Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As a contract Recruiter at Power Digital, you will plug directly into an active, high-volume recruiting pipeline and own full-cycle recruiting across a set of assigned roles. This is an execution-focused engagement built for someone who ramps fast, operates independently, and genuinely cares about moving candidates through a process with speed and care. You will work closely with the TA team and hiring managers to keep momentum on open requisitions while delivering a candidate experience that reflects who we are.

Responsibilities:

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for assigned roles, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and offer support
  • Manage candidate progress in Greenhouse, ensuring accurate records, timely updates, and clean pipeline hygiene at all times
  • Partner with hiring managers on role requirements, candidate profiles, and feedback to keep searches moving efficiently
  • Proactively source and engage passive talent through LinkedIn Recruiter with a focus on building diverse, high-quality pipelines
  • Ensure every candidate moves through the process with clarity, speed, and a positive experience from first touch to close
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize your recruiting workflows and day-to-day processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to the Talent Acquisition function

Role Requirements:

  • 3 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, agency or in-house
  • Hands-on experience with an ATS, Greenhouse strongly preferred
  • Ability to manage multiple open roles simultaneously without losing detail or momentum
  • Strong communicator who can build trust quickly with candidates and hiring managers alike
  • Comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
  • Genuine commitment to inclusive hiring practices and diverse sourcing
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and AI-assisted recruiting tools

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Monthly Hiring Targets: Achieve monthly hiring targets across several departments, with a minimum requirement of 5 hires per month, adjusting as per company needs and budget.
  • Time-to-Fill Efficiency: Maintain a maximum time-to-fill of 45 days for critical roles.

Most Important Things (MITs):

  • Brand Ambassador: Act as a brand ambassador for Power Digital, promoting our culture and values to potential candidates
  • Trusted Advisor: Be a trusted advisor and consultant for hiring managers regarding talent acquisition best practices, ideal candidate profiles, and cultural differences in the vetting and interview process
  • Efficient Candidate Experience: Ensure candidates progress smoothly and rapidly through the recruitment process, enhancing their experience
  • Effective Greenhouse Usage: Properly manage candidate data and assist hiring managers in navigating Greenhouse systems for streamlined recruitment operations
  • Diverse Talent Networks: Actively contribute to building diverse talent networks to enhance the organization's commitment to diversity and inclusion

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is amplifying human ingenuity with AI.

Our Team

Adobe Creative is Adobe’s in-house brand-creative engine, developing the ideas, campaigns, and assets that power Adobe’s brand and business. We are part of the broader Content & Creative (“C&C”) organization. We work alongside Adobe Content, which focuses on publishing and audience development through owned, earned, and partner channels; an Experiences team, which oversees Adobe’s real-world moments; and shared service teams spanning Video, Talent, Partnerships, and Production.

Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency.

The Opportunity

Adobe makes the tools the world uses to create. Our own writing and storytelling should set the standard for what those tools make possible. Adobe Creative is looking for an exceptionalSenior Copywriterto create clear, original and culturally relevant work across Adobe Creative’s output.

You will write across campaigns, multi-platform storytelling, product narratives, brand films and live experiences, moving confidently between a sharp headline, a product narrative, a script, and a multi-platform idea. Working alongside Copy leaders, Creative Directors, Designers, Strategists and Product partners, you will help turn complex briefs and technologies into language people can understand, feel and remember.

You will be part of a new copywriting practice built for how brands communicate today. You will contribute to copywriters’ rooms, help develop narratives and verbal systems, and use AI-enabled tools to expand creative exploration without giving up human judgment, originality, or craft.

You are a writer first. You still search for the unexpected line, challenge the first answer, and care deeply about every word.

What You’ll Do

Write Across the Work

  • Create original copy across campaigns, multi-platform storytelling, product narratives, brand films, and live experiences.

  • Move fluidly between headlines, scripts, manifestos, product narratives, multi-platform ideas and longer-form storytelling.

  • Translate complex product capabilities and audience insights into simple, human, and compelling language.

  • Develop writing that feels recognizably Adobe without becoming corporate, repetitive or predictable.

Develop Ideas and Narratives

  • Help shape verbal systems that can support flagship storytelling and high-velocity work.

  • Bring a strong creative point of view to briefs, scripts, messaging, and creative presentations.

  • Help develop voice frameworks, messaging systems, naming approaches, and reusable writing tools.

  • Create systems that help teams work faster without losing personality, clarity, or craft.

  • Share writing practices, references, and learning with the broader creative community.

Advance AI-Native Writing

  • Use AI-enabled writing and research tools throughout concepting, drafting, editing and iteration.

  • Use generative tools to expand exploration rather than simply increase the volume of copy.

  • Apply strong creative judgment to all AI-assisted writing.

  • Test emerging Adobe capabilities through real creative work and share useful feedback with Product teams.

  • Work closely with Designers, Art Directors, Motion teams, Strategists, Producers, Product and Product Marketing.

  • Exceptional copywriting and creative judgment, with the ability to make language clearer, sharper, and more memorable.

  • The ability to move confidently between short-form and long-form writing.

  • Strong presentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

jobs.title: Design Team Lead - Ecommerce Marketing Agency
jobs.excerpt: The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team.
jobs.description:
The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team. There are two sides to it. One is craft, which means keeping the standard of the design work high across every client we serve. The other is people, which means keeping the team organised, supported, and able to do good work without getting stuck.

Most of what the team produces is email and SMS campaign design for ecommerce brands, along with ad images, GIFs, short video edits, and the occasional landing page. You will still design yourself, but the larger part of the job is making sure what goes out is right. You are the person who spots what is not working in a design before the client does, and who explains the fix in a way a designer can act on straight away.

You will work closely with Account Managers, who assign the day to day tasks, and with the designers who carry them out. A good deal of the role sits between those two groups: helping an Account Manager work out what a campaign actually needs, turning that into clear direction for a designer, and saying so when a request does not make sense.

The Design Team Lead reports to the Service Director, and works closely with the other departments at Hustler Marketing to make sure design work is delivered well and on time.

About the Role:Mission statement:

To keep the quality of our design work at a level clients notice, and to run a team that is organised, well briefed, and heard.
The first half of that is craft. Reviewing work, spotting what is weak in a design, and giving direction that makes it better. The second half is people. Distributing the week, reorganising it when something changes, and making sure the team's ideas and concerns reach someone who can act on them. We already have a strong team here, independent and reliable. What they need from a lead is someone who listens properly and comes back with a real answer.


General Responsibilities:

Design quality and direction

  • Reviewing the team's design work before it reaches Account Managers or clients, and giving feedback specific enough to act on
  • Diagnosing why a design is not working, whether that is hierarchy, contrast, the weight of the call to action, the balance of image to text, or how it holds up on mobile, and writing the fix down clearly
  • Advising Account Managers on what a campaign needs visually, and pushing back when a brief is thin or a request will not serve the client
  • Designing directly when the workload calls for it. This is a hands-on role, not a purely supervisory one
  • Keeping the work consistent across a wide range of client brands, niches, and visual identities
  • Setting and holding the design standards for email and SMS campaigns, ad images, GIFs, and short video assets
  • Understanding each client's visual brand identity well enough to advise on ideas, improvements, and optimisations

Running the week

  • Distributing and organising the team's workload week by week, working from the tasks Account Managers assign
  • Reorganising the queue quickly when priorities change, someone is unavailable, or a client adds something at the last minute
  • Keeping track of who is overloaded and who is not, and rebalancing before it turns into a missed deadline
  • Being the first person the Design Team comes to when something is blocking their work
  • Making sure the design targets set for each client account are met

The team

  • Running the Design Team's group calls and regular one-to-ones
  • Collecting the team's suggestions and concerns, taking them seriously, and coming back with an answer, including when the answer is no
  • Mentoring designers and helping the less experienced members build their skills
  • Onboarding new designers into how we work
  • Connecting Design with the other service teams through workshops, short tutorials, and written documentation
  • Running training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team

Process and improvement

  • Noticing where a workflow, a handoff, or a piece of communication is costing the team time, and fixing it
  • Writing and maintaining the documentation the team works from
  • Keeping up with what Figma ships and bringing the useful parts into how the team works
  • Staying current on design and email marketing trends, and sharing what matters rather than everything
  • Bringing industry best practices back to the Service Director and to the team
  • Taking on projects and initiatives delegated by the Service Director


Position Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month, consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement, meaning you cannot hold a position of a similar nature elsewhere while working for Hustler Marketing
  • A 30-day notice period after the first month
  • Performance reviews every 9 to 12 months, with the first one after 3 to 6 months

Requirements

About you:

Profile:

You are a senior designer with at least five years behind you, and a portfolio of real client work across different brands and niches rather than a handful of personal projects. At least three of those years involve email marketing design.

You are expert in Figma. Not comfortable in it, expert. You should be able to build and maintain component libraries, and it helps if you follow what Figma releases closely enough to tell the team when something new is worth adopting. Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity is a useful complement, though we do not lean on either heavily.

You know more than one kind of design output. Email and SMS campaign design is the core of it, but ad images, GIFs, and short video edits come up constantly. Some basic knowledge of web design is a plus rather than a requirement, since landing pages appear from time to time and the team already handles most of that themselves.

What matters most is your eye, and how you talk about it. You can look at a design that is not performing and say what is wrong with it, in what order, and what you would change first. Then you can put that in a message a designer understands without needing a follow-up call. That skill is most of this job.

You are organised enough to run a week of work across several people, and to rearrange it at short notice without the whole thing falling apart.

You are the sort of person a team talks to. Ours is independent and reliable, and there are a few things they would like to see improved that are hard to change quickly. What matters to them is knowing their comments are being considered and answered, not that every one of them gets a yes.

You are curious. You notice when a process could be better and you do something about it instead of working around it. You bring people together across teams with workshops, documents, and tutorials without waiting to be asked.

And you notice detail, in your own work and in everyone else's.


Key traits for this position:

Strong visual judgement, and the vocabulary to explain it. Organised, and calm when the week changes shape. Approachable, and willing to have the honest conversation rather than the easy one. Curious about tools and trends without chasing every new thing. Detail-oriented past the point of comfort. At ease working remotely with people spread across several countries and time zones.


Key Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a graphic designer, with a minimum of 3 years in email marketing design
  • Expert-level Figma skills, including building and working from component libraries
  • Working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity
  • Experience producing ad images, animated GIFs, and short video edits
  • An established portfolio showing on-brand, effective design work for a range of clients, stores, and niches
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating other designers. A formal lead title is not required, but you should have done the work
  • The ability to review someone else's design work and give written feedback that is specific and actionable
  • The ability to distribute and reorganise a team's weekly workload, including at short notice
  • A basic understanding of web design and landing pages is a plus
  • Experience with Klaviyo, or with a comparable email marketing platform, is a plus
  • Comfortable with Slack, Asana, Hubstaff, Google Workspace, and Figma, and willing to learn whatever else we use
  • Fluent written and spoken English. It does not need to be your first language, but you will be writing feedback and running calls in it every day
  • Remote work experience, ideally with a team spread across time zones
  • Available and responsive during office hours, Monday to Friday between 3 and 6 PM Barcelona time
  • Consistently working 30 to 35 hours per week, which is 140 hours per month
  • A stable internet connection, a laptop or PC, and the ability to join video calls

jobs.description:
About Us

OpenFX is on a mission to move money as freely as data, unrestricted by time zones, banking hours, or legacy systems. We are building the infrastructure that will power the next generation of cross-border payment systems for institutions.

The team’s execution has been exceptional and we are scaling at a remarkable pace. Our early team brings experience from J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, FalconX, PayPal, Affirm, Polygon, Kraken, Nium and others, and we are backed by Accel, Lightspeed, NFX and other top-tier investors.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Product Operations for Latin America to own how new currencies and corridors actually get to market across the region. Every currency we launch unlocks new corridors for our institutional clients and drives trading volume and revenue directly. Your mandate is to make that expansion happen on the ground: sourcing and onboarding liquidity providers, standing up settlement rails with banking partners, clearing jurisdiction-specific regulatory requirements, and holding every launch to the reliability bar our clients expect.

You will run the regional launch pipeline with real independence. You will own pricing inputs, sequencing and the go-live decision. You report to the Product Leader of Global Payments & Currencies, who sets strategic prioritisation for which currencies matter most based on payout corridor relevance. You own the how and the when.

If you have shipped cross-border payment products, worked with banking or card network infrastructure, or built API-driven financial products across jurisdictions, this role will feel familiar. The difference is that you will be doing it at the frontier of stablecoin-settled FX infrastructure, where the rails are new and the playbook is yours to write.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own corridor launch, end to end. You own every currency in your regional pipeline from Alpha through General Availability. You track liquidity partner onboarding, settlement rail readiness, regulatory clearance, operational setup and pricing. You run readiness reviews, maintain the launch checklist, and make the go/no-go call.
  • Operationalise our licences. Holding a licence and being able to use it are two different things. You work with Product Management, Legal and Regulatory, Compliance, Finance and Engineering to turn each licence, registration and partner permission into permitted product scope, documented operating procedures and live client flows. You keep what we are authorised to do and what we actually run in market in step, and you make sure new capability reaches clients as soon as the licence allows rather than months later.
  • Work directly with LPs and banking partners. You are the product voice in liquidity provider onboarding and banking partner discussions. You understand what it takes to stand up a new currency pair technically, what banking partners need in order to enable settlement, and how to translate partner constraints into product decisions.
  • Navigate multi-market regulatory complexity. Every currency carries jurisdiction-specific requirements. You work with Legal and Regulatory to establish what is needed, translate it into product and engineering decisions, and ensure no currency launches without clearance.
  • Prioritise engineering effort. You work with engineers to deliver against the roadmap. You write specs, set sprint priorities, and partner with your EM so capacity lands on the highest-impact currencies.
  • Drive post-launch adoption. A currency is not done at launch. You track whether clients are actually trading new corridors, partner with GTM to drive activation, find the friction, and feed what you learn back into prioritisation.
  • Build the regional launch playbook. You turn each launch into a repeatable, documented process covering every dependency, gate criterion and handoff, so the tenth currency is faster than the first.

What We Are Looking For

Must-haves

  • 8+ years in product management, product operations or programme management. You have owned a complex, multi-dependency delivery process in a B2B or infrastructure product.
  • Cross-border payments or financial infrastructure context. You have worked on payments, FX, card networks or digital asset products.
  • Multi-market experience. You have shipped products across multiple countries or regulatory jurisdictions.
  • Comfort operating between product, legal and compliance. You can read a regulatory requirement, work out what it means for a product flow, and drive it to a decision without waiting to be told.
  • Operational rigour. You maintain systems that track complex, multi-dependency work. You build the checklist, follow up on the open item, and catch the gap before it becomes a blocker.
  • Based in Brazil, in São Paulo or remote, and fluent in Portuguese and English.

What helps you stand out

  • LatAm corridor knowledge. Experience with Brazilian and wider LatAm payment rails, regulatory environments or banking partner ecosystems. Spanish is a plus alongside Portuguese.
  • Licensing and regulatory delivery. You have helped operationalise a licence, registration or scheme membership, not just tracked one.
  • Card network or payment scheme background. Time at a card network, payment scheme or large-scale processor with multi-market product launches.
  • Stablecoin or digital asset rails. Familiarity with stablecoin settlement, on and off-ramp infrastructure, or crypto payment products.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Equity in a rapidly growing company
  • The chance to work in a fast-paced startup at the forefront of fintech innovation
  • Real impact on global financial infrastructure
  • A collaborative culture with genuine emphasis on personal and professional growth

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status

The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Foundry, an AI-Native Recruiting Agency currently in build at FutureSight. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Recruiting has run on the same model for decades: firms charge a fixed percentage of a hire's first-year salary for work that is largely manual, sourcing, screening, and outreach done one candidate at a time. That pricing made sense when the work required a person doing it by hand. It doesn't anymore.

Market Context

Foundry is an AI-native recruiting firm built around a simple idea: use AI agents to handle sourcing, screening, and candidate evaluation, and keep a small human team focused on what still requires a person: building trust with clients and candidates, exercising judgment on close calls, and closing the placement. That shift in who does the work lets us offer clients a fee that's a fraction of what traditional firms charge, without cutting corners on quality.

This is where we believe recruiting is headed. AI-native service firms are starting to emerge and prove the model works, and we're building toward that shift deliberately.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets
  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning
  • Customer Development — Lead pilot placements with design-partner companies, convert them to paid retained relationships, and build the go-to-market motion
  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company
  • Demonstrated success in B2B AI or B2B SaaS go-to-market, including consultative, relationship-driven sales and customer engagement
  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company
  • Deep domain expertise in recruiting, staffing, or talent acquisition, as a builder operator or agency leader

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset.

About the role

Fundraise Up is building high-trust donation and fundraising experiences that help nonprofits grow their impact. We are looking for a UX Researcher to strengthen how UX research informs product decisions across the company.

You will focus on two areas: leading complex, ambiguous, high-impact UX research that informs product strategy, and building a scalable UX Research practice within the Design team. Designers will run simpler studies independently, while you provide the process, coaching, quality guardrails, and support that make research a consistent habit.

You will be the dedicated UX Research expert within the Research Team, working alongside Product and Marketing Researchers who will support you across your projects. You will bring deep UX Research expertise while collaborating closely with the wider Product, Design, and Analytics teams.

  • Lead high-impact research from the quarterly plan and run it end-to-end: intake brief → write methodology → conduct research → analyze → synthesize → present → push actions.

  • Run your work independently: access to tools/data, participant scheduling and confirmations, session logistics, note-taking, and documentation — no hand-holding.
  • Work closely with Product Analytics to connect quantitative and qualitative evidence. We work together and show a product manager a full picture of user behavior.
  • Experiment with new approaches and tools, from moderated and unmoderated testing to emerging AI-enabled methods such as synthetic users, where they can add real value.
  • Be the user's best friend: ensure user needs and constraints are represented in product decisions – not just opinions.

Requirements

  • At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. You should already be using AI meaningfully in your work. We will not teach you how to use AI, but we will give you everything you need, like unlimited Claude and support from AI-experienced colleagues.
  • Bring exceptional empathy and care for people: our users are nonprofits and donors—people doing good in the world—so you approach participants with respect, sensitivity, and high ethical standards.

You should already be using AI meaningfully in your work and understand where it adds value and how it can improve the way you operate.

The second is hf-voice, a new product that will let any developer build and deploy voice agents with their Hugging Face account.

Job title: Head of Business Development, Europe (m/w/d)

Location: Germany (Munich or Düsseldorf preferred) — remote, with regular travel across Europe. Candidates based in the United Kingdom or the Nordics will also be considered.

Compensation: Competitive base salary and uncapped performance-related variable compensation, benchmarked above market for the region. We will share the specific range with you in our first conversation, before any interview. We will not ask you about your current or previous salary at any stage.

Role Overview

Lumenci is seeking a Head of Business Development, Europe (m/w/d) to establish and scale our commercial presence across the European market, spanning both Lumenci's expert IP services and , our expert-guided AI platform for patent intelligence and monetisation.

This is a founding, revenue-owning role. You will be Lumenci's first dedicated business development leader in Europe, responsible for market entry, pipeline generation from a standing start, and closing the first wave of European clients across corporate IP departments, law firms, and litigation funders.

The role reports directly to the CEO and sits at the intersection of enterprise sales, IP domain expertise, product go-to-market, and regional market building. It is a senior individual contributor position carrying a personal revenue target, with the autonomy and executive access to match. Over time, this role will help define and build the European commercial function, including establishing repeatable market-entry processes and, as the region scales, contributing to future team structure and hiring.

You will work cross-functionally with our technical experts, consulting delivery teams, product leadership, and marketing to translate deep technical IP capability into European client relationships and recurring revenue.

About Lumenci

Founded in 2018, Lumenci is a premier intellectual property consulting firm specialising in patent litigation, expert witness testimony, and patent monetisation for leading corporations and global law firms across the software, telecommunications, semiconductor, and emerging technology sectors.

A key part of our model is the integration of deep technical expertise with litigation strategy. Our teams support high-stakes disputes by developing technical narratives, performing rigorous analysis, and partnering with world-class expert witnesses whose testimony shapes case outcomes in courts and arbitration forums worldwide. Alongside our services business, our iLumos platform delivers expert-guided AI for patent intelligence — portfolio segmentation, target identification, and infringement and validity assessment — moving clients from analysis to action in minutes rather than months.

Today we work with more than 175 clients and 80 law firms, supported by over 100 technical experts and 300+ campaigns, with more than $3.5B tied to verdicts, settlements, and negotiated outcomes.

Headquartered in Austin, Texas, with offices in San Francisco, New York, and Gurugram, India, Lumenci delivers end-to-end support spanning technical analysis, expert strategy, valuation, and monetisation execution. We are backed by VSS Capital Partners and Century Equity Partners.

We have built a strong North American franchise. Europe is our next market, and this is the role that opens it.

Key Responsibilities

Market entry and go-to-market strategy

  • Define and execute the go-to-market plan for Europe, beginning with the DACH region and expanding into the UK, Nordics, and broader EU markets.

  • Define ideal customer profiles, target account lists, and high-value early adopter segments for the European market.

  • Contribute to product positioning, messaging, and commercialisation strategy for both Lumenci services and iLumos, based on European customer and market feedback.

  • Gather structured market intelligence, customer discovery insights, and competitive observations — including UPC-driven shifts in European patent strategy — to inform roadmap and go-to-market decisions.

  • Advise leadership on entity, partner, and hiring decisions as Europe moves from beachhead to scaled operation.

New business development and enterprise sales

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle for the region: territory and account planning, outbound prospecting, discovery, solution shaping with technical experts, commercial negotiation, and close.

  • Build durable executive relationships with Chief IP Counsel, Heads of Patents, General Counsel, Heads of Licensing, R&D and innovation leaders, and IP partners at leading European firms.

  • Build the region's pipeline through targeted outbound, referral networks, and a deliberate industry-event strategy across the European IP and licensing calendar.

  • Structure complex, multi-year engagements spanning litigation support, portfolio and licensing programmes, technical analysis, and AI-enabled IP platform services.

Platform commercialisation and pilots

  • Lead tailored iLumos demonstrations, workflow walkthroughs, and value-based conversations with European law firms, corporate IP teams, and litigation funders.

  • Structure pilot and proof-of-concept engagements with clear business objectives, success criteria, stakeholders, and timelines.

  • Support conversion of pilots and early engagements into subscription, usage-based, or long-term commercial relationships.

  • Stay engaged through early adoption on your first European accounts, partnering with product leadership and consulting delivery on onboarding, enablement, and value realisation until the region supports dedicated customer success coverage.

Commercial infrastructure

  • Establish the CRM discipline, forecasting cadence, and pipeline reporting rigour that the region will scale on, in partnership with global revenue operations.

  • Build repeatable market-entry, prospecting, and deal-structuring playbooks that support expansion into additional European markets.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally across product, engineering, consulting, sales, and executive leadership teams spanning US, European, and Indian operations.

Who You Are

You are a domain-deep, entrepreneurial enterprise seller who has built a market rather than inherited one. You are equally credible in a discovery conversation with a Head of Patents, a technical scoping session with reverse-engineering experts, a platform demonstration with end users, and a commercial negotiation with procurement.

You understand that in IP services and patent intelligence, trust and technical credibility precede transactions, and you have both the network and the substance to earn them. You are comfortable with the ambiguity of a first-in-region role, and you would rather own the outcome than inherit the infrastructure.

Required Qualifications

  • Extensive experience — typically 12 years or more — in enterprise business development or complex solution sales, with a sustained record of new-logo acquisition and target overachievement against seven-figure annual revenue goals.

  • Direct experience selling into intellectual property, legal, or professional services buyers — corporate IP and legal departments, and/or IP law firms.

  • Demonstrated success building a market, territory, or region from a standing start rather than inheriting an established book of business.

  • Proven ability to sell consultative, high-consideration engagements with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders, including procurement and legal.

  • Experience running discovery conversations, guiding product demonstrations or capability presentations, and translating customer needs into solution workflows and quantified business value.

  • Established European network across the IP, licensing, or legal services community.

  • Strong CRM discipline and forecasting rigour, with the ability to establish commercial infrastructure without dedicated support.

  • Business-fluent English, plus business-fluent German or another major European business language aligned to your territory.

  • Legally authorised to work in your country of residence within Europe, and willing to travel extensively across the region.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at an IP intelligence, legal technology, expert services, patent analytics, or IP managed services provider.

  • Technical fluency in one or more of: semiconductors, telecommunications and standards, AI/ML and cloud, software, consumer electronics, or medical devices.

  • Experience selling AI-enabled or platform-based products alongside expert human delivery.

  • Experience helping launch or commercialise a new product, business line, or geographic market.

  • Familiarity with patent monetisation, licensing programmes, or litigation funding economics.

  • Active participation in the European IP community — LES, AIPPI, EPO and UPC-adjacent events, IP Service World, IPBC, or similar.

  • Comfort operating in a founder-led, high-growth, distributed environment across US, European, and Indian teams.

What We Offer

  • Direct reporting line to the CEO, with genuine ownership of a region rather than a territory within an existing structure.

  • Base salary and on-target earnings as stated above, with uncapped variable compensation and accelerators above target.

  • A guaranteed variable component during your ramp period, reflecting that this is a market-entry role with no existing pipeline.

  • The scope and visibility of a founding commercial role in a private-equity-backed, high-growth business.

  • Remote working with a dedicated travel and industry-event budget.

  • 30 days of annual leave, plus public holidays and local benefits appropriate to your country of employment.

Recruitment Process

  1. Introductory conversation with People Operations

  2. Interview with the Chief Executive Officer

  3. Market-entry working session, based on a plan you prepare

  4. Panel conversation with consulting delivery, technical experts, and marketing

  5. Final conversation and reference checks

We aim to respond to every applicant. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please tell us in your application or contact us at , and we will make appropriate arrangements.

Lumenci is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, gender identity, age, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual orientation, marital or family status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law, including the German General Equal Treatment Act (AGG) and the UK Equality Act 2010. How Your Data Is Handled

Lumenci is the data controller for personal data you submit as part of this application. We process your data on the basis of our legitimate interest in assessing candidates and taking steps prior to entering into a contract of employment.

Your data will be used solely to assess your application, will be shared internally only with those involved in this recruitment process, and will be stored in our applicant tracking system. jobs.description:
AI Visibility Strategist

Full-time · Remote-first (Canada) · Reports to the Head of Advisory

About podium iq

AI models now decide who gets recommended, considered and chosen. We measure how enterprise brands show up inside those answers, score them against the competitors that actually appear, and turn the finding into a content plan. Then we ship the content. Most of this category stops at the dashboard - we don’t, which is why our clients are financial institutions, global consumer technology brands, national regulating bodies, and major consulting firms.


What the work looks like

It starts with a conversation rather than a query. A client arrives with something they want to understand, usually phrased more vaguely than they realize, and your first job is to turn it into a question worth measuring. Get that wrong and the run is a beautifully rendered answer to nothing, which is the most expensive mistake available to us.

Then the results come back and you interrogate them. The platform surfaces the pattern and ranks the recommendation. You bring the market context, the competitive read and the client knowledge that turns a strong recommendation into the right one for that business, this quarter.

The third part is making sure the fix can be found. Answer engine optimization is yours: structure, schema, internal linking, architecture, and the retrieval signals that decide whether a page gets cited or sits there unread. You will brief the content, review it, and hold the quality line before anything reaches a client.

You do all of this beside our founder and our head of advisory to begin with, on live enterprise accounts, learning the method on real work rather than in a deck. Then you take accounts of your own, and we would like that to happen quickly.

Interested? Keep reading.

What we’re looking for

  • Six or more years in SEO, content strategy or digital strategy, spent owning the thinking rather than executing someone else's.

  • Real AEO and SEO range, technical and editorial. Schema and structured data, site and content architecture, crawl and indexation, on-page, internal linking, and comfort inside analytics and visibility platforms.

  • Analytical rigour with writing to match. You can take something large and noisy and come back with one page that is right.

  • A point of view you offer before anyone asks for it, and the research to back it up.

  • A nose for the missing question. The platform is strong and the models change weekly, so what we value most is your sense of what the analysis has not been asked.

  • We build with AI across our stack and you will too. Underneath it we want your own hypothesis and the curiosity to find out whether it held.

  • The habit of raising a hand. We are distributed, and the people who enjoy it here flag capacity early and pull threads nobody handed them.

What you’ll build toward: Within your first 6 months you will have command of a methodology you cannot learn anywhere else, genuine depth in a category that is only about two years old, and the presence to carry a room full of enterprise stakeholders, built by watching, then supporting, then leading.

The practical details

Remote-first and open to candidates within Canada. You will work with strategists, copywriters, creative and product across several time zones, asynchronously by default. We are still building the culture rather than inheriting one, and that is meant as an invitation.

If this sounds like you, then here's how to apply

Send us your resume and two other things:

  1. A piece of analysis you are proud of, with a short note on what you concluded that the data did not obviously hand you and what changed because of it.

  2. A question about AI search you have not been able to answer yet.

Short listed candidates will be invited to run an asynchronous analysis inside podium iq, which is the closest thing to a real day with podium iq and the part where we learn the most about how you think.

The Sr. PM, EPTR is expected to have a working knowledge of drug development and clinical trial execution. S/he has overall responsibility for the successful initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, controlling and closure of assigned clinical trials. The Senior Project Manager acts as the main line of communication to relevant stakeholders and provides input to feasibility, study design, budget development and ensures progress reporting (resources, budget and timeline).

The Sr. PM, EPTR also acts as a mentor and provides training to other project managers and actively contributes to continuous improvement efforts of the department.

More specifically, the Senior Project Manager, EPTR must:

  • Serves as primary contact for the Sponsor, sites, CRAs, vendors and internal team throughout the study.
  • Ensures assigned studies are “audit ready” at all times (project team training records, central files, system validation, etc.).
  • Communicates effectively with sponsors, study team members, functional departments, and senior management
  • Serve as escalation point for project issues to internal and external stakeholders, as appropriate. Proactively identify and resolve conflicts.
  • Proactively, manages operational aspects of the clinical trial including trial timelines, budget, resources and vendors. Coordinates tasks and deliverables from all functional departments involved in the project.
  • Controls the project budget by ensuring that project team member understand the hours allocation for each task and review time billed to the study against the budget to control write-off and identify out of scope activities for change orders
  • Provides efficient updates on trial progress to the internal and external stakeholders, with respect to site selection, vendor selection, project plans, trial budget and timeline management, quality standards and risk mitigation.
  • Aid in development and maintenance of key project performance indicators for client specified metrics, ensuring that the KPIs are within scope of the project contract
  • Defines and manages project resource needs and establish succession plans for key team members.
  • Leads study start-up process, including but not limited to conduct of the Trial Kick-off meeting the set-up of trial master file (TMF), site selection and finalization of site lists, site activation, management of vendor set up timelines and site contracting and budgeting.
  • Manages risk and control measures to assure project quality. Escalates issue appropriately to Innovaderm management, quality assurance and sponsor, when required.
  • Leads client calls, internal work groups, vendor status update meetings. Ensure meeting minutes are completed, distributed to team members and filed in the Trial Master File (TMF) in a timely manner.
  • Monitors the quality of study deliverables, (including vendor and SubCRO deliverables), addresses quality issues with the appropriate team member and identify opportunities to improve training, execution and quality control across the study team
  • Analyzes discrepancies between planned and actual results and participates in the development and implementation of corrective actions to be taken as needed.
  • Ensures that project specific training matrix is customized to each study and maintained accurate through out the study
  • Ensures all team members including contracted services providers have adequate training on the project by reviewing training records periodically during the trial
  • Reviews and approves Indero, site, and vendor responses to quality assurance audits for appropriateness, timeliness and accordance with company SOPs and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensures that study specific documents and project deliverables (e.g., study plans, protocol, informed consent form, electronic case report form (eCRF), tables/listings/figures (TLFs), clinical study report, etc.) are developed on time and meet study requirements
  • Ensures all project level study documentation is filed in the TMF in accordance with company SOPs/all regulatory requirements and provide oversight to the clinical team regarding TMF filing, maintenance and archival procedures
  • Provides project status updates to external and internal stakeholders ensuring compliance with the study budget, project scope and timelines and in accordance with applicable standard operating procedures (SOPs), good clinical practices, regulatory and study-specific requirements.
  • Manages and reports on recruitment status and highlights initiatives needed to mitigate slippage in recruitment timelines
  • Participates in the planning and conduct of Investigator’s Meetings
  • Collaborate with the Regulatory Affairs group, to ensures submission to central are done on time and collection of required essential documents is complete prior to site initiation and maintained current throughout study duration. Ensures that the Trial Master File (TMF) is complete, accurate, and inspection ready at all times.
  • Oversee clinical monitoring activities for site qualification, initiation, routine and close-out visits (i.e. project-specific training of CRAs, reviewing monitoring visit reports and follow-up letters, ensuring compliance with monitoring plan, escalation of site-related issues).
  • Contributes to the development of the Clinical Monitoring Plan.
  • Prepares and conducts project-specific training for the CRAs; may perform study initiation visits (SIV) for single-site studies.
  • Develops the annotated site visit reports and monitoring tools such as source data verification worksheets.
  • May serve as a point of contact for CRAs and Lead CRAs for assigned projects.
  • Supports the sites and ensures that each site has the necessary material to adequately perform the study (e.g., investigational product, study supplies, special equipment, safety lab kits, etc.)
  • In collaboration with the data management group, ensures that the CRF complies with the protocol and Sponsor requirements and ensures queries resolution and data review process follow the study timelines until database lock.
  • Mentors team members.
  • In collaboration with relevant departments, prepare and deliver presentations for new business as required
  • May provide technical, therapeutic and project management expertise in training and process improvement efforts for the department

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

IDEAL PROFILE

Education

  • B.Sc. in a related field of study to clinical research;

Experience

  • At least 7 years industry experience and a minimum of 5 years in Phase I-III clinical trial project management with financial accountability.
  • Experience leading concurrent multi-centered, multinational clinical trials with budgets in excess of $25M USD.
  • PMP certification desirable
  • Experience in one or more of the following considered an asset: cost management, study start up, regulatory submission, resource management, supervisory experience, CRA, data management, medical writing, or vendor management;
  • Therapeutic experience managing dermatology trials an asset

Knowledge & skills

  • Excellent knowledge of GCP and ICH standards, FDA and local country regulations;
  • Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office suite;
  • Fluency in English with excellent oral and written skills, required
  • Bilingualism (English and local language) is an asset
  • Ability to work in a team environment and establish good relationships with colleagues and sponsors;
  • Good problem-solving abilities;
  • Strong ability to carry out different projects and work under pressure while meeting timelines
  • Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

About Indero

A Global Clinical Leader In Dermatology and Rheumatology!

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

  • Review learner feedback, performance data, and business needs to improve learning effectiveness.
  • Support learning-process transformation by helping implement improved tools, standards, workflows, governance, and ways of working.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, modernize, or digitize learning processes across the learning lifecycle.
  • Stay current on instructional design, learning technology, learning analytics, accessibility, and compliance-training practices.

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is an individual with these qualifications.

  • OR
  • Master’s degree and 6 years of training experience
  • OR
  • Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of training experience
  • OR
  • Associate’s degree and 10 years of training experience
  • OR

  • Bachelor’s degree in instructional design, education, learning and development, organizational development, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

  • Proven track record of successfully managing e-learning projects from conception to completion
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Knowledgeable on SCORM LMS

Job Title: Group Air Travel Advisor
Department: Group Air
Reports to: Kaleen Klein, Group Air Manager
Location: Flexible, Remote

Christopherson Business Travel, a globally recognized leader in Travel Management, is seeking an experienced Group Air Travel Advisor to join our Group Air Team. This position is responsible for coordinating and servicing air travel for meetings, events, incentive programs, and other group travel programs from initial setup through ticketing and program completion.
The Group Air Travel Advisor works closely with clients, travelers, airlines, and internal teams to provide expert travel counsel, manage multiple programs simultaneously, and deliver accurate, responsive, and exceptional customer service. This role requires strong Sabre skills, excellent organizational abilities, attention to detail, and the ability to manage complex domestic and international travel arrangements in a fast-paced environment.
As an employee of Christopherson Business Travel, you will set an excellent example of our brand promise while providing a high level of service to our clients and travelers.
These duties provide an overall guide to the responsibilities of the position; additional tasks may be assigned based on business and client needs.

Responsibilities

  • Provide travel expertise and exceptional customer service for clients and travelers participating in meetings, events, incentive programs, and other group travel programs.
  • Manage air travel arrangements for multiple programs and travelers simultaneously while meeting established deadlines and service expectations.
  • Book and service domestic and international air reservations using Sabre GDS.
  • Handle complex itineraries, including multi-city travel, international travel, split tickets, split forms of payment, exchanges, refunds, and manual pricing when necessary.
  • Perform timely and accurate ticketing, exchanges, refunds, voids, and other ticketing functions.
  • Interpret and apply airline fare rules, ticketing requirements, client travel policies, and program-specific guidelines.
  • Work with airline group departments and group contracts, including managing blocked air space, deposits, ticketing deadlines, name requirements, and contract terms.
  • Research flight schedules, availability, and pricing to identify economical and efficient travel options that meet client and program requirements.
  • Communicate professionally with clients and travelers regarding flight options, schedules, pricing, ticketing deadlines, changes, and other travel requirements.
  • Provide consultative recommendations and creative solutions when standard travel options do not meet program or traveler needs.
  • Maintain accurate traveler information, PNR documentation, program records, and tracking documents.
  • Manage Excel, Google Workspace, Smartsheet, and other documents or systems used to track travelers, reservations, ticketing, deadlines, and program activity.
  • Monitor assigned programs to ensure reservations and tickets are completed accurately and within required deadlines.
  • Resolve traveler and client service issues with patience, urgency, professionalism, and sound judgment.
  • Assist travelers during schedule changes, cancellations, irregular operations (IROPs), and other travel disruptions.
  • Maintain awareness of international entry requirements, passport and visa procedures, and other requirements relevant to international travelers.
  • Ensure compliance with DOT regulations, TSA requirements, PCI standards, company procedures, and applicable client travel policies.
  • Participate professionally in client and internal meetings, including on-camera meetings when required.
  • Maintain a high level of travel industry knowledge through ongoing training and professional development.
  • Communicate and collaborate effectively with Group Air leadership, fellow advisors, Account Management, and other internal teams.
  • Be willing to assist other team members and programs when workload and service needs require.
  • Be available outside normal business hours on an occasional basis when needed to assist with urgent client or traveler issues.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 1 year of Sabre GDS experience, including reservations, ticketing, reissues/exchanges, refunds, voids, cancellations, EMD/MCO issuance, and PNR management.
  • 5+ years of reservation experience with a full-service travel agency or travel management company, including domestic and international travel.
  • Experience coordinating group air travel, including working with airline group departments, blocked air space, group contracts, ticketing deadlines, and traveler manifests is preferred.
  • Strong international booking, pricing, ticketing, and exchange experience.
  • Ability to interpret fare rules and confidently handle complex ticketing, exchanges, refunds, split tickets, split forms of payment, and manual pricing when necessary.
  • Familiarity with DOT regulations, TSA requirements, passport and visa procedures, international entry requirements, and PCI compliance.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook and Excel, and comfortable working with Google Workspace, Smartsheet, GDS, mid-office, and other travel technology platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate professionally with clients, travelers, airlines, and internal partners.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple programs, travelers, deadlines, and requests simultaneously.
  • The ability to accept coaching, apply feedback, and work within an established process
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment
  • Self-motivated with a desire to positively influence others
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a professional, distraction-free home office environment are required.
  • Comfortable participating on camera during client and internal meetings as needed.
  • Working hours preferred 8:30 am –5:30 pm MST, Mon-Fri

Perform monitoring and site management work to ensure that sites are conducting the study(ies) and reporting study data as required by the study protocol, applicable regulations and guidelines, and sponsor requirements.

Essential Functions
• Perform site monitoring visits (selection, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits) in accordance with contracted scope of work and Good Clinical Practice.

• Collaborate and liaise with study team members for project execution support as appropriate.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to small to medium size customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $5k to $20k, and typically involve proof of concepts, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to owners, safety and operational managers.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. You will be selling over zoom and not in person.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close.
  • Generate pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, as well as receive inbound leads from our account development team.
  • Target accounts with 11-30 vehicles.
  • Experience handling and owning transactional sales process with high volume demands.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 1+ years of experience in a closing sales role

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the commercial space - small to medium deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Experience in fast-paced, transactional sales
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Senior ERP Finance Consultant

About Us

GenetiQ delivers perfect-fit software solutions that elevate the businesses of our customers. Powered by our customer-focused, collaborative and innovative team, our software is used by more than 2,500 businesses worldwide. Continuously innovating since 1992, our open and trusting environment has created lasting relationships. GenetiQ's founders and many of our first team members are still a core part of the organisation. GenetiQ employees drive our culture and success and our goal is to inspire, support and help them to develop – and enjoy – their careers. GenetiQ was honoured in the Deloitte Fast 50 for the fourth year running in 2020. To stay future-focused, we are always looking for dynamic team players who are customer-focused and share our enthusiasm for technology. If this sounds like you, then come elevate your career at GenetiQ.

We recently announced the launch of GenetiQ, our new cloud-native, browser-based ERP software solution. This innovative business management platform is set to redefine industry standards by offering a level of personalisation and flexibility previously unavailable in the cloud.

Scope of Role

Our ERP Finance Implementation Consultants have ultimate responsibility for the smooth implementation of GenetiQ software and related financial solutions for our customers. The Consultant will be the product and finance process expert, leading design discussions focused on core accounting and financial operations, guiding clients on best practices, performing software configuration, providing training to customers, supporting issues, and more.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with all internal and external project stakeholders to ensure a successful implementation of GenetiQ.
  • Lead workshops to gather requirements and assist in defining a blueprint and financial project plan, with a focus on financial process mapping such as general ledger, chart of accounts, accounts receivable/payable, and financial reporting.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for financial modules during the implementation lifecycle, including scoping, configuration, testing, and go-live support.
  • Ensure the project is defined, designed, and configured effectively to best support the customer’s needs.
  • Validate that the customer understands the specifications of the software, such as inclusions and exclusions.
  • Liaise with customers to define requirements, configurations, and specifications for modifications to the software or integrations with external applications.
  • Assist the development team with understanding of specifications during the development of modifications, and subsequently test and document developed changes.
  • Become an expert in GenetiQ, our newly launched browser based ERP platform, to educate and advise customers on best practices.
  • Provide expert input to Project Manager, including comprehensive task definition on project plan, estimation of work duration, identification of potential risks, etc.
  • Train colleagues in the operation of software to ensure a smooth hand over of projects to the support function.
  • Train the customer’s project team and provide knowledge transfer in the operation of software.
  • Deliver specialised training in financial modules, as well as demonstrations to support pre-sale consultancy.
  • Advise customers on financial best practices, ensuring compliance with accounting standards, tax rules, and internal controls.
  • Take responsibility within an implementation to ensure all customer documentation is completed, that a pre-live checklist is prepared, and that the customer is ready to go live.
  • Assist in the data migration ETL (Extract, Transform, and Load) process from the legacy system to GenetiQ ensuring accuracy of open balances, historical transactions, and relevant master data.
  • Resolve, or assist in the resolution of, customer questions and issues arising from the implementation and subsequent live operation of software at customer sites.
  • Attend project meetings when required, internally or with clients, to gain or impart knowledge on current status of projects and to document details.
  • Complete all relevant project management documentation and help with standardization.
  • Remain engaged with customers after go-live to provide support and ensure continuity of experience.
  • Daily timesheet completion in line with company procedures.
  • Ensure project work is appropriately billed to the customer.
  • Escalate any complexities to the relevant teammate, department, or manager.
  • Live the core values and take responsibility for ensuring an experience of excellence for the customer.
  • Collaborate with the customer to professionally and proactively manage change.
  • Influence the customer to follow a process that will help with the smooth transition to GenetiQ.

Education & Experience

  • 5+ years experience within an equivalent role.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher with a concentration in business or tech.
  • CPA or financial certifications a plus.
  • Strong technical aptitude and analytical skills.
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, balancing several concurrent projects.
  • Can present professionally at a senior level and ensure the presentations are focused on the customer’s needs.
  • Willingness to travel on-site to customers as needed.
  • Willingness to work outside regular business hours on occasion.
  • Experience working across ERP functional areas.
  • Strong understanding of financial standards and compliance.
  • Experience within the Building Materials Supply Chain industry is a plus.

Benefits & Culture

Our perfect fit ethos extends to our employees, ensuring that our roles, environment, benefits and progression paths are geared toward their professional and personal development. As a member of the GenetiQ family, you'll have the freedom to unleash your creative genius, the support to make your ideas a reality, and the opportunity to grow both personally and professionally.

With our award-winning employee engagement program, we've cultivated a workplace culture where our employees feel like part of a close-knit family. Our year-round calendar of social events and activities, including summer BBQs, golf outings and charity hikes, is just one way we ensure our team's wellbeing and happiness are at the heart of everything we do.

In addition to a competitive salary and an awarding winning culture, we offer a great range of benefits including:

  • Healthcare: Health and wellbeing matter to us so we offer private healthcare to our employees.
  • Flexibility: Our flexible working plan helps employees to manage a better work-life balance.
  • Pension plan: We contribute a % of an employee's salary, helping them plan for the future.
  • Exercise reimbursement: Whether it's a gym or a golf club membership, we support the efforts of employees to keep active.
  • Holidays: GenetiQ offers 25 paid holidays, plus bank holidays.

The ideal candidate will be a strong partner to cross-functional teams, in understanding new and existing product offerings, and recommend advanced analytical products and solutions. We are looking for someone who loves to solve problems using various advanced analytical techniques and algorithms.

Reporting to the Director of Data & Analytics, your primary focus is advanced analytics - building models, uncovering behavioural and usage patterns, and generating insights that help charity partners and donors make smarter, data-driven decisions. This is an ideal opportunity for someone that wants to “use data science for good” and apply statistical and machine learning techniques to solve real-world social impact challenges. This is a new role.

The annual salary range for this role is $70,000 - $80,000. Where an offer falls within this range is determined through the interview process. Responsibilities will include but are not limited:

  • Charity Data Expertise: Become a subject matter expert on how charity data is stored and structured across multiple systems.

  • Support the development, testing, and deployment of predictive models (e.g., donor segmentation, churn prediction, lifetime value estimation)

  • Interest or emerging experience in AI/ML techniques, such as working with classification models, clustering, natural language processing, or recommendation systems

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Jitterbit is a market-leading Enterprise Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) & API Management solution provider recognized in Gartner MQ for seven straight years. We help businesses make faster and more effective decisions by making it fast, easy, and cost-effective to seamlessly connect their data, apps, and devices. In order to do this, we need to build a high-quality platform that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the quality-driven initiative to lead validation and testing efforts on our products and take on this challenge?

What you will be doing:

Jitterbit is seeking a SDET Engineer who is smart, curious, and loves the challenge of solving problems that improve the testing feedback loop. You'll collaborate with an agile team to architect, implement, and continuously deliver the testing tools and infrastructure required to run tests at scale for both our front-end and back-end components. You'll be using the latest from Node, Webdriver.io, and Typescript or from pytest and Python to accomplish these goals. You will also work with our DevOps team to integrate tests into our CI/CD pipeline using tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Selenium Grid, Docker, and other similar technologies. You will also be exposed to a lot of different end-user endpoints we are supporting from MS Sql Server/MySQL/Oracle/MongoDB, to MS Dynamics CRM/Salesforce/NetSuite, and other technology endpoints such as REST/SOAP/FTP/HTTP/XML etc.

We believe in approaching our automated testing efforts just like any other software development effort. That's why we're not just writing tests, we're building test software and reporting solutions that help our developers continuously deliver new features and products to our customers. Like keeping up with the latest trends and technologies in automated testing? Great! You'll be expected to do that and much more. We want someone who isn't afraid to experiment and bring new ideas to the table. You should be self-educating and self-motivated through curiosity, a passion for quality, and an unruly desire to squash software bugs dead in their tracks. Come help us re-imagine our solutions to provide an integration platform that delights our customers and improves the performance of a world-class engineering team.
