jobs.excerpt: Enterprise Solution ArchitectFull-Time W-2 | Fully Remote (U.
jobs.description:
Enterprise Solution Architect

Full-Time W-2 | Fully Remote (U.S.) | Federal Civilian Practice

The Problem We're Hiring You to Solve

Most architects know systems. A few know mortgage. Almost none understand it from both sides of the table: the lender and servicer technology that originates and manages loans, and the federal agency that guarantees those loans and holds industry accountable.

We are hiring one of the few. You will own the enterprise and solution architecture for the modernization of a federal home loan benefit program, translating statute, policy, and two decades of accumulated business rules into a modern platform while the 20-year-old legacy system keeps running underneath it. If you can hold the loan lifecycle and the oversight lens in your head at the same time, keep reading.

The Opportunity

This program is replacing the technology behind a nationwide home loan guaranty operation. That means origination-adjacent workflows, servicing oversight, loss mitigation, claims, grants, analytics, and the data exchanges that connect a federal agency to thousands of external lender and servicer users. The target platform is Salesforce-centered, supplemented by serverless capabilities in a government cloud. The legacy platform stays alive, integrated, and secure until the modern one absorbs its functions and the bridges between them come down.

Your job sits at the point where all of it must cohere. Requirements arrive as business needs, policy decisions, and process flows. Development teams need buildable designs with traceability, data models, integration specifications, and test strategies. The customer needs an architect who can explain why a design decision protects the program, not just how it works. And the whole effort runs on a fast clock: intake requests turn into executable plans in days, releases ship monthly, and architecture decisions that stall become delivery risks with your name on them.

This is not an ivory-tower architecture role. Your designs get built, deployed, and measured within weeks of leaving your hands, and you stay accountable for whether they hold up in production.

Why the domain requirement is real. Plenty of strong architects can design an integration. Very few can look at a servicing data exchange and know which fields carry regulatory weight, why the agency needs lineage on a particular data element, or where a workflow change quietly breaks a downstream claim calculation. This program moves too fast to teach you mortgage while you architect it. We need someone who walks in fluent.

What You'll Own

  • The target-state architecture. Define and defend one coherent enterprise architecture across the product line: legacy systems, the modern platform, and everything bridging them. Teams and the customer should make decisions against your picture of where the program is going, not their own private versions of it.
  • Solution designs that survive contact with development. Turn approved requirements into complete solution packages: architecture and state diagrams, data models, API and interface specifications, integration designs, and test strategies with full traceability back to the business need. The bar is that development builds from your package without re-litigating it.
  • The configure-versus-customize line. The program mandates out-of-the-box and configuration-first solutions, with custom code as an approved exception. You decide what is configured, what is customized, and why, and you defend those calls to the customer's change authority with evidence.
  • Data architecture and lineage. Own the logical and physical data models, data dictionaries, and the migration and bridging strategy that moves a 20-year accumulation of loan data into the modern platform without breaking the processes still running on the old one. Design data governance enforcement in, not around.
  • Industry-facing integration architecture. Design the APIs, batch exchanges, and system-to-system transfers that connect the agency to lenders, servicers, and partner systems. Fluency in mortgage data standards such as MISMO is part of the job. Resilience, self-recovery, and monitoring are design requirements, not operational afterthoughts.
  • The legacy decommissioning roadmap. Sequence which functions move when, design the bridge services that keep both platforms consistent during the transition, and plan the retirement of every bridge you create.
  • Fast, credible solution judgment. New needs enter through a formal intake process that produces an executable plan, with scope and level of effort, in days. Your architecture instincts have to be right at speed, and honest about uncertainty when they cannot be.
  • Security and compliance as design inputs. Zero Trust alignment, accessibility, data protection, and authorization evidence get engineered into your designs from the first diagram, because retrofitting them is how federal programs lose months.
  • The architecture bar for the program. Run design reviews, mentor engineers and analysts on architectural thinking, document the standards, and hold the line on them, including against pressure from delivery deadlines.

AI-Native Architecture

AI is part of how PhoenixTeam works, and this role has more to gain from it than most.

We are looking for someone who already uses tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, or comparable AI tools, as a working part of their practice. For an architect on this program, the leverage looks like: analyzing legacy code and data structures to recover business rules that exist nowhere else, accelerating the production of data models, interface specifications, and architecture documentation, pressure-testing designs against edge cases before development finds them, and prototyping integration patterns in hours instead of weeks.

You will also help decide where AI belongs inside the solutions themselves, and where it does not, given federal security, data, and authorization boundaries.

Two things anchor all of it. Judgment stays human: you know when AI output is wrong, incomplete, or inappropriate for a federal system of record, and you review accordingly. And boundaries are non-negotiable: federal environments govern what tools may touch government code, systems, and data. Use AI wherever it creates leverage, and understand the security, data, privacy, and authorization boundaries governing where and how it can be used.

What Great Looks Like

Twelve months in, we would expect to see:

  1. The program has one architecture, and people use it. Your target-state model is the reference for customer decisions, intake sizing, and development sequencing, and it stays current as reality moves.
  2. Solution packages flow into development without rework. Designs carry full traceability, teams build from them directly, and re-litigation of settled architecture decisions has become rare.
  3. Legacy knowledge is captured, not trapped. Business rules that lived only in old code and long memories are documented, validated with the customer, and reflected in the modern designs, with AI-assisted analysis doing real work in the extraction.
  4. The data bridge is boring. Legacy and modern platforms stay consistent through the transition, migrations prove out with real conversions, and no one fears the bridging layer.
  5. The custom-code footprint stayed small. Configuration-first held under pressure, and every exception has a documented, defensible reason.
  6. Industry integrations ship clean. Lender and servicer exchanges deploy with resilience and monitoring designed in, and partner onboarding does not require heroics.
  7. The customer treats you as a trusted advisor. Architecture decisions that once took quarters now take days, because the customer trusts the reasoning behind your recommendations.
  8. The team thinks architecturally. Engineers and analysts you have mentored make better design decisions without you in the room.

What You Bring

We care about evidence more than resumes. Expect us to ask which platforms you have architected, which mortgage workflows you know cold, what a design of yours looked like two years into production, and how AI functions in your practice today.

  • Deep mortgage domain expertise. This is required. You know the loan lifecycle from origination through servicing, loss mitigation, and claims, and you understand the data, the regulatory pressure points, and the industry participants at each stage. We will not teach you mortgage. We will expect you to teach us things.
  • The dual perspective. The strongest candidates have seen mortgage from the commercial side, in lender, servicer, or vendor technology, and from the federal housing agency side, where guaranty, insurance, and oversight programs set the rules industry builds to. If you have both, say so early and loudly. If you have one deeply and genuine fluency in the other, we want to talk.
  • Enterprise and solution architecture track record. You have owned target-state architectures, designed complex integrations and data migrations, and produced design artifacts that real teams built real systems from. You are fluent across application, data, and integration architecture, not just one.
  • Federal delivery credibility. You have designed within regulated federal environments, or delivered technology to federal housing programs, and you treat authorization, security controls, accessibility, and documentation requirements as design constraints rather than obstacles.
  • Legacy modernization scars. You have decomposed an aging system, extracted its rules, and sequenced its replacement while it stayed in production. You know which parts of that go wrong and how to see them coming.
  • Demonstrated AI-in-the-loop practice. You can show us, concretely, how AI tools accelerate your architecture and analysis work today.
  • Communication that spans the room. You can translate statute and policy into architecture for engineers, and architecture into consequences for executives and program officials, in the same meeting.
  • Judgment under ambiguity. You commit to defensible designs on incomplete information, document your assumptions, and revise without ego when the facts change.

  • U.S.-based, and able to obtain and maintain a federal Public Trust clearance.

We do not screen on degrees or year counts. If your evidence is strong, we want to talk.

Helpful, Not Required

  • Salesforce platform architecture experience, or architecture on a comparable configuration-first enterprise platform. A strong architect can learn the platform. The domain is the hard part.
  • Hands-on work with MISMO dataset versioning, URLA, or other mortgage data standards implementations.
  • Experience with VA loan guaranty, FHA, USDA rural housing, or GSE programs and systems.
  • Serverless architecture in AWS GovCloud or similar government cloud environments.
  • Prior support of authorization packages, Zero Trust initiatives, or federal data governance programs.

Leadership Expectations

This role leads through architecture, and that is real leadership, not a consolation prize.

You own technical direction that dozens of engineers execute against. You chair design reviews, set and enforce architecture standards, and mentor the people around you into stronger design thinkers. You work directly with federal customers and program decision-makers, which means presenting hard tradeoffs plainly, defending recommendations with evidence, and respectfully challenging direction that will hurt the program, including ours. Silent disagreement is a failure mode here.

When requirements are ambiguous, and in a modernization of this age and scale they often are, you make the call, document the reasoning, and own the outcome.

You'll Probably Love This Role If...

You are the architect who gets pulled into every mortgage conversation because you actually understand the business, not just the systems. You find a 20-year-old loan platform fascinating rather than frightening, because you know its rules encode decisions someone needs to understand before they can be replaced. You want your designs built within weeks, not filed within binders. You like the customer in the room. And you have already made AI a working part of your practice, because analyzing legacy systems by hand stopped making sense to you a while ago.

This May Not Be the Role for You If...

We would rather you self-select now than be unhappy in month three. You may struggle here if you:

  • Know architecture but not mortgage and hoped to learn the domain on the job.
  • Prefer producing architecture documents to being accountable for what gets built from them.
  • Need requirements fully settled before you can commit to a design direction.
  • Default to custom code when configuration would do.
  • Avoid challenging technical or program decisions, especially with customers.
  • Treat security, accessibility, and compliance as someone else's design problem.
  • View AI as a novelty rather than a working capability.
  • Stopped learning when you became senior.

None of that makes someone a bad architect. It makes them a bad fit for this particular job.

Why PhoenixTeam

  • You will be among people who speak your language. PhoenixTeam is a woman-owned small business founded and led by housing finance technologists who still do the work. Our teams have spent years embedded inside federal housing programs, from loan guaranty to rural housing lending to mortgage insurance, with real depth in origination, servicing, loss mitigation, and the data standards underneath them. Your domain expertise will be recognized here, not explained here.
  • Your architecture has visible consequences. This is the defining technical role on a major federal modernization where designs are built, deployed, and measured monthly. Impact is not hypothetical here.
  • Direct customer access. You work with federal decision-makers yourself. Your technical judgment reaches the people who act on it, without three layers of translation in between.
  • You set the direction. You are defining the target architecture for this program, not inheriting someone else's and annotating it.
  • AI-native is practice, not positioning. AI is part of how PhoenixTeam delivers, and we fund ongoing AI education and development for the entire team. In this role you will build on that investment, not fight for permission to use it.
  • Fully remote.
  • Competitive salary and 100% employer-paid medical insurance.
  • Mission you can explain at dinner. The platform you architect supports a home loan benefit for the people who served this country.

Position Requirements

  • Full-time W-2 employment with PhoenixTeam.
  • Must be based in the United States.
  • Fully remote.
  • Work supports a federal civilian agency.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required federal Public Trust clearance. A Secret clearance is not required.
  • Deep mortgage industry domain expertise is required for this position.

PhoenixTeam is a woman-owned small business focused on federal and commercial housing finance technology.

jobs.description:
We’re currently looking for artists who can join us within the next few weeks and bring strong expertise in high-end photorealistic effects. The contract is expected to run through the end of March 2027. For this specific project, we’re primarily considering candidates based in North America or Europe.

The FX Artist designs and creates complex visual simulations such as fire, smoke, fluids, destructions, and abstract effects, while respecting Rodeo FX’s artistic and technical standards. Integrated at the heart of the 3D pipeline, they collaborate closely with the FX and CG supervision teams, as well as with other departments, to deliver photorealistic, dynamic, and technically solid shots. Their creativity, precision, and mastery of procedural tools allow them to effectively translate the project's visual intentions.

Main responsibilities:

Mastery of his craft

  • Produce complex simulations (smoke, fire, explosions, liquids, destruction, magical or abstract effects) while respecting artistic and technical guidelines.
  • Use Houdini effectively (Pyro, Flip, RBD, Vellum, SOPs) to generate optimized and adaptable effects.
  • Maintain a high level of autonomy in the management of assigned FX tasks, from initial setup to final rendering.
  • Ensure rigorous quality control of its files, caches and workfiles before any submission.

Creative quality

  • Propose simple, effective artistic solutions aligned with the vision of the project.
  • Actively participate in dailies and integrate feedback constructively.
  • Adapt the effects to the narrative needs, visual style and pace of the scene.
  • Improve shooting by adding creative value to simulations.

Technical quality

  • Ensure cache optimization, setup stability and compliance with internal technical conventions.
  • Quickly identify technical problems and provide functional solutions.
  • Collaborate with the Pipeline team to integrate or test new tools as needed by the project.
  • Check the compatibility of effects with other departments (layout, lighting, comp).

Communication

  • Provide realistic estimates, communicate quickly if there are difficulties or risks of delay, and collaborate with production to adjust priorities if necessary.
  • Maintain a fluid and respectful exchange with production, leads and artists from other disciplines.
  • Communicate clearly about issues, deadlines, needs or technical limitations.
  • Actively participate in turnovers, briefings or progress monitoring with the project team.

Learn, transmit and evolve

  • Stay up to date with the latest practices, techniques and references in visual effects.
  • Share your knowledge, tools or techniques with your colleagues.
  • Participate in documenting or improving the working methods of the FX department.
  • Welcome feedback with openness with a view to continuous progress.
  • Previous experience in FX in a VFX studio (10 years minimum recommended).
  • Excellent command of Houdini (Pyro, Flip, RBD, Vellum, SOPs).
  • Basic knowledge of compositing (Nuke) and rendering (Arnold and Karma).
  • Knowledge of USD and Solaris.
  • Good sense of movement, physics and visual rhythm.
  • Rigor, autonomy, attention to detail, team spirit.
  • Asset: knowledge of Flow Production Tracking, experience in developing Houdini tools, Python or VEX scripts.

We’re currently looking for artists who can join us within the next few weeks and bring strong expertise in high-end photorealistic effects. The contract is expected to run through the end of March 2027. For this specific project, we’re primarily considering candidates based in North America or Europe.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Rodeo FX, diversity is a core value. We’re committed to creating an inclusive, equitable workplace where different perspectives are embraced. Every team member brings unique insight that strengthens our creativity, challenges our thinking, and helps us deliver better work.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment

Rodeo FX may use AI-based tools to support certain steps of the recruitment process, such as interview transcription or preliminary application analysis. These tools may be operated by third-party providers, and data may be processed outside Quebec. These tools never replace human decision-making: all final hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team and hiring managers. To learn more about how we protect your personal information and your rights, please consult our Privacy Policy.

Apply with LinkedIn

If you would like to use the “Apply with LinkedIn” feature to simplify your application, please make sure you accept cookies on the SmartRecruiters application page. This allows the feature to display and function properly.

Repeatedly voted one of Montreal’s Top Employers and Employer of the Year for the 2022 Mercuriades Awards, Rodeo FX is a high-end creative company offering services in visual effects, advertising, animation, and experiential.

Nominated for multiple Emmy® Awards for its work on the series Stranger Things season 4, The Witcher season 2 and The Lord of The Rings: The Rings of Power season 1, the independent, Oscar®-winning company boasts close to 900 artists crafting from studios in Montreal, Québec City, Toronto, Los Angeles and Paris.

Rodeo FX is a creative partner to the world’s best storytellers including Netflix, HBO, Disney, Marvel, Amazon Studios, Warner Bros. and Sony, and has collaborated on ads for YouTube, NBC and Apple. Current projects include Blue Beetle, Monarch: Legacy of Monsters, and Zack Snyder's Rebel Moon. Recently released projects include John Wick: Chapter 4, Black Adam, Disney's The Little Mermaid and Love, Death and Robots Volume 3, for which the company won a 2023 VES award.

Access Specialist II - Metabolic - East

Company: Cycle Vita

Location: This is a remote position, but candidates will be located in Eastern time zone

The opportunity

Are you ready to become the trusted expert that patients and healthcare providers turn to for guidance on access, affordability, and solutions?

Cycle Pharmaceuticals is recruiting for an Access Specialist II within our Metabolic team where you'll be supporting our patients and healthcare professionals every step of the way.

As an Access Specialist II, you’ll be at the forefront of delivering timely, accurate and compassionate support to both patients and healthcare providers. You’ll be responsible for communicating directly with patients and healthcare professionals to provide benefit summaries, verify insurance coverage, obtain prior authorizations and support appeals processes. As part of your role, you’ll make sure patients are referred to the right resources like educational tools and nursing support to help them feel confident with their care journey.

Our Company

At Cycle, we believe that Every Single Patient Matters. This is at the heart of why we work and were looking for people to join our team who share our vision. We know that life-changing treatments need life-improving product support to match, because when you put the two together, great things can happen.

Our core focus areas include rare metabolic, immunological, and neurological genetic conditions and oncology. We improve existing drugs, repurpose them for new uses, and bring generics back to market. Using cutting-edge drug delivery technologies, we enhance the efficiency of treatments, offering patients greater freedom and choice.

Headquartered in Cambridge, UK, with a significant US presence, Cycle has scaled rapidly and was named one of the UK’s fastest-growing private companies by The Sunday Times (Sunday Times 100 2024 & Sunday Times 100 Tech 2025). If you want to know more about what we do then, why not check out our website and take a look at some of our patient stories: Patient Stories - Cycle Pharma

What you will be doing:

  • Obtain insurance verification and benefits from insurance companies and leveraging additional sources such as insurance carrier websites.
  • Ensure that all documents and information are up to date and correct in the system.
  • Prepare benefit summaries and deliver this information to Health Care Professionals and Patients via phone, fax, email, and letters.
  • Educate Health Care Providers and Staff regarding prior authorization and appeals process & documentation including highly specific, payer-based requirements.
  • Supply all necessary prior authorization requirements to Health Care Professionals based on the insurance company’s requirements, following Cycle Pharma’s Compliance SOPs and regulatory guidance.
  • Support patient’s needs for alternate funding scenarios including free drug and copay and enrolling appropriate patients.
  • Triage orders to Specialty Pharmacies including follow-up calls/emails to gain knowledge of the status of those orders.
  • Assist with answering any incoming telephone calls or emails within the shared inbox.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships with patients, caregivers, insurers, and colleagues to promote service excellence and teamwork at Cycle Pharma.
  • Work closely with the Clinical Education Managers and support with any other duties as required

Skills and experience that will help you to succeed in this position:

  • Prior experience within the field of health sciences.
  • Proven experience in Benefit Investigations and Prior Authorization processes, with a strong understanding of industry documentation standards.
  • Strong knowledge within Copay and Free Drug Assistance Programs within the Healthcare or Pharmaceutical industry.
  • Proficient in using CRM systems (Customer relationship management) such as SalesForce, Veeva or Microsoft Dynamics.
  • Familiar with operating in highly regulated environments, ensuring full compliance with industry policies and procedures.
  • Prior reimbursement experience with ability to communicate complex reimbursement scenarios to patients and medical professionals.
  • Strong background in case management and coordinating with patient support services.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to plan, prioritize and meet deadlines effectively.
  • Positive, relationship-focused mindset, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Willing and able to travel up to 50%, including visits to healthcare providers, specialty pharmacies, and company headquarters in the UK for training and business reviews.

Desirable skills but by no means essential:

  • Experienced in working in biotech/pharmaceutical industry for a drug manufacturer or Hub Services provider
  • Rare disease experience

What can we offer to you

This role will be homebased but some travel, up to 50% of the time, to attend team meetings or support patient activities may be required. We have an agile work policy which allows employees flexibility to set their schedule and plan their day to meet the business needs.

In addition to being part of a great team and doing things that will make a real difference to patients’ lives, you will enjoy all the benefits that brings:

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • A collaborative high performing work environment
  • Performance based bonus
  • Opportunity to join a fast growing and ambitious business
  • 100% employer paid membership for Private Health Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • 401k plan

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, gender, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. As part of Manos Software, a Valsoft operating group, Dispatch combines the focus and agility of a specialized software company with the long-term support of a global vertical SaaS organization. We’re investing in our product, our customers, and our team with a focus on sustainable, profitable growth.

We're now investing in a dedicated marketing function to match the strength of our product and customer base, and we're hiring our first Director of Demand Generation to build it.

THE ROLE:

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Director of Demand Generation will own demand generation for Dispatch and Youreka, reshaping what marketing means for the company and our products. This role also owns our Business Development Representative team's strategy and targets, working primarily through our existing BDR team lead. This is a hands-on, builder role: you'll set strategy and run campaigns yourself in the early days, then pursue growth within the marketing team as the function proves out.

AS THE DIRECTOR OF DEMAND GENERATION, YOU WILL:

  • Demand generation & growth - assess Dispatch's situation from first principles to determine where marketing should focus (paid acquisition, lifecycle/email, organic, and other channels); own the marketing automation and CRM stack; generate and manage a healthy, measurable pipeline in close partnership with sales. Building this out is the top priority for this role.
  • Product-market fit & positioning — identify, through testing and analysis, which segments, use cases, and messages actually convert; use that to sharpen demand-gen targeting and messaging, and share findings with our Product Marketing team to inform their formal positioning work.
  • Content — build a content engine (website copy, case studies, thought leadership) that supports demand generation and conversion.
  • Team leadership - own strategy and targets for our BDR team, working closely with the existing Lead BDR and aligning team output with the broader demand generation strategy. You will also manage an existing marketing team resource and help define future role additions over time.
  • Diagnose marketing channel mix for Dispatch’s products - prioritizing investment accordingly.
  • Establish the processes, reporting, and KPIs the function will run on.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

  • 5–10 years of marketing experience including specific focus on demand generation and program definition.
  • A startup-tested operator - comfortable being hands-on and building programs with limited resources, not just directing an existing team.
  • A proven track record of owning a marketing function or team from an early stage.
  • Proven, hands-on experience managing a demand-generation/marketing function is required. Experience managing a team on a sales-style comp plan - such as a BDR, SDR, or inside-sales function - is a plus.
  • An analytical, first-principles thinker who can diagnose which channels and tactics actually drive results for a given business, rather than defaulting to a standard playbook - we're counting on you to help define our ideal marketing mix, not just execute one.
  • A strong written communicator who can turn technical or operational product value into compelling brand and content narratives.
  • B2B SaaS experience preferred; experience in field service, home services, or enterprise software is a plus.

WITHIN THE FIRST SIX MONTHS, YOU WILL:

  • Build a functioning marketing engine - team, tools, and process, revamped from a lean starting point and working closely with our Senior Marketing Manager.
  • Define a clear, data-backed point of view on where Dispatch should focus its marketing investment, measurable pipeline/revenue contribution from marketing, and BDR-driven programs.
  • Develop sharper product positioning and messaging along with marketing support delivered for major product launches and market expansions.
  • Be viewed internally and externally as a strategic leader for Dispatch’s growth functions.

SALARY:

The base salary range for this role is between $160,000 - $170,000 annually. Actual pay within the range is influenced by multiple factors, including but not limited to skill set, residence location, and prior work experience. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual bonus and benefits.

LOCATION:

Dispatch fully accommodates remote work, as long as you have a permanent residence in the US and reside in one of our registered states. Want to spend a month in Italy? Great, do it! Live in Idaho? Sweet, we have another team member there! As long as you are crushing your goals and helping us drive the business forward, you do you. We also have an office in Boston that is open and available for you to use.

WE HAVE:

  • An amazing team focused on innovating and improving every day
  • Room for growth and an emphasis on talent development, including a professional development reimbursement program
  • A fun, casual team environment with co-workers who will make you feel like an important part of our team, engage you in developing new solutions to challenging problems, and help you leverage your strengths
  • A generous medical, dental, and vision package with 90% covered by us
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Company-sponsored life insurance coverage, short-term disability, and long-term disability
  • Additional perks including a wellness and adventure fund, as well as monthly personal Uber credits
  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO), 9 company holidays, and a flexible work schedule

STILL WITH US?

We’re ready to meet you if you wake up every day excited to build strategic customer partnerships, lead complex commercial conversations, and find new ways to grow the impact Dispatch has within our customers.

Not a fit? Keep an eye on our Careers Page for other positions!

  • Monitor and implement reimbursement policies - Identify and track updates and changes to government policies (Medicare, etc.) as well as policy changes by other healthcare stakeholders including private payers and the AMA that could impact coding, coverage, and payment for medical device companies. Incorporate new policies into reimbursement support initiatives when appropriate.
  • Represent Fortrea to device industry and other organizations - Develop education material for presentations to medical device trade associations, startup incubators, investment groups, etc. via webinars, podcasts, in-person presentations and other means to promote Fortrea’s health economic and reimbursement expertise and capabilities.

Assist in the general marketing of opportunities for the regulatory and clinical groups within Fortrea Medical Device and Diagnostics and serve as a strategic consultant to staff and management as needed.

Commercial Acumen:

  • Has a good understanding of the industry, market and our clients and presents Fortrea’s reimbursement and health economics capabilities to clients.

  • Helps to develop and lead high quality end-to-end business development strategies, including RFI/RFP response, proposal, or work order development, bid defense preparation and presentations.
  • Partners with the BDD to drive more wins by customizing our proposal based on the customers’ needs and competitive landscape.
  • Drives end to end proposal operational strategy across the opportunity, leveraging our “Why Fortrea” messaging and differentiators.
  • Owns the strategy build and content for proposals.
  • Consults with internal SMEs and functional areas as appropriate.
  • Develops, attends, and may lead BDMs (complex opportunities/strategy).

Leadership:

  • Engages with Fortrea’s leadership to help drive and implement initiatives, including cross business area and functional integrated opportunities, to grow and expand the business.
  • Helps to define and implement the MDD vision and strategy; translates this into key initiatives and priorities; develops and delivers against objectives/plans; able to achieve results in a global, virtual, and complex environment; tracks and measures progress.
  • Partners with peers ensuring consistency (quality, standards, policies, processes, and practices) across the MDD business.
  • Effectively leads in a global, complex environment; sets clear expectations; coaches and mentors for success; consistently communicates and connects; fosters a continuous learning environment.
  • If manager, attracts, selects, on-boards, develops, and retains high performing talent; strengthens and deepens talent bench and succession.
  • Operational Leadership and Financial Acumen:
  • Leads portfolio growth and delivery, encompassing consistent quality.
  • Ensures allocated resources are aligned with current and projected work in terms of capability, quantity, timing, efficiency.
  • Part ownership for the success of the MDD business, including achieving objectives/metrics as assigned. These may include number of new client capability discussions resulting in RFP or proposal, opportunities closed, win %, etc.

Subject Matter Expertise:

  • Contributes to MDD commercial, operational, reimbursement and scientific leadership and direction, leveraging expertise from other functions as required.
  • Participates in training opportunities to advance knowledge MDD including new areas as MDD leadership sees fit, regulatory changes, GCP, etc.
  • Serves as a senior, strategic consultant to Fortrea clients and Fortrea staff.
  • Provides relevant strategic reimbursement counsel to MDD clients and project teams.
  • Prepares clients, sites, and MDD teams for regulatory inspections; participates in regulatory inspections for clients and MDD projects.
  • Provides leadership as an executive lead and senior principal advisor to clients and MDD teams.

  • All other duties as needed or assigned.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • The Senior Principal Advisor typically holds a graduate or post graduate degree in a relevant discipline including but not limited to business administration, public health, public policy, law, clinical science, health services research and health economics.

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • The Senior Principal Advisor has extensive experience developing and executing reimbursement strategies within the medical device industry or as a consultant at Fortrea or in a similar environment and meets the performance criteria outlined by the Firm.

Preferred Qualifications Include:

  • Related work experience of at least 12 years is preferred.

Physical Demands/Work Environment:

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

At Mozilla, our Release Engineering team (RelEng) plays a crucial role in ensuring the seamless and reliable delivery of our world-class software products. As a key part of our engineering infrastructure, RelEng is responsible for the continuous deployment of our products, ensuring they reach our users efficiently and without interruption. For instance, we can reliably ship a security fix to > 200M users across different platforms and > 100 locales in under 24 hours.

RelEng has an expertise in configuring and optimizing our build and deployment pipeline. In order to provide a faster and more reliable experience for Firefox developers, RelEng is looking for an engineer who can help optimize and maintain the pipeline.

If you are passionate about release automation, the Release Engineering team at Mozilla is the place for you. Join us and be a part of a team that is making a significant impact on the web and beyond.

What you’ll do:

  • Write software that scales - tens of thousands of tasks are run to build, test, and release Firefox every single day
  • Collaborate with senior+ engineers to improve the developers’ experience, then implement the improvements.

  • Collaborate with others by requesting and providing code reviews
  • Respond to critical service outages (during normal working hours - no on call rotation is required)

What you’ll bring:

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in computer science (or related programs) or equivalent work experience
  • You have a minimum of 2 years of experience working in an object-oriented programming (OOP) language (preferably Python)

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

jobs.description:
DIGITAL MARKETING SPECIALIST

Location: Remote – anywhere in Canada

POSITION SUMMARY

Northerm Windows & Doors, based in Whitehorse, Yukon, and Capitol Glass, based in Anchorage, Alaska, are established manufacturers and suppliers of window, door and architectural glass products designed for demanding northern environments. As part of RAB Energy Group and the broader Dakwakada Capital Investments portfolio, the companies are focused on expanding their markets, strengthening their brands and modernizing how they connect with residential, commercial and institutional customers, including the launch of a comprehensive and sustained digital marketing program.

The Digital Marketing Specialist is a hands-on role responsible for developing, implementing and managing the companies' digital marketing programs across Canada and Alaska. Working closely with the President and business leaders, the Specialist will translate sales and growth objectives into practical digital campaigns that increase brand awareness, generate qualified leads and support revenue growth.

This is not simply a social media role. The successful candidate will have practical experience across the digital marketing ecosystem, including paid search, paid social, organic social media, search engine optimization, digital advertising, website content and optimization, analytics, campaign development and emerging AI-enabled marketing tools.

The Digital Marketing Specialist will be expected to do the work — developing campaigns, creating content, establishing and managing advertising accounts, placing digital advertising, monitoring performance, managing social media channels and continuously adjusting activity based on results. It is expected that some campaign execution work will be contracted to third-parties.

The initial focus will be on Northerm Windows & Doors and Capitol Glass. As the digital marketing programs for these businesses become established, the position will also provide digital marketing support to other companies within the Dakwakada Capital Investments portfolio.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Digital Marketing Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Work with business leadership to develop practical digital marketing strategies aligned with sales objectives, target markets, product priorities and growth opportunities.
  • Develop and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across appropriate channels, including Google, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
  • Establish campaign structures, audiences, geographic targeting, messaging, budgets and performance objectives.
  • Set up and directly manage advertising accounts, campaigns and commercial arrangements with digital advertising platforms.
  • Develop paid search, display, retargeting and paid social campaigns designed to generate qualified customer inquiries and sales leads.
  • Coordinate digital campaigns with seasonal sales activity, product launches, geographic expansion and other business-development initiatives.
  • Continuously test and refine campaigns, creative content, messaging and audience targeting to improve performance and return on marketing investment.

Social Media & Content

  • Manage the day-to-day social media presence across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok and other appropriate platforms.
  • Develop and maintain content calendars that support brand awareness, customer engagement, recruitment, product promotion and sales objectives.
  • Create engaging written, photographic, graphic and short-form video content appropriate to each platform and audience.
  • Develop content highlighting products, completed projects, employees, customers, community involvement and the unique requirements of building in northern environments.
  • Monitor social media engagement and ensure comments, inquiries and messages are responded to or appropriately directed within the organization.
  • Proactively monitor and engage with relevant social media accounts, conversations and content based on geography, hashtags, industry sectors, community interests and target customer profiles, identifying appropriate opportunities to contribute thoughtful, authentic comments that build brand awareness, demonstrate expertise and create natural connections to Northerm and Capitol Glass products and services.
  • Maintain consistent brand identity, voice and messaging across digital channels.

AI & Creative Content Development

  • Effectively use generative AI and other emerging marketing technologies to support content creation, campaign development, market research, image creation and enhancement, audience targeting and marketing productivity.
  • Create and edit digital marketing materials using Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva or comparable graphic design and content-creation platforms, including AI platforms.
  • Use AI responsibly as a productivity and creative tool while maintaining appropriate human oversight, brand standards, accuracy and originality.
  • Remain current with emerging digital marketing technologies, platforms and practices and identify practical opportunities to introduce them into the business.

Website, Search & Digital Presence

  • Support the modernization and ongoing development of Northerm and Capitol Glass websites, working with external specialists where appropriate.
  • Coordinate website content, structure, customer journeys and calls to action to improve customer experience and lead generation.
  • Develop and maintain website content to ensure product, service and company information remains current and relevant.
  • Improve organic search visibility through practical search engine optimization (SEO) strategies, working directly and through third-party vendors.
  • Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles and other online business listings.
  • Support online reputation management, including monitoring reviews and coordinating appropriate responses.
  • Identify opportunities to improve digital lead capture, quote requests and conversion from website traffic.

Analytics & Performance

  • Establish appropriate digital marketing metrics and reporting to measure campaign effectiveness, lead generation and return on marketing investment.
  • Use tools such as Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Business Suite and other platform analytics to monitor customer behaviour and campaign performance.
  • Track digital marketing activity from impressions and engagement through to inquiries, quote requests and, where practical, completed sales.
  • Provide regular, concise reporting to business leadership identifying results, trends, opportunities and recommended adjustments.
  • Use data and analytics to continually improve campaign effectiveness and allocation of marketing resources.

Portfolio Support

  • Once the Northerm and Capitol Glass digital marketing programs are established, provide digital marketing expertise and execution support to other Dakwakada Capital Investments portfolio companies.
  • Work with individual business leaders to understand their markets, customers and sales objectives and adapt digital marketing approaches accordingly.
  • Help establish consistent digital marketing practices, tools and performance measurement across participating portfolio companies while maintaining the individual identity and market positioning of each business.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Post-secondary education in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, Business or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on digital marketing experience, preferably within a business-to-consumer and/or business-to-business environment.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and directly managing paid digital advertising campaigns, including Google Ads and Meta advertising platforms, and managing third-party performance agencies.
  • Strong understanding of paid search, paid social, organic social media, SEO, audience targeting, retargeting and digital lead generation.
  • Experience managing business social media accounts across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok.
  • Demonstrated ability to create effective written and visual marketing content.
  • Practical experience using Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva or comparable creative software, as well as emerging AI tools and platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience using generative AI tools for marketing, content development, image creation and productivity.
  • Working knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Business Profile and digital campaign measurement.
  • Experience supporting website development, modernization or ongoing website management.
  • Experience within manufacturing, construction, building products, home improvement or another considered-purchase environment would be an asset.
  • Experience marketing to customers in both Canada and the United States would be an asset.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES

The successful candidate will be:

  • Hands-on and execution focused – comfortable moving from strategy to actually building the campaign, creating the content, placing the advertising and analyzing the results.
  • Creative – able to develop compelling ideas, messaging and visual content that differentiate established brands in competitive markets.
  • Commercially minded – understands that marketing exists to support business growth and can connect digital activity to customer inquiries, sales opportunities and revenue.
  • Analytical – comfortable using data to evaluate performance, identify trends and make informed decisions about where marketing resources should be invested.
  • Technically capable – confident learning and working across digital advertising platforms, analytics tools, content-creation software and emerging AI technologies.
  • Organized and self-directed – capable of independently managing multiple campaigns, platforms, brands and priorities in a remote working environment.
  • Collaborative – able to work effectively with business leaders, sales teams, operational employees and external service providers.
  • Curious and adaptable – interested in emerging technologies and continually looking for better ways to reach customers and improve marketing effectiveness.
  • A strong communicator – able to translate business objectives into effective marketing messages and communicate results clearly to non-marketing leaders.

WORKING CONDITIONS

This is a full-time remote position and may be performed from anywhere in Canada, subject to appropriate working-hour availability to support operations in Yukon and Alaska.

The position will work closely with the President of RAB Energy Group and leadership teams at Northerm Windows & Doors and Capitol Glass. Travel to Whitehorse, Anchorage or other portfolio-company locations is expected to be infrequent and only where there is a specific business requirement.

As the role evolves, priorities and the allocation of time between Northerm, Capitol Glass and other Dakwakada Capital Investments portfolio companies may change based on business needs.

As a 100% First Nation-owned business, we strongly encourage submissions from qualified First Nations, Metis and Inuit Peoples.

While we thank and appreciate all applicants, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

No phone calls or agencies, please.

Salary: $80,000 - $95,000

About This Role

As a Solution Architect at Stitch, you'll be responsible for gathering and analyzing technical requirements to ensure seamless integration of Braze and partner technologies within our clients’ marketing technology stacks. You'll develop detailed functional design specifications, outlining workflows and user journeys that align with business goals. You'll also design and implement scalable, end-to-end solutions that support personalized customer experiences, managing complex data structures, user attributes, and event tracking. Additionally, you'll leverage Braze’s segmentation tools to create dynamic audience segments, while crafting multi-channel campaign flows using Braze’s Canvas tool to drive customer engagement through automated messaging and real-time interactions.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with other Stitchers on the Delivery team, including Business Strategists, Marketing Strategist, and Technical Producers (email developers) to gather and analyze technical requirements, ensuring Braze and partner technologies are optimally configured within the customer’s existing martech stack
  • Provide detailed documentation, define integration points, and ensure seamless data flow across platforms.

  • Design and implement end-to-end solutions that bridge the gap between business objectives and technical execution. You'll ensure the architecture is robust, scalable, and tailored to meet specific customer needs while integrating seamlessly with the broader technology ecosystem
  • Build and manage complex data structures, including user attributes and events, to support personalized customer experiences. You'll define how customer interactions and behaviors are tracked and leveraged to enhance engagement strategies
  • Utilize Braze’s segmentation tools to design dynamic and static audience segments based on user behaviors, preferences, and lifecycle stages. You'll ensure that segments are leveraged effectively for targeted messaging and personalized campaign experiences
  • Design and implement sophisticated campaign flows using Braze’s Canvas tool, incorporating multi-step, multi-channel journeys that drive customer engagement. You’ll develop logic to automate actions, such as messaging triggers and conditions, based on real-time customer interactions and behaviors
  • Bring new ideas, recommendations, and solution write-ups to other Solution Architects directly, within projects, or during office hours

Application Security Engineer

Parallels is seeking a highly motivated and talented Application Security Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will make security decisions that impact millions of our customers while gaining hands-on experience in exploit development and CVE discovery. The ideal candidate will combine an attacker mindset with the humility and detail-oriented attitude required to coordinate fixes and security architecting with busy engineers.

Your primary responsibility will be to coordinate with more senior members of our team to write exploits and design fixes for existing application vulnerabilities. You will also help search for new critical/high risk vulnerabilities in our codebase. In addition, you will assist in vulnerability disclosure processes and help implement repeatable secure development practices.

As issues are uncovered, you will communicate with the appropriate technical and leadership teams to ensure a focus on risk mitigation – allowing for business continuity, but without negligent risk. Application security engineers are constantly assessing applications for weaknesses and finding resolutions before they can be abused.

Parallels: anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity.Why Parallels, why now?

The top creative and technical minds could sell anywhere. So why are so many choosing Parallels? Three reasons:

This is the moment.It's an exciting time at Parallels — strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to how the world works. The EUC market is shifting fast, and we're at the front of that wave. We want you riding it with us.

We want you to be you.Too many companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Ours is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe being who you are, taking risks, and showing us what you've got.

It's your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it — not all of it. At Parallels, we're serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. Happy sellers mean happy customers. That's why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let's talk about the role

What you'll do:

  • Reproduce and triage incoming vulnerabilities from security automation/bug bounty programs, then propose granular fixes to engineers
  • Discover vulnerabilities and construct exploits for core Parallels applications such as Parallels Remote Application Server
  • Assist in the CVE disclosure process
  • Provide threat models and design reviews for teams throughout the company
  • Assist in tuning existing static analysis, dynamic analysis, and dependency management tools

Desired Qualities:

  • An attacker mindset: engineers will often want proof before fixes are implemented
  • Eagerness to learn – you are not expected to know everything coming in, but you should continuously learn new techniques on the job
  • The ability to communicate clearly, acknowledge mistakes, and disagree when necessary
  • Demonstrable passion for offensive security
  • Experience reading, writing and debugging C++ and Python code
  • Basic experience with memory exploitation techniques
  • Demonstrable experience with web exploitation techniques and tools (e.g. PortSwigger lab scoreboards)
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • BSc/MS in computer science or a related field
  • Previous CVEs in desktop applications
  • Proficiency with reverse engineering tools
  • Significant experience in memory exploitation techniques (e.g. gaining code execution from memory vulnerabilities in modern operating systems)
  • Familiarity with cloud security best practices
  • 3+ years of industry experience
  • OSCP/OSWE/OSED/RET2 certification

What are you waiting for? Apply now. We can't wait to meet you.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Maestro, an AI-native inventory-planning intelligence venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Maestro is an autopilot planning intelligence for SMB operators managing physical inventory complexity without a planning team. It connects across channels and ERPs, handles routine decisions silently, and surfaces exceptions with context and a recommended action before they become revenue losses. The institutional memory that today lives only in a planner's head gets externalized, structured, and queried in plain language.

We didn't just build a thesis; we validated it directly with the market. We have spoken with founders, VP E-Commerce leaders, merchandise planners, and multi-channel operators at DTC and specialty retail brands across the US. The market signal is clear:

  • Autopilot is the vision: Every named competitor generates recommendations that humans still have to act on manually. No product at this revenue tier is building toward full autonomous execution of the planning lifecycle. Maestro's product vision is full autopilot: the system owns the buy decision, allocation, and markdown trigger end-to-end. But buyers earn that trust incrementally, starting with routine decisions handled silently and exceptions surfaced with context.
  • The pain is in the dollars, not the dashboards: Documented annual losses across just five buyer accounts total $1.25–1.5M+. Buyers currently spend $0–500/month on software; the entire planning budget is tied up in headcount. The payback case is immediate, and ROI demonstration, not feature demos, will be the critical sales motion.
  • Institutional memory failure is systemic and unresolved: One SVP with 30 years of domain expertise described relying entirely on personal recall to flag which materials, colours, and styles underperformed last season. When he leaves, that knowledge disappears, and no tool captures it today. Every buyer interviewed described a version of this problem.

Market Context

We are targeting a large, structurally underserved segment: SMB operators managing multi-channel physical inventory complexity at $5M–50M revenue — importers, distributors, Amazon aggregators, and specialty retailers. The beachhead SAM is estimated at $200M–$225M across approximately 15K–16K brands in the US and Canada. Excel is the universal incumbent! 5/5 buyers in our discovery sprint were on spreadsheets, with zero dedicated planning tools in use. EBITDA across the $10–50M DTC cohort is compressed to 7.25% in 2025 with revenue declining ~4.6% YoY. Planning waste attacks the margin stack directly.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets
  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning
  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with VPs, operations managers, and merchandise planners at importers, distributors, and multi-channel retail brands, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion
  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement
  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company
  • Deep, operational exposure to merchandise planning, inventory management, and multi-channel retail operations

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

Marketing's effectiveness is increasingly determined by the systems behind it — the layer that orchestrates AI agents, the data they reason over, and the workflows of every marketing team. Autodesk is investing to build that capability for Worldwide Marketing, and this role leads it.

The Director, Marketing AI Orchestration is responsible for designing and building the AI orchestration layer that makes Worldwide Marketing (WWM) measurably more effective — and, over time, the data and AI substrate that sits beneath it. This is the connective tissue between AI capabilities, marketing data, our martech stack, and the work of every WWM function — and the foundation those capabilities run on.

This is a builder role. We're hiring a platform builder who understands marketing, not a marketer who is curious about AI. Success is shipped capability that drives measurable lift in marketing effectiveness — speed, quality, scale, and revenue. The job to be done is to architect and ship the AI orchestration layer, drive adoption across WWM functions, and establish the measurement framework.

Responsibilities

  • The WWM AI orchestration layer. Architect and build the platform that orchestrates AI agents, models, knowledge, and workflows across marketing. Define what runs autonomously, what is human-in-the-loop, and what stays human-led

  • Capability roadmap. Sequence what gets built based on impact to marketing effectiveness. Make build / buy / partner calls. Own the budget

  • Cross-function integration. Embed the layer into the workflows of every WWM function — Brand & Creative, Growth & Partner Marketing, Industry Portfolio Emerging Business Marketing, Digital Ecommerce, Acquisition & Performance Marketing, Education, Communications, and the new Small Business team. Adoption is engineered as part of the build, not bolted on after

  • Governance and trust. Build guardrails for brand safety, data privacy, IP, and responsible AI into the platform — as enforced behaviors in the system, not as policy documents

  • Partnerships. Represent marketing's interests in Autodesk's enterprise AI roadmap

Why Worldwide

From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

SUMMARY: Implement, configure, and maintain the pricing tools and automated systems used in the management and delivery of Commercial Solutions initiatives, meeting business and technical specifications by contributing at all stages of the software development life cycle. This role delivers specialized development and integration expertise including VBA, SQL, Power Query, API, and Microsoft Power Platform to advance the REBOOT Pricing Strategy, drive pricing tool modernization, and lead process automation efforts. The position is focused on strategic delivery and future-state modernization rather than legacy operational ticket support.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Tasks may include but are not limited to:

  • Ensure pricing tools and production systems function to meet service level agreements by analyzing and resolving issues, including implementing bug fixes in alignment with SOPs and established governance processes.
  • Design and implement software solutions to meet business requirements, including data integration, automation, monitoring, and reporting across a variety of platforms, tools, and languages (VBA, SQL, Power Query, API, Power Platform).
  • Lead the technical execution of pricing tool modernization and consolidation efforts in support of the REBOOT Pricing Strategy initiative.
  • Support the Project Manager and other functions with the production and review of specifications, plans, reports, and technical documentation throughout system development and support.
  • Review and translate User Requirements Specifications into technical designs appropriate for pricing tool and automation solutions.
  • Prepare, review, and approve design and integration documentation for pricing systems and cross-functional data flows.
  • Perform coding and configuration to meet delivery timelines, fulfill business and technical requirements, and align with SOPs.
  • Perform formal code reviews and informal unit testing to meet delivery timelines and maintain solution quality.
  • Complete Traceability Matrices and maintain audit-ready documentation as required.
  • Work closely with Strategic Finance, Proposal Management, Contracts, and Commercial Operations to define and coordinate integration processes between systems and vendors (e.g., Salesforce, Certinia).
  • Interact and communicate effectively with project teams in both technical and non-technical terms to determine requirements, configuration needs, and acceptance criteria.
  • Write and execute scripts as required to meet delivery timelines.
  • Support Test Analysts and business users during formal testing and quality review.
  • Perform QC checks of manual data edits and other tasks where required to protect data integrity.

jobs.description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Head of Customer Experience will define and execute Roofr's post-sale customer strategy, leading Customer Experience team.

This leader will be responsible for building a future-focused organization that leverages AI, automation, and digital-first experiences to accelerate customer time-to-value, improve retention, and deliver world-class customer experiences at scale.

Success in this role requires an operator who can balance strategy and tactical execution to build high-performing teams, optimize processes, and partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to continuously optimize the end-to-end customer journey and create a cohesive experience across every customer touchpoint.

What you’ll get to do:

Build the Future of Customer Experience

  • Develop and execute Roofr's Customer Experience strategy aligned with our Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Product-Led Sales (PLS) models.
  • Design a scalable customer journey that enables customers to achieve value quickly while creating a seamless experience across every customer touchpoint.
  • Establish a customer-first culture focused on simplicity, speed, and measurable customer outcomes.
  • Own the holistic customer experience across the post-sale lifecycle, identifying opportunities to improve the journey from onboarding through adoption, engagement, support, and retention.
  • Create a consistent experience across digital, self-service, and human-assisted interactions.

Lead Customer Operations

Provide leadership and/or support across:

  • Customer Support
  • Onboarding & Customer Success (Interim)
  • Customer Retention (Interim)

Develop leaders, build organizational capability, establish operational rhythms, and create clear performance metrics that drive accountability and continuous improvement.

Connect these functions into a cohesive Customer Experience organization, breaking down operational silos and ensuring customers experience a consistent journey regardless of how or where they engage with Roofr.

Drive AI & Automation

Champion the use of AI and automation to transform both the customer and employee experience.

Examples include:

  • AI-enabled customer support
  • Intelligent ticket routing and case management
  • Automated onboarding workflows
  • Digital customer education
  • Self-service knowledge management
  • Customer health monitoring
  • Predictive churn identification
  • AI-enhanced productivity tools for customer-facing teams
  • Automated journeys that guide customers toward activation, adoption, and expansion

Continuously evaluate emerging technologies that improve efficiency while maintaining a high-quality customer experience.

Improve Customer Outcomes

Own and improve key customer metrics, including:

  • Customer Retention
  • Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)
  • Customer Health
  • Time to Value
  • Product Adoption
  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
  • Net Promoter Score (NPS)
  • Support SLAs
  • Resolution Time

Use customer insights and data to identify friction, improve onboarding, increase product adoption, and strengthen long-term customer relationships.

Partner Cross-Functionally

Serve as the voice of the customer across the business by partnering closely with:

  • Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Finance
  • Translate customer feedback into actionable recommendations that influence product strategy, operational improvements, and customer experience initiatives.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to identify and address experience gaps within the product itself.
  • Bring a holistic view of customer behavior, needs, and friction points to cross-functional planning and prioritization.

Build for Scale

  • Develop scalable systems, processes, and operating models that support rapid company growth.
  • Create dashboards, forecasting models, workforce planning, and operational KPIs that provide visibility into customer performance and organizational health.
  • Connect customer behavior, product usage, support interactions, onboarding progress, and retention signals to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Build feedback loops that translate customer insights into improvements across people, processes, product, and technology.

Drive Holistic Customer Journey Optimization

  • Map and measure key customer journeys to understand where customers experience friction, where they derive value, and where Roofr can proactively improve the experience.
  • Prioritize journey improvements based on customer impact, business value, and scalability.
  • Establish a culture of continuous experimentation and optimization, using data and customer feedback to test, learn, and improve the customer experience over time.

What You’ll Bring to the Role:

  • 10+ years of experience leading Customer Experience, Customer Success, Customer Operations, or Support organizations within a B2B SaaS company.
  • 5+ years leading multiple customer-facing functions through managers and senior leaders.
  • Experience supporting SMB customers in a Product-Led Growth (PLG) and/or Product-Led Sales (PLS) environment.
  • Demonstrated success improving customer retention, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
  • Experience implementing AI and automation to improve customer outcomes and team productivity.
  • Strong understanding of onboarding, customer support, customer lifecycle management, and digital customer engagement.
  • Experience owning or optimizing end-to-end customer journeys across multiple customer-facing functions and touchpoints.
  • Proven ability to build scalable processes and high-performing teams in high-growth environments.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
  • Exceptional executive presence and cross-functional leadership.

Who You Are:

  • Awareness that strategic clarity comes from a deep understanding of customers, products, teams and processes. You become decisive through deliberate learning and bring a growth mindset to every role.
  • Experience scaling a Customer Experience organization and innovating to solve problems.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to improve customer adoption and product usability.
  • You think beyond individual functions and see the customer experience as one connected journey rather than a series of departmental handoffs.
  • You naturally look for friction across the customer lifecycle and bring teams together to solve the underlying problem.
  • You are deeply customer-centric and use a combination of qualitative feedback, behavioral data, and business metrics to understand what customers need and where the experience can improve.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Intercom, Gainsight, Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, or similar customer technologies.
  • Experience designing digital-first customer journeys and self-service customer experiences.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics including GRR, churn, customer health, adoption, and customer lifetime value.

Success in Your First 12 Months

  • Establish a unified Customer Experience strategy across Support, Onboarding, and Retention.
  • Map and establish a clear view of the end-to-end customer journey, including key moments that matter, friction points, and opportunities for optimization.

  • Strengthen cross-functional partnerships that elevate the voice of the customer throughout the organization.

Compensation Band: $200-250k CAD

About the Role & Team

As an Account Manager specialising in OTA Partnerships, you will grow and develop Disney’s Online Travel Agency partnerships across EMEA, excluding the UK. The role focuses on improving the visibility, positioning, and booking performance of Disney Parks and Resorts on key third-party travel platforms.

In this role, you will lead commercially driven account plans and partner marketing initiatives designed to strengthen distribution, optimise channel performance, and deliver measurable revenue growth. You will translate the OTA strategy into actionable partner plans, collaborating closely with local market teams, marketing functions, central stakeholders, and external partners to deliver integrated activity across multiple markets.

Success in this role requires strong commercial acumen, effective stakeholder management, and the ability to operate with pace and agility. You will bring structure, clarity, and momentum to a growing distribution channel, balancing revenue objectives with brand integrity, market requirements, and an exceptional guest experience.

Values

You’ll join a team grounded in our Disney values, acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day.

What you will do

In this skilled, experienced role, you will lead commercially focused account plans and partner marketing activity that strengthen distribution, improve channel performance, and drive measurable revenue growth across O‑EMEA OTAs, acting as a lead, mentor, and problem‑solver for cross‑functional partners and project teams.

  • Grow Disney’s OTA partnerships across O‑EMEA by expanding distribution, improving visibility, and driving measurable revenue performance through key travel platforms.
