  • Manage internal stakeholder alignment across markets, marketing, commercial, creative, and approvals to ensure OTA activity is delivered clearly, on brand, and on time.

  • Improve how Walt Disney World Resort and Disneyland Resort products are presented across third‑party platforms, ensuring clear content, strong merchandising, and accurate product information.

  • Track performance and turn data into clear actions that improve conversion, revenue, and partner effectiveness, contributing insight to planning and forecasting processes.

  • Contribute to OTA strategy by sharing market insight, partner feedback, and recommendations from across the region, helping to shape the future of this developing growth channel.

  • Build simple, scalable ways of working that make the OTA channel easier to manage, measure, and grow, while mentoring others on best practices as a skilled team player and lead.

  • Demonstrate strong collaboration, planning, and accountability by aligning work with organizational goals, holding yourself and partners to commitments, and fostering effective teamwork across markets.

  • Strong commercial judgement and travel industry account management experience, with the ability to balance revenue growth, brand integrity, guest experience, and OTA or multi-market distribution priorities when shaping account plans and partner recommendations.

  • Highly analytical, with the ability to interpret data, assess OTA distribution performance, identify trends or risks, and translate insights into clear commercial recommendations for internal teams and external partners.

  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills, with experience collaborating across multiple markets, central functions, matrix organisations, and external partners to align priorities and deliver activity effectively.

  • Excellent planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, lead cross-functional initiatives, and bring structure, pace, and momentum in a fast-paced or developing channel.

jobs.description:
Overview:

Reporting to the Field Reimbursement Director, Lead, the Associate Director, Field Reimbursement will optimize access to Alnylam products in his/her region by understanding and addressing reimbursement and patient access challenges. This position requires a professional who can leverage his/her technical expertise and experience to deliver educational, reimbursement in-service programs to all sites of care (Medical Doctors Office, Alternative Infusion Centers, Hospital Outpatient Department, etc.) and manage access and reimbursement issues by initiating as well as leading action plans to resolve these issues.

A key component of this role is the ability to establish and deepen customer relationships through quality interactions with access and reimbursement focused external stakeholders at targeted strategic accounts. As such, extensive knowledge of ‘buy and bill’ products and prior experience with high-touch, specialty products are essential.

The Field Reimbursement Team is a critical part of the commercial strategy, working closely with National Account Leads (NALs), Health Systems Directors (HSDs), Regional Account Leads (RALs), Site of Care Directors, Patient Services, the broader Reimbursement team, and Sales to support Alnylam’s patient-focused vision of harnessing a revolution in biology for human health.

The successful candidate must be passionate about science and deeply motivated by the quest of delivering value to patients with the long-term success of the company in mind. He/she will work collaboratively with both internal and external stakeholders to build tactical plans to execute strategic imperatives.

This position supports the Northwest region, which includes the following states: Alaska, Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Optimizes access to the full Alnylam portfolio of products by ensuring that provider accounts understand access and reimbursement dynamics
  • Proactively identifies trends impacting barriers to access or reimbursement and creates solutions
  • Works with internal stakeholders and providers to support treatment pathways for patients
  • Proactively engages with key stakeholders in accounts, including Intake/Authorization teams, billing compliance, Finance executives (Revenue Cycle, Revenue Integrity), Infusion Center management and decision-makers and key Pharmacy Stakeholders
  • Responsible for identifying, addressing and supporting education to resolve outstanding claim payment issues
  • Provides mentorship and guidance to case managers and field reimbursement managers on case-specific complex PA/Appeal issues
  • Provides case-specific PA/Appeal support and site of care options for the rare business
  • Maintains relationships with Medicare Administrative Contractors (MACs) to optimize coverage for Alnylam therapies and monitors Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) and National Coverage Determinations (NCDs)
  • Works with Public Policy & Government Relations team on engagement strategies and tactics regarding MACs or local policy changes as well as state-level public policy initiatives
  • Utilizes reporting dashboards to track critical metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Ensures compliance with all corporate and industry policies in collaboration with Alnylam Legal, Regulatory and Compliance

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 5+ years prior pharma/biotech or other related and relevant healthcare experience
  • 3+ years of field reimbursement experience in “buy and bill” preferably in rare disease, oncology, specialty products and/or infusions/injectables
  • Established relationships with Medicare Administrative Contractors (MACs) highly preferred
  • Strong knowledge of the US payer landscape
  • Deep understanding of both medical benefit and pharmacy benefit across payer types (Medicare, Medicaid, commercial, VA/DoD, etc.) and sites of care (Hospital Outpatient Department, free standing centers and home infusion)
  • Proven ability to identify key access and reimbursement barriers to treatment and design effective resolution plans
  • Exceptional professional communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills necessary to interact with decision makers (CFO and other C-suite level stakeholders)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead without authority in a highly collaborative matrix and fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter who is enthusiastic about rare disease and Alnylam’s core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people
  • Ability to travel up to 50%
  • Must reside in geography or within 75 miles of the boundary and with reasonable proximity to a mid-size or larger airport

jobs.description:
Pay Plan Title:Medical Economics Analyst II

Working Title:Medical Economics Analyst II

FLSA Status:Exempt

Posting Salary Range:$67,524 - $85,222

Office Location:Remote within North Carolina

POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Medical Economics Analyst II to join our Finance team! The Medical Economics Analyst II is responsible for performing analysis on rate trends, developing insights into key financial drivers, and communicating findings to various stakeholders.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Develop and implement payer analytics and economics strategies around provider rates.
  • Analyze behavioral health, physical health, and pharmacy data and rates using a variety of data sources and programs including but not limited to Excel, SQL, Access, etc.
  • Utilize industry trends and Medicaid fee schedules and data concepts to drive decision-making.
  • Prepare presentations and other collateral materials to support rate initiatives.
  • Participate in rates process improvement projects.
  • Provide technical training and support to team members.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • High school diploma or GED and six (6) years of experience in healthcare analytics or medical economics, including experience with Excel or experience developing and writing code; OR
  • Associate's degree and four (4) years of experience in healthcare analytics or medical economics, including experience with Excel or experience developing and writing code; OR
  • Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of experience in healthcare analytics or medical economics, including experience with Excel or experience developing and writing code; OR
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience. experience.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within North Carolina.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.

Preferred:

  • Two (2) years or more experience in Managed Care industry.

Deadline for Application:September 23, 2026 at 11:59pm

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)
  • Licensure/certification information, if applicable

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

Trillium Health Resources is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and a drug-free workplace. All candidates must pass a drug test as a condition of employment.

🏆 Sr. Software Engineer II | United States | Remote

Pax8 is hiring a remote Sr. Software Engineer II in the United States to shape resilient cloud systems, establish modern engineering standards, and accelerate responsible artificial intelligence-assisted software development.

🚀 Define What Great Engineering Looks Like

This is an opportunity to influence engineering far beyond a single codebase. You’ll own the technical direction of a key product domain, solve complex challenges across teams, and establish patterns that help engineers deliver secure, observable, and maintainable software at scale.
As Pax8 advances its artificial intelligence journey, you’ll grow alongside rapidly evolving technology. You’ll help determine where artificial intelligence can improve engineering outcomes, where human review remains essential, and how teams can adopt new tools responsibly without compromising technical quality.

☁️ Build the Future With Pax8

Pax8 combines the energy of a fast-growing technology business with the reach of a global cloud marketplace. Our people are encouraged to stay curious, challenge convention, share knowledge, and build solutions that make technology more accessible to small businesses.
Discover more about Pax8 in the United States and explore our culture, purpose, and people.

🧩 What You’ll Do

  • Set the technical strategy for a major product domain, guiding architecture, engineering standards, and the delivery of complex initiatives involving multiple teams.
  • Design dependable distributed systems using event-driven and cloud-native patterns that support long-term product growth.
  • Establish practical standards for distributed tracing, structured logging, service-level objectives, alerting, and production reliability.
  • Lead collaborative technical design reviews and document important architectural decisions so teams can move forward with clarity.
  • Identify recurring engineering challenges and create system-level solutions that improve productivity across the wider organization.
  • Partner with product and data science colleagues to turn business needs into thoughtful, scalable technical designs.
  • Define meaningful measures of engineering quality, including test coverage, deployment performance, incident trends, and recovery effectiveness.
  • Own critical systems throughout their lifecycle and participate in on-call support when required.
  • Mentor engineers in system design, software quality, domain ownership, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence tools.
  • Establish clear safeguards for artificial intelligence-assisted development, including validation checkpoints, review expectations, and appropriate limits for autonomous agents.
  • Evaluate emerging development tools and guide adoption when they offer genuine value to engineers, partners, and the business.
  • Use artificial intelligence to explore design options, assess trade-offs, support complex refactoring, strengthen testing, and produce clear technical documentation.

🌟 The Difference You’ll Make

Your work will raise the engineering bar across multiple teams. By creating reusable patterns, improving platform reliability, and removing systemic barriers, you’ll help engineers deliver better software with greater confidence.
You’ll also influence how Pax8 approaches artificial intelligence-assisted engineering at scale. Your judgement will help teams move faster while protecting maintainability, privacy, fairness, transparency, and human accountability. The result will be stronger products, more effective engineering teams, and a more dependable experience for Pax8 partners and their customers.

⭐ What You’ll Bring

  • Extensive software engineering experience, including ownership of complex production systems and technical leadership across multiple teams.
  • Expert proficiency in Python and TypeScript, supported by deep knowledge of a significant product or technical domain.
  • Proven ability to define architecture, establish engineering standards, and guide important technical decisions without waiting for problems to escalate.
  • Considerable expertise in distributed system design, including event sourcing, command query responsibility segregation, microservices, and service mesh patterns.
  • Extensive experience with Amazon Web Services, Kubernetes, cloud-native infrastructure, and platform reliability engineering.
  • A systems-first mindset, with the ability to replace recurring fixes with durable solutions that eliminate whole categories of problems.
  • Demonstrated success leading platform, infrastructure, developer experience, or engineering productivity initiatives.
  • The ability to connect technical decisions with the business problem, customer need, and complete system lifecycle.
  • Proven experience mentoring engineers and helping teams improve their technical judgement, documentation, and delivery practices.
  • Advanced capability with artificial intelligence coding tools for complex analysis, multi-file change, automated test generation, and large-scale refactoring.
  • Sound judgement about the capabilities and limitations of artificial intelligence, including when human review must remain non-negotiable.
  • A responsible approach to data classification, privacy, bias mitigation, fairness, transparency, and validation of artificial intelligence-generated output.
  • Experience creating clear technical proposals and architectural decision records that allow teams to understand context, options, and trade-offs.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Postgraduate study may be valuable for research-adjacent work but is not essential.
  • A collaborative approach grounded in curiosity, ownership, candid feedback, continuous learning, and respect for diverse perspectives.
  • The ability to maintain adequate, secure, and private internet service for remote work.
  • Flexibility for infrequent travel when collaboration or business needs require it.

🔐 Trust at Every Step

At Pax8, we care deeply about building genuine, trust based relationships — starting with how we hire.
To protect our business, our teams, and our customers, we use a range of measures throughout the recruitment process to help confirm authenticity and prevent fraud. These safeguards are designed to be fair, respectful, and proportionate, and may evolve as risks change. By applying, you acknowledge that we take steps to verify identity and representation during hiring. If you're applying as your authentic self, you have nothing to worry about — we're excited to meet you.
We also use thoughtfully applied AI-enabled tools to support our hiring process. These tools may assist with tasks such as reviewing or prioritizing applications, but hiring decisions are made by our people. More information is available in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. If you have questions about how we hire or would prefer not to have your application supported by these tools, you can opt out at any part of our process.

💙 Bring Your Perspective

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the criteria. We're committed to diverse perspectives, inclusive hiring and sharing your transferrable skills. To fulfil this role, you must hold valid right to work in United States.

💙 Salary & benefits

🎁 Total Rewards

At Pax8 we believe that your Total Rewards should include a benefits package that shows how much we value our greatest assets. All FTE Pax8 people enjoy the following benefits:
  • Non-Commissioned Bonus Plans or Variable Commission
  • 401(k) plan with employer match

📚 Grow Without Limits

There's extensive room for a talented individual to grow at pace — whether that's advancing quickly in this role or exploring one of the many opportunities across our global organization. Alongside specialist Learning & Development trainers, you'll also tap into AI powered tools, "born in the cloud" mentors, and cross continent collaboration that broaden your perspective and sharpen your expertise. We'll give you the space, trust, and the right projects to help you thrive — and full visibility of what it takes to reach your next level.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter - High Volume (Manufacturing - English Language)
jobs.excerpt: The Senior Recruiter is responsible for Service Excellence throughout the recruitment cycle.
jobs.description:
The Senior Recruiter is responsible for Service Excellence throughout the recruitment cycle. They act as a brand ambassador for their client and partners with the hiring managers in a consultative capacity. They are focused on delivering top talent for their hiring managers while providing proactive and timely communication on the status of the search. The Senior Recruiter is expected to stay abreast of industry and market specific information or trends that could impact the search. They will act as a mentor to Recruiters as well as other team members. They demonstrate innovation and outside of the box thinking with their search techniques.

  • Skills: High Volume recruiting background is a must with an experience in Manufacturing enviroments: such as Hiring Machine Operators, Maintenance, Forklift for example.
  • A background in recruiting for US is a must.
  • Work set up: Remote / Monday to Friday
  • Languages: Fluent English is essential

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Complete a detailed job scope conversation with the hiring leader to determine position specifications.
  • Timely review of applicants who have applied via the applicant tracking system.
  • Build and deploy effective recruitment marketing campaigns specific to the job opening.
  • Source candidates via resume databases and networking sites using sophisticated Boolean search language.
  • Source candidates via social media channels and deep web sourcing techniques.
  • Generate targeted lists of passive candidates using member subscriptions and technologies.
  • Solicit and pursue referrals from business networks and/or internal referrals.
  • Utilize proprietary software for mobile and email campaigning to talent communities.
  • Use a sophisticated mix of media to connect with talent community (phone, email, campaigning, network introductions and social media).
  • Provide value propositions uniquely tailored to each candidate situation and interest level in the job.
  • Prepare candidates for interviews; providing logistical information, interview schedule, appropriate attire and expectations for follow up from the recruiter; additional counsel as needed.
  • Ensure all candidates are provided with timely updates concerning the status of their applications and interviews.
  • Throughout the process, keeps a strong pulse on the interest levels and/or concerns of top candidates.
  • Conduct professional and thoughtful phone interviews that are infused with industry/role specific probing questions as the conversation/interview dictates.
  • Navigate difficult conversations in order to gather appropriate information.
  • Compare candidate phone interview notes and skills assessments with requisition specifications to determine if the candidate is a match for the role.
  • Apply consideration for factors relative to candidate fit to team and cultural fit.
  • Issue skills testing as needed and evaluate results (if process dictates).
  • Review background and reference information (if process dictates).
  • Keep candidates engaged throughout process.
  • Continuously build talent pipeline to ensure there are multiple candidates in play at all times.
  • Keep hiring manager up to date on any market changes that would impact the hiring process or talent community.
  • Articulate a job offer and drives for candidate acceptance.
  • Partner with the hiring manager to ensure the offer is accepted by the candidate.
  • Strict adherence to all regulations (OFCCP and all other compliance standards set forth).
  • Demonstrate segment/practice/industry expertise.
  • Work to deliver a strong candidate slate for each requisition.
  • Provide accurate and regular reporting of recruiting activities.
  • Identify perceived difficulties with searches and research solutions by collaborating with leadership (and hiring manager as appropriate).
  • Proactively and regularly communicates the status of each search to the hiring manager.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, management, human resources or related field required. Equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of five or more year’s results-oriented recruiting experience working in an in-house, RPO or agency setting.
  • Ability to showcase niche segment or industry expertise.
  • Ability to employ technologies in the recruiting process that create efficiencies.
  • Adhere to documentation and processes for compliance.
  • Experience utilizing deep web sourcing techniques.

Additional information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

A career at Cielo will give you the opportunity to work with the industry’s smartest people and to take ownership of your success! Cielo is a brand that reflects our big idea – that talent is rising – and with it our opportunity to rise above. We create careers for ambitious people by moving beyond traditional assumptions of what it means to work in talent acquisition.

Cielo is the world's leading Talent Acquisition Partner. We deliver a better talent experience for everyone through Talent Acquisition, Search, Consulting, and Digital Accelerators™. With our fresh approach – we design and build comprehensive, proven solutions inspired by technology to find and keep the unique talent that elevates our clients above the competition.

jobs.excerpt: Our client is a specialized business consultancy and software integration firm that helps organizations streamline operations through cloud-based technologies and intelligent business systems.
jobs.description:
Our client is a specialized business consultancy and software integration firm that helps organizations streamline operations through cloud-based technologies and intelligent business systems. They work closely with clients to design, implement, and optimize scalable digital solutions, enabling businesses to automate processes, improve customer engagement, and build more connected technology ecosystems.

As they continue to grow, they are looking for an experienced Salesforce Pardot Consultant to help clients design, implement, and optimize effective B2B marketing automation solutions using Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot).

The Role

We're looking for a Salesforce Pardot Consultant (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement) with strong hands-on experience building and optimizing marketing automation workflows within the Salesforce ecosystem.

Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement is the primary platform for this role.

You'll work directly with clients to understand their marketing and lead management requirements and translate them into effective Pardot solutions—from lead capture, segmentation, scoring, and nurturing through to campaign automation, reporting, and Salesforce CRM alignment.

This is a client-facing role that requires someone who is comfortable combining hands-on technical execution with consulting and stakeholder communication.

Experience with the broader Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) ecosystem is valuable, but it is considered a secondary skill rather than the primary requirement.

Role Details

Commitment: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Working Hours: AU working hours

Location: Fully Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Monthly Rate: USD $1,600–3,000/month (depending on level of experience)

What You'll Do

Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement

  • Build, configure, test, and optimize marketing automation campaigns using Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot).

  • Design and manage automated lead nurturing journeys and engagement programs.

  • Configure segmentation lists, automation rules, completion actions, dynamic lists, and other Pardot automation functionality.

  • Build and optimize lead scoring, grading, and qualification models.

  • Develop forms, landing pages, email templates, and lead capture workflows.

  • Create personalized and segmented B2B marketing campaigns based on prospect behavior, attributes, and lifecycle stage.

  • Support campaign tracking, attribution, and reporting within Pardot and Salesforce.

  • Maintain strong data quality and ensure accurate synchronization between Pardot and Salesforce CRM.

Lead Management & Marketing Automation

  • Translate client marketing strategies and business requirements into scalable marketing automation solutions.

  • Develop lead nurturing and lifecycle strategies that effectively move prospects through the marketing and sales funnel.

  • Configure lead routing, qualification, and handover processes between marketing and sales.

  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates, campaign performance, and marketing-to-sales alignment.

  • Troubleshoot automation, synchronization, campaign, and data issues.

  • Perform thorough QA and testing before campaigns and automation workflows go live.

Email & Campaign Development

  • Build and optimize responsive email campaigns and templates.

  • Support personalization and dynamic content based on prospect data and behavior.

  • Develop landing pages and forms that integrate effectively with marketing campaigns.

  • Apply HTML and CSS where required to customize emails, forms, and landing pages.

  • Monitor campaign engagement and recommend improvements based on performance data.

Salesforce Integration & Data Management

  • Work with Salesforce CRM and Pardot to ensure reliable synchronization of prospect and customer data.

  • Support field mapping, campaign attribution, segmentation, and lead management processes.

  • Troubleshoot data synchronization and integration issues.

  • Collaborate with Salesforce and technical specialists where more complex integrations are required.

  • Support integrations between Pardot, Salesforce CRM, and other marketing or business systems.

Client Consulting & Collaboration

  • Work directly with clients to understand their marketing objectives, processes, and technical requirements.

  • Translate business requirements into practical Pardot solutions.

Licensed Clinical Social Worker

Location: Remote, Texas Licensure required (must reside in Texas)

Who We Are:

Tuesday Health is a value-based palliative care provider dedicated to transforming serious illness and end-of-life care. We deliver goal-centered care focused on alleviating physical symptoms and emotional stress for individuals and their caregivers. Our interdisciplinary care teams reduce avoidable hospitalizations and improve quality of life wherever individuals call home. Through our leading-edge care model, Tuesday Health is shaping the future of community-based palliative care nationwide.

The Role:

The Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) will collaborate closely with an interdisciplinary clinical team to deliver comprehensive, patient-centered palliative care to individuals with serious illness. In this value-based care model, the LCSW plays a critical role in addressing the psychosocial, emotional, and practical needs of patients and their families, supporting care coordination, goal-aligned decision-making including advance care planning and serious illness conversations, and improved quality of life across the continuum of care.

Key responsibilities of this role may include:

  • Conduct comprehensive assessments, including evaluation of psychosocial distress, mental health needs, caregiver burden, social determinants of health, and risk factors impacting patients with serious illness.
  • Clinically interpret assessment and screening results to identify priority needs, emerging risks, and appropriate interventions within the palliative care model.
  • Conduct serious illness conversations with patients and families and facilitate advance care planning conversations and documentation
  • Provide clinical recommendations and escalation to physicians, advanced practice providers, and other clinicians in accordance with established escalation protocols, including concerns related to safety, mental health, caregiver stress, or complex psychosocial needs.
  • Develop, document, and contribute clinically appropriate interventions within individualized care plans, ensuring alignment with patient goals, values, and value-based care outcomes.
  • Participate in and contribute clinical insight during interdisciplinary rounds and case conferences, supporting coordinated, goal-aligned care and an optimal patient and family experience.
  • Deliver short-term clinical counseling, psychoeducation, and emotional support to patients and caregivers coping with serious illness, illness progression, and end-of-life considerations, within scope of LCSW licensure.
  • Serve as a clinical resource to the care team by identifying psychosocial barriers to care, recommending evidence-based interventions, and supporting transitions across care settings.
  • Utilize Tuesday Health’s electronic systems, tools, and technology to document clinical assessments, interventions, and care plans, supporting coordinated care delivery and quality measurement in a value-based environment.
  • Establish and maintain therapeutic, trust-based relationships with patients and families, grounded in clinical listening, empathy, and culturally responsive care.
  • Collaborate with the multidisciplinary team to improve quality of life, reduceavoidable utilization, and support holistic outcomes including appropriate and timely hospice transitions for members with serious illness.
  • Support the interdisciplinary team through care team debriefings following emotionally charged cases and the facilitation of periodic memorial rounds for the team

A strong candidate will demonstrate the following:

  • Master’s in Social Work (MSW) from an accredited program
  • Active, unrestricted Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) license in the applicable state(s).
  • Clinical experience in palliative care is required, including experience with advance care planning and serious illness conversations
  • Experience working within an interdisciplinary care model, collaborating with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, care managers, health plan partners, and community-based resources.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent clinical judgment, including knowing when and how to appropriately escalate concerns or respond in urgent or emergent situations.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly document clinical assessments, interventions, and care plans.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high-quality patient and family experience.
  • Proficiency in using electronic health records (EHRs), clinical documentation systems, and digital tools, with the ability to adapt quickly to new technologies as the organization evolves.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment, demonstrating flexibility, resilience, and comfort with change and ambiguity.
  • Commitment to delivering compassionate, patient-centered care aligned with the goals of a value-based care model.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation, reflecting our commitment to attracting, retaining, and motivating the best talent in the industry
  • Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, paid time off and holidays, employer 401(K) match, etc.
  • Remote work with multiple onsite sessions each year to maximize collaboration and team building
  • A dynamic and inclusive team environment where you can lean on your teammates, offer candid feedback, bring your true self to work each day, and deliver tremendous impact while having fun along the way
  • Meaningful work each day; we care deeply about our mission, our patients, and each other

Tuesday Health seeks to recruit and retain staff from diverse backgrounds and encourages qualified candidates to apply. Tuesday Health is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, sex, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, color, race, creed, national origin, ancestry, religion, marital status, political belief, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, military, or veteran status.

Be Aware of Recruitment Scams

  • Tuesday Health has become aware that scammers impersonate our recruiters to defraud job candidates. No one representing Tuesday Health will:

  • Five + years of experience with Deltek Costpoint, specifically the Budget & Planning module.
  • Experience reviewing and entering project budgets into Costpoint.
  • Strong understanding of project budgeting and financial controls.
  • Experience working directly with Project Managers and Billing/Finance personnel.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting government contracting or defense programs.
  • Five + years of experience directly entering budgets into the Costpoint Budgeting & Planning module.
  • Knowledge of direct and indirect costs, labor rates, overhead, and project accounting.

jobs.excerpt: Role Purpose The AI Strategy role identifies, frames, validates, and prioritizes the AI opportunities that offer potential for significant enterprise revenue and margin growth.
jobs.description:
Role Purpose

The AI Strategy role identifies, frames, validates, and prioritizes the AI opportunities that offer potential for significant enterprise revenue and margin growth. This individual acts as a organizational thought leader to our company's leadership in order to decide what opportunities to attack, how to attack them, how to prioritize them, and what to initiate, accelerate, or stop ahead of critical investment decisions.

This is a strategy and business-judgment role. It sits with SBU and functional leaders to turn financial, operational, and clinical problems into investment-ready theses: the problem, the customer or clinician, the first principles approach, the opportunity value, the investment required to unlock that value, the risk, and the conditions under which the work should proceed or cease.

This is not a builder role. Solution design, technical feasibility, and build execution sit with AI Business Partners, Product Builders, enterprise architecture, and technology colleagues. AI Strategy owns the quality of the question and the quality of the bet.

Key Responsibilities

Problem Framing & Opportunity Assessment

  • Partner with enterprise and SBU, finance, operations, and clinical and pharmacy leaders to identify business problems where AI could create significant, even non-linear, value unlock.

  • Frame each opportunity in business terms: who is served, what changes, what value is at stake, what risk is introduced, and what would have to be true for the work to succeed.

  • Conduct rigorous qualitative and quantitative user and market research to validate the opportunity in order to derisk the bet.

  • Distinguish problems for which AI offers non-linear advantages, (i.e. not just problems that need process, policy, data, or operating-model change), and conduct a first principles decomposition of the problem's points of leverage and AI's ability to unlock value against those points.

  • Translate enterprise and SBU challenges into opportunities with measurable financial value, outcomes, and experiential improvements, not a list of use cases.

  • Bring a clear recommendation to proceed, sequence, partner, or stop.

Portfolio Strategy & Investment Framing

  • Stack-rank opportunities on strategic alignment, customer or clinical value, feasibility (in partnership with product and technology colleagues), risk, cost, and speed to value, developing a robust and rigorous scoring methodology aligned to our organization's strategic needs.

  • Develop business cases, investment theses, value realization models, and roadmaps that a business owner have data to stand behind.

  • Assess buy, build, partner, and hybrid paths as business choices, and flag duplicate investment across teams.

  • Explore non-traditional investment routes to solving problems, such as exploration of venture investment, incubation, or even M&A discussion, alongside colleagues from these areas.

  • Define success metrics and measurement instrumentation before work is staffed, including adoption, productivity, financial impact, quality, customer experience, and clinical outcomes.

  • Revisit the AI portfolio as evidence arrives, and retire or reframe work that is not earning the next increment of investment, seeking to drive an "innovation rate of return" on the total body of work.

Progression Criteria & Value Discipline

  • Establish stage-gates and evidence expectations for concept, pilot, and broader adoption decisions.

  • Define what good enough to continue looks like in business and adoption terms, and name the owner who will be accountable if the work scales.

  • Identify the workflow, operating-model, and organizational changes required for value to show up, not only the technology change.

  • Use results from live work to refine what the enterprise should fund next.

  • Partner with the DD&AI program function and technology partners, including the AI Enablement team, on portfolio tracking and value reporting. Note that this role does not serve as the project or program manager, but facilitates key reporting around our AI IO return on invested capital and effort.

Healthcare Context & Responsible Use

  • Align recommendations with clinical and operational realities, regulatory context, and member or provider impact.

  • Partner with legal, compliance, privacy, information security, governance, and model risk management when an opportunity raises those questions.

  • Apply Responsible AI principles as decision criteria, including transparency, fairness, privacy, reliability, human oversight, and accountability.

  • Recommend where AI should automate, assist, recommend, or escalate, and name the human who remains accountable.

  • Raise risk early enough that it shapes the investment decision, not the launch review.

Stakeholder Alignment & Influence

  • Advise business, clinical, product, and operations leaders on which AI bets are worth making and why, using rigorous analyses and data.

  • Communicate recommendations clearly and compellingly through business narratives, simple decision frameworks, and financial or outcome models.

  • Align stakeholders with competing priorities and variable AI fluency.

  • Represent AI Strategy in intake, planning, and investment conversations.

  • Mentor colleagues on problem-framing quality. Note that this role does not coordinate the delivery function.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Typically 8+ years in strategy, product strategy, management consulting, business operations, finance, digital transformation, or a related field inside a large or regulated enterprise.

  • Demonstrated experience framing business problems, writing investment cases, and helping leaders make fund, sequence, or stop decisions.

  • Ability to evaluate value, adoption risk, implementation complexity, and total cost of ownership at a decision-quality level, in partnership with technology counterparts.

  • Working literacy in what current AI capabilities can and cannot do, sufficient to challenge weak use cases and to know when a technology partner or AI expert needs to be in the room.

  • Knowledge of what it takes to build great products, including an appreciation and intuition around the user's needs and experience expectations.

  • Experience operating in a matrix, with competing stakeholders and incomplete information.

  • Clear written and verbal communication with senior business leaders, with the ability to make a recommendation rather than only present options.

Preferred

  • Master's degree, MBA, or equivalent advanced degree.

  • Experience in healthcare payer, provider, pharmacy, clinical, benefits, or healthcare services environments.

  • Familiarity with clinical workflows, claims, utilization management, prior authorization, care management, provider operations, or member engagement.

  • Deep expertise in leveraging AI to solve problems at a root cause level.

  • Experience with Responsible AI, privacy, or regulatory considerations as they affect product and investment decisions.

  • Experience managing or advising an innovation or digital portfolio, including stopping or redirecting work.

  • Experience partnering with product, technology, and delivery teams without owning their work.

Core Competencies

  • Problem Framing: Identifies the problem worth solving and states it so a leader can act.

  • Value Orientation: Anchors recommendations in rigorous financial (e.g. revenue, cost, margin, etc.), clinical outcomes, and experiential differentiation metrics, not just as interesting opportunities.

  • Portfolio Judgment: Sequences work, stops work, and protects reuse over another isolated initiative.

  • Product-Mindedness: Fundamentally understands what it means to build great products.

  • AI Literacy: Knows enough about developing AI solutions to decompose a use case and to pull in specialists when needed.

  • Healthcare and Operating Context: Understands how clinical teams operate in a regulated healthcare enterprise.

  • Responsible Use: Treats privacy, fairness, oversight, and accountability as part of the strategy, not a later review.

  • Trusted Advisor: Earns trust through clarity and integrity. The recommendation holds when the answer is no.

What Success Looks Like

  • Business leaders treat AI Strategy as a go-to thought leader partner on what is worth doing, not as a ticket-taker or a project coordinator.

  • A prioritized set of AI opportunities is well documented with clear articulation of a compelling problem, audience, value, approach, risk, owner, and a proceed, sequence, or stop recommendation.

  • Funded work in partner areas has passed shared framing and validation criteria before teams are assigned or funds are allocated.

  • Duplicative or redundant or low-value ideas are stopped or merged, and that outcome is counted as success.

  • Handoffs to AI Business Partners, Product Builders, and Technology are clean: the bet is clear, the owner is named, and the success measures are agreed.

  • Responsible-use questions are raised before investment, not after a pilot is already underway.

  • Return on invested capital compounds as high value problems are attacked with rigor, measured, and investment decisions are made with discipline.

jobs.description:
Production Music Library Consultant, UK & International

Peermusic Accorder Library Ltd, a peermusic company

Part time consultancy | 1 to 2 days per week | Remote, UK based

About peermusic Accorder Library

peermusic Accorder Library (PAL) is part of the global peermusic group and represents a dedicated production music catalogue for use across television, film, advertising, digital content and other media.

The peermusic Accorder Library is a modern, technology led production music platform designed to make it simple for music users to discover, search, save, share and download music, with tools that support professional production workflows.

Explore the peermusic Accorder Library

Job Role

We are looking for an experienced Production Music Library Consultant to help us develop the reach and usage of the PAL catalogue, initially across the UK and with the potential to support international growth.

This is a flexible consultancy role for someone who understands the production music world from the inside and who combines strong industry relationships, commercial instinct, excellent music knowledge and confidence with music metadata and digital library technology.

You will help shape the growth of a modern production music library, using your existing industry expertise and network to identify and develop relationships with production companies, television producers, editors, post-production teams, music supervisors, agencies, broadcasters and other professional music users.

You will also analyse how people are searching for and using production music, feeding that knowledge back into the development, presentation and discoverability of the PAL catalogue.

Finally, you will already have good experience managing library platforms, creating releases, and handling large amounts of metadata.

Key responsibilities

The role is particularly interesting because it combines:

  • Business development / relationships
  • Music curation / creative expertise
  • Metadata / technology / catalogue management

Business development / Relationships

  • Use existing industry network to identify potential new users of the PAL catalogue across UK television, film, advertising, digital, branded content, post production and other relevant media sectors.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with existing production companies, producers, editors, and other clients.
  • Develop a structured approach to outreach and relationship building.
  • Identify opportunities for PAL within areas of the media industry where production music is increasingly being used, including for existing clients.
  • Attend relevant industry meetings, networking opportunities and events where appropriate

Music Curation / Creative Expertise

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of production music and how music is selected and used within television, film, advertising and digital content.
  • Familiarise yourself with the music already in the library and respond to various requests and briefs, by identifying appropriate tracks and creating playlists.
  • Help users get the best from the PAL catalogue, by demonstrating AI and keyword search, playlist creation, saving and sharing functions.
  • Understand the difference between simply supplying music and providing a genuinely useful creative music service.
  • Monitor changes in the production music and sync landscape and identify emerging opportunities for the catalogue.
  • Keep a record of and provide regular feedback on gaps in the catalogue, changing user requirements, genres, moods, themes, formats and areas of demand.

Metadata / technology / catalogue management

  • Apply a strong eye for detail, a creative flair and a practical understanding of production music metadata and tagging.
  • Work confidently with SharePoint, audio files, spreadsheets, library applications and digital music platforms.
  • Understand the importance of accurate, consistent and useful metadata to both the client and to peermusic.
  • Assess whether tracks are being described and tagged in ways that reflect how real world users search for music, and make improvements based on the results.
  • Understand music data, cue sheets, rights information and the relationship between catalogue metadata and music usage.
  • Experience with platforms such as DISCO, AIMS, Harvest or similar music library and catalogue management systems would be highly advantageous

International development

Although the initial focus will be the UK, PAL sits within the international peermusic organisation and the role has the potential to contribute to developing the catalogue's international user base.

You will help identify International production companies and media organisations, editors, music supervisors as well as other potential partners, such as library sub publishers or other routes to market.

Experience of working across international territories would therefore be highly valuable.

Prior Experience

We are looking for someone who already has hands-on experience in the production music industry and a strong understanding of how professional music users work.

You will ideally have an established network within the UK media and production industry, with contacts that you feel could benefit from use of the library.

Working arrangement

This is a part time consultancy role of approximately 1 to 2 days per week, with flexibility around how those days are structured.

The role will be predominantly home based within the UK, with occasional meetings, industry events and client visits where appropriate.

The consultancy is intended to be flexible and could suit someone who already works independently within the music, television or media industries and is looking for an additional consultancy opportunity.

The successful candidate will work closely with the peermusic Accorder team to develop a clear programme of UK and international user growth.

How to apply

Please send (in one document) a CV together with a short covering note outlining your experience in production music, your current industry network and why you think you could help develop the PAL catalogue.

jobs.description:
The Senior Splunk Engineer supports the federal client by engineering, developing, deploying and maintaining the organization’s SIEM implementation and its minor applications, integration, apps and interfaces. This position possesses mastery of the Splunk tool, with technical expertise including hands-on solution development and implementation experience, and analytical skills for evaluating and optimizing capabilities of securing application solutions. The qualified candidate will be critical team member with proven leadership, communication, organizational and interpersonal skills. This position provides technical consulting support as well as advance technical design and specifications and planning process assistance, and must have the ability to multitask and solve complex technical problems.

Chickasaw Nation Industries, Inc. serves as a holding company with multiple subsidiaries engaged in several lines of business (Business Services, Health, Infrastructure and Engineering, Mission Optimization, Technology and Transportation) for the federal government and commercial enterprises. A portion of our profits is used to support Chickasaw citizens. We are proud to support the economic development and long-term viability of the Chickasaw Nation and its people. CNI offers premium benefits eligible on the first day of hire to full time employees; (Medical - Dental – Vision), Company Life Insurance, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, 401(K) Immediate Vesting, Professional Development Assistance, Legal Aid Assistance Program, Family Planning / Fertility Assistance, Personal Time Off, and Observance of Federal Holidays.

As a federal contractor, CNI is a drug-free workplace and adheres to the Federal Controlled Substance Act.

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

The ability to obtain, maintain and access classified information at the Public Trust level.

REQUIRED Certifications: Certified Splunk Architect

Preferred Certifications: Additional Splunk certifications, CEH, CySA+, GSEC, CISM, CCNA, Security+, Server+, Linux+, Cloud+ (or equivalent higher-level certifications)

Senior level mastery of SIEM front and back-end operations and configurations in addition to the interoperability with other security tools.

Extensive knowledge of Splunk Enterprise Security and CIM compliance.

Extensive knowledge of Splunk Risk Based Alerting (RBA).

Cross functional and well-rounded. Firm understanding of data flows and interconnections between multiple system with the network environment.

Exercises multi-tasking skills and critical thinking by managing events in multiple systems, applications, and other priorities.

Extensive knowledge of system back-end engineer and administration with heavy focus on Linux.

Analytical skills for evaluating and optimizing capabilities of securing application solutions.

Systematic approach to remediate system issues/problems and making recommendations to improve the efficiency of system operations and data availability utilizing current and future technologies.

Must demonstrate capability to operate autonomously in a diverse environment with minimal supervision and provide accurate and precise documentation.

Must demonstrate excellent troubleshooting skills, and be self-motivated, results-driven, and well organized.

Must have excellent communication skills (written and verbal) with experience communicating effectively with all levels of staff and management.

Extensive experience with SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) systems, and security event correlation is required; PERL/Linux shell scripting/Regex experience is highly preferable.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Responsible for the integration of CNI Core Competencies into daily functions, including: commitment to integrity, knowledge/quality of work, supporting financial goals of the company, initiative/motivation, cooperation/relationships, problem analysis/discretion, accomplishing goals through organization, positive oral/written communication skills, leadership abilities, commitment to Affirmative Action, reliability/dependability, flexibility and ownership/accountability of actions taken.

Implements, optimizes and maintains the SIEM infrastructure (Splunk), and deploys products, apps, reports, alerts and dashboards utilizing system development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies and business best practices.

Increases the efficiency of the infrastructure to connect more enterprise data sources to Splunk Enterprise.

Develops change management plans to be adaptable to the changing needs of the program. Leads prototyping and testing of new features and solutions.

Manages and monitors Linux based on-prem server infrastructure for configuration and software upgrades.

Develops, maintains and optimizes installation of internal and external SIEM components.

Oversees the optimization, operation and health of Splunk components and connections to data sources. (Query scheduling, Performance tuning, Apps, Dashboards, Saved Searches, Scheduled Searches, Alerts, etc.).

Provides mentoring to Tier II technicians for problem resolution and lead technical discussions with technical engineers of SIEM and SIEM data connections.

Shares and provides knowledge to junior security architects and engineers and recommends training as needed.

Brings industry best practices and innovative ideas leading to continuous improvement of the Splunk environment.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management of Information Systems, Cybersecurity or a related Math or Science discipline, and a minimum of six (6) years in IT infrastructure, networking, architecture, administration or security. Six (6) years of Splunk expertise, with at least three (3) years of experience in large scale enterprise-level solutions. Clinical & Educational Background

  • Language Proficiency: Must be Bilingual (English and Spanish).

  • Fixed Working Location: The candidate must work from one specific, consistent location only. Epic EMR access is tied to a verified IP address; changing locations or IP addresses causes significant security disruptions and requires hours of technical modification to restore access.

  • Hardware: Minimum 8 GB RAM.

  • Monitor: Minimum 21–22 inch monitor. Epic does not function well on smaller screens without 32 GB RAM.

  • Multitasking: Ability to run Epic and Zoom simultaneously on the same computer (no phone/tablet workarounds).

Compliance

V. Nice to Haves

  • Software Proficiency: Prior experience with Epic EMR is a significant advantage.

  • Specialty Exposure: Previous experience in Gastroenterology or surgical practices.

VI. Schedule and Training

  • Training Period: Two-week intensive phase (Epic EMR and practice-specific workflows).

  • Working Hours: Starts at 30 hours per week, with the potential to move to 40 hours based on performance.

jobs.description:
L’ENTREPRISE

Careerminds est un leader des solutions de transition de carrière, de développement des talents et de coaching. Nous aidons les organisations à accompagner leurs collaborateurs dans le changement tout en favorisant le développement et la mobilité des talents. Notre portefeuille de solutions comprend des services de référence en matière de Transition de Carrière et de Coaching, ainsi que Progression, notre application dédiée aux référentiels de carrière et à la planification des parcours professionnels.

LE RÔLE

Le ou la coach de transition de carrière accompagne les participants des programmes d’outplacement Careerminds, individuellement et/ou en groupe, dans leur développement de carrière et leur recherche d’emploi.

Il s’agit d’une mission freelance / en tant qu’indépendant(e), exercée à 100 % à distance. Les candidats doivent être légalement en mesure de fournir leurs services en tant qu’indépendant(e) dans leur pays de résidence.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Établir des relations solides et de confiance avec les participants et créer un environnement de coaching à la fois soutenant et motivant.
  • Accompagner les participants tout au long de leur parcours de Transition de Carrière, en les aidant à définir des objectifs clairs, à maintenir leur dynamique et à progresser vers leurs objectifs professionnels.
  • Proposer un accompagnement personnalisé sur l’orientation professionnelle, les enjeux liés à la transition, les choix de carrière et la prise de décision.
  • Guider les participants dans leur positionnement professionnel et leur marque personnelle, la préparation de leur CV, le networking, leur stratégie de recherche d’emploi, les entretiens, l’évaluation des opportunités et la négociation.
  • Renseigner avec précision les éléments relatifs à l’accompagnement dans le Career Management System (CMS) pour chaque participant, conformément à nos engagements de service.
  • Animer ou dispenser, selon les besoins, d’autres programmes liés à la transition professionnelle auprès de participants individuels ou de groupes.

RESPONSABILITÉS COMPLÉMENTAIRES

  • Apporter une expertise sur l’environnement français de l’emploi et des restructurations, notamment en matière de réduction des effectifs, de licenciements collectifs, de dispositifs de départ volontaire et de Plans de Sauvegarde de l’Emploi (PSE).
  • Soutenir l’équipe Internationale dans l’identification et l’intégration des exigences, pratiques et spécificités propres à la France dans la conception et le déploiement des programmes de Transition de Carrière.
  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes afin de soutenir la mise en œuvre et l’alignement continu des exigences spécifiques à la France en matière d’outplacement.
  • La connaissance des pratiques de restructuration et de rupture du contrat de travail dans d’autres pays européens est un plus.

COMPÉTENCES ET EXPÉRIENCE REQUISES

  • Une expérience pratique en ressources humaines et une solide compréhension des processus de restructuration en France, y compris les instances représentatives du personnel (CSE – Comité Social et Économique).
  • Une expertise en développement de carrière, incluant notamment la planification de carrière, le personal branding, la préparation de CV, les entretiens, le networking, les réseaux sociaux et la recherche d’emploi en ligne.
  • Un minimum de 7 à 10 ans d’expérience professionnelle, ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension des structures organisationnelles, des cultures d’entreprise et des processus de prise de décision.
  • Une maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable, le rôle étant en lien avec de nombreuses parties prenantes internationales.

jobs.excerpt: Requisition ID2026-4633Job SummaryWe are seeking an experienced Program Manager to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Testosterone Screening and Treatment Expansion Program, a federal healthcare initiative aimed at improving Veterans' access to evidence-based testosterone screening and treatment services across an integrated health system.
jobs.description:
Requisition ID

2026-4633

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Testosterone Screening and Treatment Expansion Program, a federal healthcare initiative aimed at improving Veterans' access to evidence-based testosterone screening and treatment services across an integrated health system. In this role, you will serve as the Task Order Manager responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing all programmatic activities in direct support of VA clinical and operational goals. You will work at the intersection of federal healthcare delivery and program governance, ensuring that program milestones, deliverables, and quality standards are met on time and within scope. The ideal candidate is a mission-driven, detail-oriented leader with deep experience managing complex healthcare programs within large government or corporate environments, and who thrives in a structured federal contracting context with multiple stakeholders. You are equally comfortable driving strategic planning sessions and managing day-to-day execution details, and you bring a collaborative, proactive working style that keeps cross-functional teams aligned and accountable.

Primary Responsibilities

Serve as the primary Task Order Manager for a large-scale federal health contract, acting as the central point of accountability for all program planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout activities in support of the VA Testosterone Screening and Treatment Expansion Program. Lead the development and maintenance of comprehensive program management artifacts including project plans, integrated master schedules, risk registers, communication plans, and status reports in compliance with VA and federal contracting requirements. Coordinate with VA Contracting Officer's Representatives (COR), clinical subject matter experts, and internal team leads to align program activities with targeted VA health outcomes and ensure timely achievement of task order deliverables. Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate program risks and issues, escalating critical blockers to VA leadership and contractor management with recommended corrective action plans to maintain program momentum. Oversee resource allocation, staffing plans, and subcontractor performance to ensure the right personnel and capabilities are deployed across all phases of the task order lifecycle, from initiation through closeout. Prepare and present program performance briefings, data-driven progress reports, and executive summaries to VA stakeholders and senior leadership, ensuring full transparency into program health, metrics, and strategic alignment with VA's integrated healthcare mission.

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum of 10 years of experience in healthcare program management, with demonstrated expertise in planning, initiating, managing, executing, and closing out programs within an integrated health care system. Master's Degree required in a relevant field such as Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Minimum of 6 years of experience supporting a large corporation or government agency, with preference for direct experience supporting federal healthcare agencies such as the VA, DoD, HHS, or similar. Ability to obtain and maintain VA network access and comply with all VA security, privacy, and credentialing requirements, including completion of required VA onboarding and background investigation processes. Must be authorized to work in the United States; this position does not offer visa sponsorship. Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent recognized project/program management certification (e.g., PgMP, FAC-P/PM, DAWIA PM) required at time of hire.

Desired Qualifications

Prior direct experience supporting VA programs, Veterans Health Administration (VHA) initiatives, or federal health IT/clinical operations contracts; familiarity with VA-specific program governance frameworks such as the VA Acquisition Regulation (VAAR) and VHA Directives; experience managing programs related to men's health, endocrinology, preventive care, or clinical screening and treatment expansion; knowledge of federal performance-based contracting principles, earned value management (EVM), and OMB/federal reporting requirements; and experience working within or alongside VA's Office of Patient Care Services or a comparable federal clinical program office.

jobs.title: Technical Co-founder (CTO)
jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking an applied AI builder to co-found and lead the technical direction of a new B2B AI venture from the ground up.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking an applied AI builder to co-found and lead the technical direction of a new B2B AI venture from the ground up. This is a co-founder partnership with founder-level equity and founder-level authority, not a salaried executive role.

We are not looking for someone who manages engineers from a distance or adds AI language to a traditional CTO resume. We are looking for someone who can take a vague problem, frame it clearly, design the right system, and turn it into something customers actually use and trust. If you've gone from ambiguity to working product before — and you want to do it again with the backing of an experienced venture building team — this is the opportunity.

This is a full-time, exclusive commitment to building and owning a single B2B AI venture from the ground up.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You'll co-create with a proven venture building team, including:

  • John Carbrey – 4x founder, bootstrapped to $100M ARR
  • Joshua Auslander – Seasoned CFO and strategic advisor with $200M aggregate exits
  • Alan Smith – Globally recognized early stage validation expert, 24 products launched, an exit, 5M+ books sold
  • Prathna Ramesh – Early-stage investor and capital strategy advisor

The Partnership

  • Founder-level equity with meaningful ownership from inception, aligned across funding rounds
  • Founder-level authority, including co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • A proven process and playbook for taking ventures from 0 to 1, informed by our team's prior experience and mistakes
  • Venture building and scaling resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
  • Investor and advisor network across B2B AI and early-stage capital markets
  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CTO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner — building alongside you.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will set the venture's technical direction and lead its execution. This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire.

  • Technical Direction — Own problem framing, architecture, system design, and product judgment from day one, translating rough product intent into structure, context, and specs that both humans and AI systems can execute against
  • Build — Use modern tools and frontier models to move fast without sacrificing quality or maintainability, designing agentic systems with first-principles thinking and knowing when orchestration adds genuine leverage versus when simplicity is the better call
  • Customer & Market — Be the primary technical voice in early customer conversations, understanding real workflows and shaping the right product rather than just shipping quickly
  • Traction Before Scale — Prove there is something worth scaling before thinking about scaling it, focusing on traction first and team-building second
  • Capital — Contribute to fundraising, from investor conversations to due diligence
  • Team — Recruit and grow a technical team when the time is right, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Proven track record of shipping AI products to real users under real-world constraints — not research, experiments, or prototypes
  • Deep practical experience with frontier models, LLM-based systems, and agentic architectures, with strong system design instincts and a bias for simplicity and maintainability
  • Strong translation layer skills — able to turn messy product intent into clear structure, constraints, and specs that both humans and AI systems can act on
  • Close to the customer, comfortable in customer conversations, and able to let real workflows shape what you build
  • Rigorous about verification — feedback loops, evaluation, and systems that can be trusted
  • Prior experience as a technical co-founder or early engineering leader, with fundraising experience a strong plus
  • Founder at heart — energized by ambiguity, able to go far alone, and ready to commit fully

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 105591

Market Development Executive III - Cybersecurity Services & Managed Security Services

Location:

You will have the flexibility to work fully remote.

Insight at a Glance

  • 14,000+ engaged teammates globally
  • $8.2 billion in revenue in 2025
  • Certified as a Great Place to work in 9 Countries in 2025
  • Fortune 500 Company (No. 447) in 2025
  • Received 25+ industry and partner awards in the past year
  • $1.4M+ total charitable contributions in 2024 by Insight globally

Now is the time to bring your expertise to Insight. We are not just a tech company; we are a people-first company. We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organizations through complex digital decisions.

About the role

Are you a proven cybersecurity services seller with deep expertise in Zero Trust, cloud security, managed detection and response (MDR), security operations, managed security services (MSS), or enterprise security transformation? Do you have experience guiding enterprise clients through complex security decisions, helping them architect, implement, manage, and secure their critical infrastructure? Are you looking for a remote career opportunity that rewards top performers?

Now is the time to bring your cybersecurity expertise to a consulting sales role for a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator where success and fulfillment go hand in hand. You will be at the forefront of helping enterprises transform their security posture, strengthen their resilience, achieve compliance objectives, and optimize their security operations in an increasingly complex threat landscape.

The Opportunity
As a Market Development Executive with Insight, you will be the catalyst for identifying new cybersecurity and security services opportunities within our existing enterprise client base. We will count on you to introduce customized security consulting, implementation, managed services, and managed security services solutions to large enterprise clients across a spectrum of industries. You will manage the sales process from the initial security assessment, through solution design, to the final close. Along the way, you will leverage Insight's unique services expertise to provide everything our clients need to progress in one place: a creative vision, executional capabilities, and ongoing solutions management.

Previous enterprise cybersecurity sales experience is required; however, we will consider cloud security, infrastructure security, and application security experience as added benefits.

Qualifications and Responsibilities
We're seeking experienced technical and sales executives with a track record of strategizing & operationalizing cybersecurity and managed security services solutions to solve critical business problems. You should also have a bachelor's degree in business, IT, cybersecurity, or a related field and experience driving enterprise security sales.

Significant Cybersecurity & Managed Security Services Sales Experience
You are known as a trusted advisor to clients in how to deploy enterprise security solutions and have extensive experience in cybersecurity consulting services and managed security services: Zero Trust architecture, managed detection and response (MDR), security operations center (SOC) design and implementation, managed security services (MSS) operations and optimization, cloud security, application security, threat and vulnerability management, and/or security compliance and governance. Your track record in 'hunting' and 'farming' accounts, including new areas of an existing client with cybersecurity consulting and managed security services, will distinguish you as a meaningful addition to the account team. Your skills in multi-stakeholder engagement (CISO, CIO, Security Architects, Board-level executives), channel selling, and formal opportunity/account management methods will help you build a deep and varied set of opportunities. Your proven experience to forge new security vendor partnerships and your ability to quickly build trust with security vendor counterparties will establish new and consistent pipeline opportunities.

Managed Security Services Expertise
You bring hands-on knowledge of managed security services delivery models, including 24/7 monitoring, threat detection, incident response, and security operations optimization. You understand the operational and financial benefits of MSS to enterprise clients, including cost predictability, access to specialized talent, and improved security posture. You can articulate the value of transitioning from reactive security to proactive, managed security operations, and you have experience positioning MSS alongside traditional consulting and implementation services to create comprehensive security transformation programs.

Client Engagement Skills
You share our goal to make meaningful connections each day that positively impact the lives of the people we serve, including our clients, partners, and teammates. You build strong customer relationships with executive-level decision-makers (CISOs, CIOs, security leaders) around their security posture and operational efficiency, providing trusted advisory services to assist them in achieving their security transformation, compliance objectives, and security operations excellence.

The Opportunity

Solo practitioners and small law firms still lose work the same way: missed calls, slow callbacks, and intake handled between hearings. Hiring is no answer — payroll, training, and turnover are exactly what these firms cannot absorb.
