The Venture

BloomLex is a managed AI staffing platform that delivers AI workers as fully-set-up hires — trained, monitored, and continuously improved by our team. Rather than another self-serve SaaS tool, BloomLex operates as a Role-as-a-Service business: lawyers evaluate us on outcomes — time saved, calls answered, consults booked — not configuration effort.

Our first hire, Ava, is an AI Front Desk that answers calls 24/7, captures structured intake, books consultations, and performs outbound callbacks, without creating new operational burden for the lawyer. The roadmap expands from the front desk into adjacent AI staff roles, all delivered through the same managed model.

The Partnership

The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, and live pilots are running. What remains is to bring on the technical co-founder — a partner who will own product and engineering with the same conviction, urgency, and ownership stake.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

  • Unit Economics — Own the trade-offs between AI quality and cost-per-call, and lock in unit economics within the $499/month pricing model

  • Roadmap — Convert pilots into paying customers, expand the AI staff beyond the front desk, and begin a path toward custom and self-hosted models where legal and privacy requirements demand it

Co-Founder Profile

  • Full-stack confidence across applied LLMs, real-time voice and conversational AI, telephony, human-in-the-loop workflows, observability, and secure multi-tenant SaaS

Job Details

Position Summary

The Principal Data Architect is responsible for designing, governing, and optimizing the enterprise data architecture that supports analytics, operational data needs, AI/ML capabilities, and strategic business objectives. This role ensures data is structured, integrated, secured, and governed in a way that maximizes usability and value across the organization.

As a key contributor within the Data, Analytics & AI Architecture and Strategy Office, you will set architecture direction, create reusable patterns and canonical models, and guide multi‑domain, cross‑platform implementations. You will partner with executives, product leaders, data engineering, analytics, security, and data governance teams to modernize the data ecosystem (e.g., lakehouse, data mesh/fabric, streaming, data products), shorten time‑to‑insight, and enable AI/ML at scale. You will own critical architectural artifacts, proof‑of‑concepts, and reference implementations for mission‑critical initiatives, and mentor architects and engineers across the organization.

This role is instrumental in establishing the building blocks of the organization’s data ecosystem—data domains, data products, semantic layers, metadata frameworks, and data quality controls—while helping evolve the organization toward modern patterns such as data fabric, data mesh, and cloud‑native lakehouse platforms.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

Data Architecture & Modeling

  • Conduct current‑state assessments and define transition architectures to reach the target state with measurable milestones and risk mitigation.

  • Own conceptual, logical, and physical data models across enterprise domains.

  • Establish standards for data modeling, canonical data definitions, and metadata structures.

  • Define modeling patterns (e.g., 3NF, dimensional/star, Data Vault, wide tables/Delta, semantic/metrics layers) and enforce consistency.

  • Partner with data engineering to implement data models in modern cloud platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery).

  • Ensure lineage, metadata, and data contracts are designed and documented to support interoperability and governed data sharing.

  • Ensure consistent, reusable, and scalable data structures aligned to enterprise data strategy.

Data Platform & Integration Design

  • Architect data ingestion, transformation, storage, and distribution patterns aligned with platform capabilities.

  • Define best practices for data architecture across batch, micro‑batch, and streaming use cases.

  • Evaluate and recommend data platform technologies for lakehouse, data warehouse, data lake, and operational data stores.

  • Optimize data storage and processing for performance, cost, and scalability.

  • Guide implementation teams on data structures, partitioning strategies, indexing, and schema design.

Data Governance, Quality & Security

  • Partner with governance to operationalize data ownership/stewardship, policy enforcement, PII/PHI protection, and compliance.

  • Collaborate with governance teams to define data policies, data contracts, and stewardship models.

  • Define data quality SLAs/SLOs, validation rules, trust scores, and observability practices (schema drift, freshness, lineage, anomaly detection).

  • Architect security-by-design (RBAC/PBAC/ABAC, column/row‑level security, masking, encryption, key management) across cloud and on‑prem environments.

  • Integrate governance tooling (e.g., Collibra, Purview ) with catalogs, lineage, and policy management.

  • Ensure data definitions, lineage, classifications, and business context are documented and visible.

Standards, Patterns & Reuse

  • Publish and maintain architecture patterns, blueprints, guardrails, and decision records (ADRs) to drive consistency and reuse.

  • Lead design reviews and architecture councils, ensuring adherence to standards, NFRs (performance, reliability, security), and cost targets.

  • Curate a library of data product templates, quality checks, and integration accelerators.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Translate complex architectural concepts into clear business narratives and trade‑off analyses for senior stakeholders.

  • Work with business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into data architecture solutions.

  • Provide mentoring and coaching to solution/data architects and senior engineers; develop talent and elevate architecture practices.

  • Influence portfolio planning, platform investments, and prioritization through architecture insights and value cases.

  • Present data architecture decisions, tradeoffs, and recommendations in a clear, business‑friendly manner.

Innovation & Emerging Technology

  • Lead POCs and reference implementations to validate modern patterns (lakehouse, mesh/fabric, streaming, data contracts, metrics layers).

  • Continuously scan market/industry trends and recommend pragmatic adoption plans that reduce complexity and accelerate value.

AI/ML Data Enablement (Supporting Role)

  • Ensure data structures and pipelines support ML feature engineering, training, inference, and MLOps.

  • Collaborate with data scientists by providing well‑curated, governed, high‑quality datasets.

  • Design data architectures that enable the integration of AI/ML outputs back into operational and analytical systems.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Weli, a B2B WealthTech venture.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Weli, a B2B WealthTech venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Weli is an AI-native operations platform purpose-built for wealth management firms. It plugs directly into the CRM, portfolio management, and custodian systems firms already run, and executes the back-office work behind every account, account opening, money transfer, trade coordination, and compliance routing. Every wealth management firm already staffs an Operations function to do this work, typically at a ratio of roughly one Operations person to every three advisors, and that function is chronically stretched: slow, error-prone, and unable to give any single advisor's book the full attention it deserves. Weli is built for the firm's back office.

Market Context

Weli's customers are independent and hybrid RIAs, firms built around senior advisors who own their own client books and lean on a small, shared operations team to execute everything behind the scenes. It's a large and fast-growing world. There are roughly 300,000 wealth and financial advisors in the US, and the independent channel has been on a two-decade climb, from under a fifth of the industry's assets in 2007 to 27% today, on track for nearly a third by 2028.

Growth is outpacing the operations layer built to support it. The industry's leading benchmarking study found 78% of RIA firms were actively hiring last year just to keep up with capacity constraints, and most firms add a full new hire for every $360,000 of revenue growth, an expensive, linear way to scale a business that should compound. In our own interviews, one managing partner put a number on it directly: his firm could roughly triple its assets under management with its current advisor headcount if operations could keep pace. That gap, real, quantifiable, and largely unaddressed by today's AI tools, is Weli's opportunity.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
  • Investor and advisor network across fintech and early-stage capital markets
  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning
  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with RIA and wealth management firms, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion
  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
  • Team — Recruit and lead a cohesive founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company
  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement
  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company
  • Direct exposure to wealth management, RIA operations, and financial services compliance, with the credibility and relationships to navigate the industry's regulatory landscape and sell into established firms

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Job Title: Experienced Clinical Research Associate- Israel

Job Location: Netanya, Israel

Job Location Type: Home-based

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Overview
Perform monitoring and site management work to ensure that sites are conducting the study(ies) and reporting study data as required by the study protocol, applicable regulations and guidelines, and sponsor requirements.

Essential Functions
• Perform site monitoring visits (selection, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits) in accordance with contracted scope of work and regulatory requirements, i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines
• Work with sites to adapt, drive, and track subject recruitment plan in line with project needs to enhance predictability.
• Administer protocol and related study training to assigned sites and establish regular lines of communication with sites to manage ongoing project expectations and issues.
• Evaluate the quality and integrity of study site practices related to the proper conduct of the protocol and adherence to applicable regulations. Escalate quality issues as appropriate.
• Manage the progress of assigned studies by tracking regulatory submissions and approvals, recruitment and enrollment, case report form (CRF) completion and submission, and data query generation and resolution. May support start-up phase.
• Ensure copies/originals (as required) site documents are available for filing in the Trial Master File (TMF) and verify that the Investigator's Site File (ISF) is maintained in accordance with GCP and local regulatory requirements.
• Create and maintain appropriate documentation regarding site management, monitoring visit findings and action plans by submitting regular visit reports, generating follow-up letters and other required study documentation.
• Collaborate and liaise with study team members for project execution support as appropriate.
• If applicable, may be accountable for supporting development of project subject recruitment plan on a per site basis.
• If applicable, may be accountable for site financial management according to executed clinical trial agreement and retrieve invoices according to local requirement.

Qualifications
• High School Diploma or equivalent Degree in scientific discipline or health care preferred.
• Requires at least 2 year of on-site monitoring experience.
• Equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be accepted in lieu of degree.
• Good knowledge of, and skill in applying, applicable clinical research regulatory requirements (i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines).
• Good therapeutic and protocol knowledge as provided in company training.
• Computer skills including proficiency in use of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint and use of a laptop computer and iPhone and iPad (where applicable).
• Written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language.
• Organizational and problem-solving skills.
• Effective time and financial management skills.
• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers, and clients.

Enterprise Data Center Business Development Director

Department: Sales

Full-time

Remote
On-Target Earnings: $350,000-400,000, dependent on experience, ($150,000 base + uncapped commissions)

Company Description:

DMD Systems Recovery is on a mission to protect the planet – one IT asset at a time. We help companies securely erase data and give technology a second life through reuse, refurbishment, and responsible recycling. As a certified B Corp, we believe business should do more than make money – it should make a difference. Every laptop, server, and device we process helps reduce waste, shrink landfills, and fuel the next generation of technology. If you care about sustainability, real‑world impact, and smart tech solutions, DMD is a place where your work truly matters.

Our headquarters are in Tempe, Arizona, with additional processing facilities in Austin, Texas and Palo Alto, California.

Job Summary:

DMD Systems Recovery LLC, a leader in IT asset disposition (ITAD), is seeking a dynamic, results-driven Enterprise Data Centre Business Development Director to drive strategic growth across enterprise-owned data centers, colocation providers, cloud service providers, and infrastructure organizations.

This is a true hunter role focused primarily on net-new logo acquisition and expansion into large-scale enterprise infrastructure environments. The successful candidate will develop and execute account strategies that create long-term partnerships with organizations undergoing data center migrations, cloud transformations, hardware refreshes, consolidations, divestitures, and infrastructure modernization initiatives. You will identify, develop, and close complex six- and seven-figure IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) and data center lifecycle management opportunities. Working closely with executive stakeholders, operations teams, and strategic partners, you will position DMD as the preferred provider of secure, sustainable, and financially beneficial ITAD solutions.

This role reports to one of the Sales Directors and offers a clear pathway toward future sales leadership opportunities as DMD continues its rapid growth.

Key Responsibilities:

New Business Development (Hunter Focus)

  • New business development. Proactively identify and target potential clients for ITAD services, including companies with large IT infrastructures, government agencies, data centers, and technology firms.

  • Enterprise & data center relationships. Develop and leverage relationships across enterprise-owned data centers, colocation providers, and cloud service providers to identify, pursue, and close new business opportunities.

Consultative & Solution Selling

  • Client relationship management. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, ensuring exceptional customer service and satisfaction throughout the IT asset disposition process.

  • Consultative sales approach. Understand clients’ IT asset lifecycle and offer solutions tailored to their specific needs, including data security, environmental compliance, and value recovery from retired IT assets.

  • Solution selling. Promote the full range of DMD’s ITAD services, including secure data destruction, equipment remarketing, logistics management, and e-waste recycling.

Proposals, Market Intelligence & Collaboration

  • Proposal development. Create and present customized proposals, RFP responses, and contracts to potential clients, aligning DMD’s services with their operational and compliance requirements.

  • Market research & competitive analysis. Stay informed about industry trends, competitors, and market conditions to develop strategies for expanding the client base and increasing market share.

  • Cross-functional collaboration. Work closely with DMD’s operations, logistics, and technical teams to ensure smooth service delivery and meet client expectations.

Sales Targets & Reporting

  • Sales targets. Meet or exceed individual and team sales quotas and revenue goals, providing regular sales forecasting and reporting to leadership.

  • Records management. Maintain and update sales and customer records.

Education and Experience:

  • B2B sales experience. 8+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in a new-business account executive role within IT asset disposition, IT services, or related technology industries.

  • Complex deal leadership. Experience leading complex six- and seven-figure sales engagements involving multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and executive-level decision makers - including multi-year enterprise contracts and RFP-driven deals.

  • Proven track record. A history of exceeding revenue targets and closing high-value deals. You have led or significantly influenced deals with Fortune 1000/5000-level clients and understand how to navigate long sales cycles, procurement processes, and enterprise RFPs.

  • ITAD & IT hardware knowledge. Knowledge of IT hardware (servers, networking equipment, computers, etc.) and the ITAD process, including data security, e-waste recycling regulations, and equipment remarketing.

  • Communication & presentation. Excellent communication and presentation skills with a focus on customer service and problem-solving.

  • Independence & prioritization. Ability to work independently, manage time efficiently, and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

  • Tools. Proficiency with CRM software and MS Office (MS Excel in particular).

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times

Employment Details:

This full-time position reports to the CRO. The role includes salary (commensurate with experience and responsibilities), commission and a benefits package. DMD is an equal opportunity employer. We conduct pre-employment drug screens and background checks.

jobs.excerpt: Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities.
jobs.description:
Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance. We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants’ homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging. As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

Location: Remote; requiring regular travel for onsite go-lives, department rounding and other support activities as needed.

Role Scope:

We are hiring a Product Manager, Strategic Technology Applications to own the product strategy, roadmap, and cross-functional delivery for the technology application portfolio that powers Habitat Health's growing PACE organization. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role sitting within the Strategic Technology Applications team, reporting directly to the Vice President of Product.

As Habitat Health expands into new markets and scales its center operations, the Strategic Technology Applications team functions as the internal “product organization” for the systems that power clinical, operational, growth, and administrative workflows. This role will own the end-to-end product lifecycle — discovery, roadmap prioritization, delivery, adoption, and iteration — for a portfolio of applications spanning call/communications, CRM, core operations, growth, and risk adjustment systems.

The ideal candidate is a product-minded healthcare technology leader who is energized by translating clinical and operational needs into a compelling roadmap, partners naturally with internal developers and vendor teams to ship solutions, and uses data and stakeholder feedback to continuously improve adoption and impact.

Core Responsibilities & Expectations for the Role

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a portfolio of strategic technology applications, including but not limited to call/communications platforms (TalkDesk), CRM platform (Salesforce), EHR platform (Epic)
  • Translate operational, clinical, and growth stakeholder needs into a prioritized backlog and roadmap, balancing quick wins against longer-term platform investments
  • Define and track success metrics — adoption, utilization, satisfaction, and operational impact — to measure product performance and guide iteration
  • Maintain a clear view of the application portfolio's health, dependencies, and integration points (e.g., Salesforce and ancillary clinical/communications tools) to ensure data integrity and a cohesive experience across platforms

Discovery, Delivery & Execution

  • Run discovery with clinical, operational, and growth stakeholders to surface pain points, validate requirements, and shape well-scoped product requirements and user stories
  • Partner with internal analysts (e.g., CRM Admin, EHR Support Analyst, etc.) and external vendors to scope, prioritize, and deliver configuration changes, integrations, and new features
  • Own backlog grooming, sprint/release planning, and prioritization decisions using tools like Jira
  • Lead or co-lead technology application implementations for new PACE center launches, including configuration, workflow validation, user acceptance testing, and go-live support
  • Build repeatable implementation and product-launch playbooks that support Habitat Health's continued growth

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Own day-to-day vendor relationships for managed applications, including performance management, escalations, contract oversight support, and roadmap alignment
  • Evaluate and recommend new technology solutions in partnership with the Director of Strategic Technology Applications; support build-vs-buy assessments and vendor selection
  • Serve as a trusted product partner for clinical, operational, and growth teams, translating their needs into the roadmap and communicating trade-offs clearly
  • Represent the Strategic Technology Applications product portfolio in cross-functional forums, governance bodies, and project teams

Adoption, Training & Change Management

  • Partner with training and enablement resources to design rollout, onboarding, and training plans for managed applications across clinical, operational, and administrative end users
  • Track adoption metrics and gather user feedback; feed insights back into the roadmap and configuration priorities
  • Own change management planning for major releases, feature rollouts, and workflow redesigns
  • Maintain clear product documentation, including roadmaps, requirements, release notes, and user-facing support materials

Required Qualifications and Competencies

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, with hands-on ownership of the roadmap and lifecycle for enterprise or B2B SaaS applications; healthcare or health IT experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience managing or launching SaaS/cloud-based applications (experience with call center platforms, CRM, or clinical ancillary systems a plus)
  • Strong command of product management fundamentals: discovery, prioritization frameworks, roadmapping, backlog management, and agile delivery (Jira or similar)
  • Proven ability to translate business and clinical requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, and workflow improvements
  • Comfortable partnering with both technical teams (developers, vendors) and non-technical clinical/operational stakeholders
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear product documentation, roadmaps, and executive-facing updates
  • Experience supporting multi-site healthcare operations or rapid program expansion preferred
  • Familiarity with PACE, Medicare/Medicaid, or other regulated healthcare environments preferred

Nice to Have

  • Experience with TalkDesk, Salesforce, Abridge, Epic or other contact center / CRM / ambient AI documentation /EHR systems
  • Experience with health plan systems (claims, eligibility, encounter submissions) or risk adjustment platforms
  • Background in product delivery or change management methodology

Compensation:

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $170,000–$194,000 for candidates located in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle, and $149,000–$185,000 for candidates located elsewhere. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 10% of the base salary and may be eligible for additional incentive compensation, as applicable.

The final compensation offered will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, education, certifications, geographical location, and business needs.

In addition, this position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; paid parental leave, short- and long-term disability coverage; life insurance; flexible spending accounts; a 401(k) savings plan that includes a match; paid time off; and company paid holidays.

At-Will Employment

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity and Inclusion

If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, perform the essential functions of a position, or receive other employment benefits and privileges, please contact us at .

jobs.description:
Staff Frontier Engineer

Frontier Engineering

Remote - US

Multiple Hires

Overview:

Pax8 is the technology marketplace of the future, linking partners, vendors, and small to midsized businesses (SMBs) through AI-powered insights and comprehensive product support. With a global partner ecosystem of over 35,000 managed service providers, Pax8 empowers SMBs worldwide by providing software and services that unlock their growth potential and enhance their security. Committed to innovating cloud commerce at scale, Pax8 drives customer acquisition and solution consumption across its entire ecosystem.

Our purpose is to help every small business turn their dreams into reality through the power of technology.

Culture is important to us, and at Pax8, it’s business, and it IS personal. We embody Compassionate Candour by aiming to assist others with candid, actionable feedback. We Seek to Understand by being open, curious, and committed to learning. We believe in We Before Me, actively collaborating and seeking out diverse perspectives to ensure a win for Team Pax8. Our team takes pride in Do What You Say, taking ownership, honoring commitments, prioritizing, and delivering on promises. We encourage everyone to Light Up Learning by being brave and trying new ideas, embracing vulnerability, and sharing failures so everyone can learn. Finally, we are Driven by Passion, connecting personal passion to Pax8's mission, and remaining resilient in the face of adversity and uncertainty in pursuit of our goals.

At Pax8, we are passionate, creative, and humorously offbeat. We work hard, keep it fun, and expect the best.

*This is a proactive opportunity posting, allowing us to connect with exceptional talent for anticipated future openings within Pax8.

Position Summary:

The Staff Frontier Engineer role requires depth and reach together: the system is technically hard in its own right, and enough of Product & Engineering builds on it that one engineer getting it right compounds across the entire org. A representative problem is identity and entitlements, where everything depends on it and it is genuinely one of the harder problems in software. On the AI side, it is the eval infrastructure that determines whether what ships is actually prompted well. The Staff Frontier Engineer is individually accountable for building, hardening, and operating a system that the organization depends on without directly touching. They hold the problem space durably, long enough to develop real expertise and innovate within it. They earn the right to set its direction by shipping the system rather than by advising on it.

This role is measured on five dimensions (Craftsmanship, Impact, Mentorship, Safety, and State of the Art). What separates it from Frontier Engineer is that Judgment, Systems Thinking, and Safety now have to hold up against a problem where being wrong is expensive and, often, no one else is positioned to catch it.

Essential Responsibilities (includes, but is not limited to):

  • Own, build, and operate a system that is hard enough to need its own technical strategy and technically deep in its own right, and help drive the technical specs behind it
  • Make consequential calls about what to build, scale, or kill on ambiguous problems where the data does not answer the question, driving them to clarity through iteration and collaboration, and own the outcome
  • Exercise Systems Thinking past your own ownership boundary: see and optimize the whole line end to end, and change your own plan, or push back on someone else's, when the end-to-end view says the locally optimal move is globally wrong. Pursue the real fix, by influencing, contributing, or escalating, even when it lives in a system you don't own
  • Own the work yourself: your domain is yours to run, so address the high-leverage problems in it, scope the solutions, and build them with a workforce of agents behind you
  • Instrument what you ship for adoption and usage from the start, and hold any claim of delivered value to a falsifiable, data-backed standard
  • Scale your own judgment into others: mentor engineers toward owning highly complex systems rather than only reviewing their output
  • Apply a categorically higher bar to safety, security, and irreversible-consequence risk: identify and close it out before it ships, covering both classic engineering risk (data loss, security vulnerabilities) and AI-specific risk (misuse, jailbreaks, unintended capability, data exposure), including deciding what not to ship when everything else is ready
  • Run the full lifecycle for adopting new techniques (discovery, spike, prototype, proof of concept, hardened production) in your problem space
  • Write documentation precise enough that other teams can consume your systems as a service without a standing coordination meeting

Ideal Skills, Experience, and Competencies:

Craftsmanship:

  • Building: Builds and operates a system that is hard enough to need its own technical strategy and technically deep in its own right, and helps drive the technical specs for it. Builds the tool that eliminates a repeated problem.
  • Judgment: Makes high-stakes calls on what to build, scale, or kill when the data runs out, and escalates the ones that belong to product
  • Writing: Documents at a level that sustains other teams consuming the system without a standing meeting, and presents technical direction to engineering and product audiences

Impact:

  • Outcomes: Instruments the system and proves delivered value against a falsifiable, data-backed standard
  • Systems Thinking: Lands fixes across ownership boundaries when the end-to-end view demands it, regardless of who owns the code
  • Mentorship: Grows another engineer's judgment

Safety:

  • Applies a categorically higher bar to irreversible-consequence risk on a system with organization-wide reach

State of the Art:

  • Owns the pipeline for adopting new techniques in the problem space

AI Foundations (All Roles):

  • Understand AI capabilities and limitations and apply that judgment in daily engineering decisions
  • Use enterprise-approved AI tools (Claude) as primary productivity accelerators across the full development lifecycle
  • Apply Pax8 data classification and privacy principles before sharing any data with AI systems
  • Practice responsible AI: recognize and mitigate bias, uphold fairness and transparency requirements
  • Advanced prompting proficiency: multi-turn context setting, chain-of-thought elicitation, structured output enforcement, and iterative refinement

Location: Remote

Environment: Early-Stage FinTech

About the Opportunity

Our client is an early-stage FinTech developing technology for businesses operating within an increasingly digital and international financial environment.

As the business progresses from early product development towards greater commercial readiness, it is building out its senior leadership team and is seeking an experienced Fractional Chief Product Officer.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Founder/CEO and engineering leadership to turn an ambitious proposition into a focused, commercially viable product strategy.

This is a build-stage opportunity. You will not be inheriting a large Product organisation, mature roadmap or established Product infrastructure.

The opportunity therefore requires someone capable of combining strategic Product leadership with practical decision-making and execution.

Further details regarding the engagement and participation structure will be discussed directly with candidates progressing through the process.

Application – Mandatory Qualifying Questions

Please submit your CV together with a cover letter answering each of the following:

  1. What senior Product leadership experience do you have within FinTech, financial services or complex B2B technology?
  2. Please provide a specific example of a product you personally helped take from concept, prototype or early development towards commercial deployment.
  3. What experience do you have translating a founder-led or technically complex proposition into a prioritised product roadmap?
  4. What experience do you have with product pricing, packaging and commercialisation?
  5. Do you have experience within trade finance, payments, lending, banking, financial infrastructure, Web3/blockchain or another relevant financial-services environment? Please explain.
  6. This opportunity requires approximately 6–8 hours per week. Can you consistently commit to this alongside your other professional commitments?

All six questions are mandatory. Applications that do not answer every mandatory qualifying question will be automatically disqualified and will not progress further.

What You'll Be Doing

You will help establish and lead the company's Product discipline, including:

  • Owning and refining product strategy and roadmap
  • Translating commercial opportunities into clear product priorities
  • Defining requirements and use cases
  • Working closely with engineering leadership
  • Supporting product positioning, packaging and pricing
  • Prioritising integrations and product opportunities
  • Supporting pilot and proof-of-concept development
  • Bringing customer and institutional requirements into product decision-making
  • Establishing scalable Product-management disciplines
  • Helping leadership distinguish immediate priorities from longer-term opportunities

What We're Looking For

You should bring substantial Product leadership experience, strong commercial instincts and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity.

Experience within FinTech, payments, lending, trade finance, banking infrastructure, financial APIs, Web3/blockchain or other complex regulated technology environments would be particularly valuable.

We are more interested in evidence of what you have personally built, influenced and commercialised than job title alone.

Engagement Structure

This is a fractional engagement of approximately 6–8 hours per week, designed to operate alongside other compatible professional commitments.

The structure is centred on longer-term participation in the development and growth of an early-stage venture rather than a conventional executive package at this stage.

Full details will be discussed with candidates progressing through the process.

Job Overview

Are you a connected, results-driven sales leader in the utility space ready to make a meaningful impact?

We’re looking for a Sales Director, Electric Meters to drive growth for Aclara (a Hubbell company) across the Southeast region. This is a high-impact role where you’ll partner with utilities, lead complex deals, and shape the future of advanced metering infrastructure.

The Electric Meter Sales Director will be responsible for achieving overall sales goals and growing the installed base of Aclara electric meter products to utilities within assigned territory. Utilizing both direct and indirect sales approaches, the Sales Director, Electric Meters is responsible for leading customer engagement within the assigned territory and developing winning strategies to assess customer needs, develop market leading solutions, gather/communicate market intelligence, and win business with current and new customers. The Sales Director will be supporting the Southeast US territory and should reside in one of the following states (FL, GA, NC, SC, TN, AL, MS).

A Day In The Life

Sales Activities

  • Achieve current year sales targets and year-on-year growth plans by analyzing territory and customers to develop a specific region plan
  • Develop and maintain a diverse network of contacts within utility management and project teams, key Aclara partners, consultants, and other industry stakeholders.
  • Identify and develop opportunities to grow business with new and existing customers
  • Analyze accounts within the assigned territory and develop actionable sales plans and long-term account engagement strategies to penetrate and grow the installed base of Aclara electric meters with new and existing customers
  • Serve as an expert on electric meters to relevantly and effectively represent our offerings cross-functionally within utility companies.
  • Assess competitor offerings and develop differentiated market approaches
  • Understand regional, state, and national dynamics within their region to promote Aclara as a market leader
  • Perform all activities in the sales cycle around the electric meter offer —generate leads, qualify opportunities, educate customers, quarterback proposal development, and lead sales meetings/presentations.
  • Work closely and cross functionally with other Aclara and Hubbell sales resources within the territory.
  • Maintain positive client relationships to ensure client satisfaction, account growth, new business acquisition, and customer loyalty through cross-selling and upselling.
  • Consolidate and convey market intelligence, competitive feedback, customer requirements, and market direction to Aclara’s product management, partners and development teams to ensure a healthy and relevant product roadmap.
  • Represent the company in a manner consistent with its core values and team-based approach.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Maintain current account and opportunity information in Salesforce.com.
  • Coordinate closely with Aclara partners for opportunities and deals within the associated territory that include partner components.
  • Deliver effective sales presentations that encompass electric meters equipped with both Aclara-owned and partner technologies.
  • Support Product Management by monitoring and gathering market/product intelligence from existing and prospective customers, competitors, and potential technology partners.
  • Control sales expenses to meet budgets and maintain a proper ratio for the assigned territory
  • Follow all established Sales and Account Management processes, procedures, and methodologies.
  • Adhere to all Hubbell corporate policies.

What will help you thrive in this role?

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and Experience Requirements

  • Minimum of a bachelor’s degree, preferably in technology-related field. MBA a plus.
  • Minimum 5-10 years’ experience working within the utility industry with well-established relationships at relevant organizational levels. Strong ability to network and establish new and/or expanded relationships.
  • 5 years of experience in sales, commercial, or product management roles.
  • Experience working with and supervising independent sales agents/distributors preferred.

Skills and Knowledge:

  • Should have advanced knowledge of the offers and business cases that support electric meters and advanced metering infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of Hubbell and competitor products and services and their applications in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electric power, and power quality measurement.
  • Must possess the ability to grasp complex selling challenges while formulating strategies to advance business plans across a multitude of accounts.
  • Knowledge of the application of domestic and international electrical standards, such as UL, IEC, ANSI, IEEE and CE, and local laboratory certificate requirements.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
  • Must be highly motivated, goal-oriented, and persistent with experience in driving business opportunities and developing markets.
  • Must be able to effectively communicate a value proposition and to work both independently and as a member of a broader team.

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to travel up to 60% via air or land.
  • Must reside in one of the following states (FL, GA, NC, SC, TN, AL, MS)

LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers (at all levels), regulatory agencies, or members of the business community with tact and diplomacy. Ability to write speeches and articles for publication that conform to prescribed style and format. Ability to effectively present information to customers, top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors.

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

Hubbell Utility Solutions

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

Team members partner with the senior leaders of the business unit, and more broadly with leaders throughout the enterprise, as they deliver strategy projects addressing some of the businesses’ most important opportunities and challenges. These high-profile strategy projects place the team at the forefront of helping to define the future of Humana’s largest businesses.

Humana is seeking an experienced team member to support delivering some of Medicare and Medicaid’s highest priority projects and initiatives, with an emphasis on Medicare Advantage strategy development. jobs.description:
Overview

Change Business Partner - MRP

Location: US Remote with travels

Employment: 12 month project based role

Role Overview:

The Change Business Partner will lead the people-side implementation of strategic transformation across manufacturing operations. This includes driving the adoption of new systems, processes, and behaviours that enhance efficiency, safety, and growth. A key focus will be supporting the deployment and behavioural integration of standard costing across manufacturing sites, ensuring consistency in cost control, performance tracking, and margin visibility. The role requires a strong understanding of manufacturing, ERP (notably Microsoft D365), and change facilitation to support both people and site-level transitions.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and support change initiatives linked to process improvements and ERP projects, with a particular focus on standard costing.
  • Partner with finance, operations, and systems teams to make sure costing methods are understood, applied consistently, and support effective cost control.
  • Help operational leaders move from legacy costing approaches to standardised cost models, explaining the impact on reporting, performance measurement, and profitability.
  • Work with local teams to build understanding of how standard costs are created and maintained, including bill of materials (BOM) accuracy, labour and machine rates, and overhead allocation.
  • Deliver training and capability-building activities that strengthen cost awareness and accountability across production and planning teams.
  • Act as the link between Global Process Owners, finance teams, and manufacturing sites, turning costing policy into practical day-to-day processes within D365.
  • Support the accuracy and integrity of costing data by identifying gaps in processes, systems, and reporting, and helping teams put the right controls in place.
  • Drive adoption of new ways of working, making sure standard costing becomes embedded in decision-making rather than simply a finance exercise.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • Experience delivering change management within an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Understands and leads for the to-be processes and ways of working.
  • Understanding and advocating good practices in principle and in detail for a range of topics especially standard costing (cost build-up, cost drivers, variance analysis, cost updates) and margin management, but also MRP, planning, and warehousing.
  • Experience supporting or deploying standard costing frameworks within ERP systems (especially Microsoft D365), including training, data validation, and cost centre alignment.
  • Ability to engage both finance and non-finance teams in understanding the operational impact of cost changes, cost performance, and product profitability.
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence frontline teams, middle management, and senior leaders.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, particularly in operational and technical contexts.
  • Experience with ERP systems (JD Edwards, Microsoft D365) is a strong advantage.
  • Comfortable working at different levels of the organisation.
  • Flexible to adapt to the changing business needs of the projects.
  • Serves as best practice/quality resource within Standard costing and ERP Transformations.

Qualifications and Behaviours:

  • Aptitude to learn and adapt, seeing change opportunities and encouraging others to seek positive change.
  • Change Management or Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher) is an advantage.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in finance management or transformation, or multi-site general management roles within manufacturing or industrial sectors.

Morgan Advanced Materials is an EEO/AA/M/W/D/V

Morgan Advanced Materials is a business rich in history and innovation. Founded in the UK in 1856, we have grown into a global organisation with 70 sites in 18 countries. Our model to serve our customers where they need us has led to a diversified product range using our unparalleled expertise in ceramic and carbon materials, which we exploit to solve difficult problems for our customers across a diverse range of markets.

We are a purpose driven organisation. Our purpose is to use advanced materials to make the world more sustainable and to improve the quality of life. We deliver on that purpose through the products that we make, and the way that we make them.

We help our customers push the limits of their processes and products to meet the demanding requirements they face, from higher process temperatures to higher product performance to increasing miniaturisation.

Key Figures: Revenue £1,114.7m (2023), ~8,500 employees, manufacturing in 20+ countries, and a global customer portfolio. A UK PLC with head office located in Windsor, Berkshire UK. Listed on London Stock Exchange; Member of the FTSE 250 Index.

This role will also play a key part in shaping how AI and advanced analytics are leveraged to enhance NAVLIN’s capabilities and create new, differentiated offerings.

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others. 

Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

The SVP of Operations Transformation will serve as the chief architect for designing, building, and scaling
Theoria Medical's unified Central Operations hub. In this role, you will own the delivery of the specialized
toolsets, automation platforms, and infrastructure required to support a dual-revenue engine: optimizing
high-volume Fee-For-Service (FFS) revenue cycles while simultaneously scaling Value-Based Care (VBC)
workflows. Additionally, you will own the central utilities of Medical Records, Laboratory Integrations,
and Referral Management, while driving the end-to-end operational implementation strategy with facility
partners. This role also provides secondary oversight to ensure our daytime Telemedicine team is effectively
deployed to support LEAD facility launches and broad footprint coverage.

Key Responsibilities

Central Operations & Ancillary Services Ownership

  • Build Centralized Hubs: Design, staff, and scale a world-class Central Operations function to
    standardize multi-state provider support, credentialing, and scheduling.
  • Medical Records Management: Centralize and automate the retrieval, auditing, and processing of
    medical records to ensure compliance, rapid billing velocity, and continuity of care.
  • Lab Workflows & Integrations: Build and manage high-throughput pipelines for laboratory ordering
    and results routing, ensuring critical diagnostic data reaches clinicians instantly.
  • Referral Management Infrastructure: Architect a centralized, friction-free inbound and outbound
    referral management engine to maximize patient volume and streamline transitions of care.
  • Dual-Model Optimization: Design operational frameworks that maximize Fee-For-Service (FFS)
    volume and capture, while simultaneously building workflows for Value-Based Care risk models.
  • Vendor & Tool Selection: Evaluate, procure, and implement enterprise-grade workflow automation
    tools to reduce manual overhead across all centralized departments.

Facility Partner Implementation & Integration

  • Onboarding Blueprint Strategy: Standardize and execute the operational playbook for launch and
    integration within new partner facilities (SNFs, ALFs, and senior communities).
  • B2B Workflow Integration: Bridge Central Operations with facility-specific workflows and systems
    (e.g., PointClickCare, MatrixCare) to ensure frictionless clinical coordination.
  • Joint Governance & Relationship Management: Establish implementation timelines and joint
    operational steering committees with executive leadership at partner facilities to ensure
    accountability and deep alignment.
  • Change Management: Lead on-the-ground training, adoption, and cultural change management
    initiatives for facility staff to accelerate utilization of Theoria's services.

Provider Productivity & Experience

  • Maximize Clinical Throughput: Build the tooling and systems required to optimize daily clinician
    schedules, reduce travel times, and increase active patient-facing hours.
  • EHR Optimization: Partner with product teams to streamline the proprietary EHR platform
    (ChartEasy), minimizing charting friction and preventing provider burnout.
  • Administrative Automation: Build and implement automated routing for administrative tasks, including documentation, lab tracking, and prior authorizations.

Value-Based Care Workflows

  • Risk Model Tooling: Develop operational tools that embed VBC requirements directly into daily
    clinical workflows, focusing on preventive intervention and chronic care management.
  • Hospitalization Prevention: Design real-time tracking systems within Central Operations to quickly
    flag at-risk patients and lower hospital readmission rates.
  • Data Integration: Ensure seamless data exchange between Central Operations, remote patient
    monitoring (RPM) platforms, and facility partners

Telemedicine Team Operations & Footprint Support

  • Daytime Telemed Management: Manage and optimize the daytime telemedicine team, focusing on
    maximizing clinician utilization and balancing cross-footprint coverage needs.
  • LEAD Launch Alignment: Coordinate telemedicine resources to support and stabilize new LEAD
    facility launches as a secondary operational layer.
    Performance Management & Insights
  • Own the Dashboard: Create executive-level productivity scorecards to monitor provider utilization,
    billing velocity, lab turnaround times, referral conversion rates, and value-based outcomes.
  • Enforce Accountability: Leverage analytics to identify low-performing workflows and drive swift
    process interventions across the regional teams.

Qualifications

  • Executive Experience: 10+ years of operational leadership, explicitly building or scaling a
    Centralized Operations/MSO hub within a fast-growing healthcare organization.
  • Ancillary Operations Expertise: Proven track record directly managing and scaling high-volume
    Medical Records (HIM), Lab routing systems, and Referral coordination departments.
  • Strategic Dual-Model Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience balancing Fee-For-Service
    operational metrics (billing velocity, coding accuracy) with Value-Based Care workflows (quality
    tracking, utilization management).
  • B2B Implementation Track Record: Proven success leading complex, multi-site operational
    rollouts with external healthcare enterprise/facility partners.
  • Productivity-First Mindset: Proven track record of deploying technologies and tools that
    measurably increase clinical team capacity and decrease administrative burden.
  • Post-Acute Domain Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the post-acute care ecosystem, including
    skilled nursing facilities (SNFs), assisted living, and senior care networks.
  • Telehealth Management Experience: Experience overseeing telemedicine operations or clinical
    coverage logistics (highly valued but secondary to central MSO operations).
  • Education: Bachelor's degree required; MBA, MHA, or equivalent advanced degree highly
    preferred.
  • Skills: Advanced financial modeling, risk-assessment frameworks, contract negotiation expertise,
    and proficiency with healthcare analytics platforms. Advanced Excel/PowerPoint skills required.
    Claude co-work experience preferred.

Compensation

  • Base: To be determined based on experience and market
  • Bonus: Eligible — performance-based

Position Title: Support Specialist II

Summary/Objective:
The Support Specialist II serves as a technical expert and customer advocate for the 3-GIS product suite within the Esri ecosystem. This role is responsible for diagnosing complex software issues, guiding customers through best practice workflows, and ensuring a consistently exceptional support experience. You will work directly with client accounts, collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams, and help shape the future of customer success at 3-GIS.
This position requires strong technical proficiency, strong communication skills, and the ability to guide customers through various 3-GIS product challenges.

Customer Support & Technical Troubleshooting

  • Provide superior customer support and troubleshoot client issues with 3-GIS software, ensuring customers exceed expectations in their use of the platform.
  • Serve as a support representative for customer accounts, acting as a trusted advisor.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues across the 3-GIS stack, Esri products (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, Portal), and associated databases.

  • Contribute toward the development of change control processes for hosted systems when required.

Technical Configuration & System Management

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with Sales, Product, Development, and PMO teams to ensure accurate, timely solutions for customers.

Continuous Improvement & Customer Advocacy

Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist – Sourcing & Full-Cycle Recruiting | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist to manage recruitment processes from candidate sourcing through the offer stage.

This is a hands-on recruiting role for someone who can proactively identify talent, engage passive candidates, conduct effective screening interviews, and maintain organized pipelines across multiple open positions.

You’ll work across candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, ATS management, candidate communication, and offer support while maintaining a strong candidate experience throughout the hiring process.

What You’ll Own

Candidate Sourcing & Outreach

  • Source qualified candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, candidate databases, and other recruiting channels
  • Proactively identify and engage passive candidates
  • Build targeted talent pipelines based on role requirements
  • Use different sourcing strategies to reach relevant candidates
  • Maintain consistent sourcing activity across multiple open positions

Resume Review & Candidate Screening

  • Review applications and resumes against job requirements
  • Conduct candidate screening interviews
  • Assess candidates based on experience, skills, communication, and overall fit
  • Gather information on salary expectations and availability
  • Identify strong candidates to advance through the recruitment process

Full-Cycle Recruitment Coordination

  • Manage candidates from initial sourcing through the offer stage
  • Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers
  • Track interview schedules, feedback, and next steps
  • Follow up with candidates and internal stakeholders throughout the process
  • Support offer and onboarding coordination

Candidate Pipeline & ATS Management

  • Maintain accurate and organized candidate records in the ATS
  • Keep candidate stages and statuses up to date
  • Track recruiting activity across multiple open positions
  • Maintain healthy pipelines for active searches
  • Ensure candidate information and recruiting notes are properly documented

Candidate Experience

  • Maintain professional and timely communication with candidates
  • Clearly communicate interview expectations and next steps
  • Follow up consistently throughout the hiring process
  • Ensure candidates receive a positive and organized recruitment experience
  • Handle candidate questions professionally and promptly

Recruiting Metrics & Performance

  • Track recruiting activity and hiring metrics
  • Monitor sourcing, screening, interview, and hiring activity
  • Work toward recruiting KPIs and deadlines
  • Identify bottlenecks within the hiring process
  • Adjust sourcing and recruiting strategies based on pipeline performance

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in recruiting, sourcing, talent acquisition, or a related role
  • Experience managing multiple open positions simultaneously
  • Strong candidate sourcing and screening skills
  • Experience sourcing passive candidates
  • Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and/or ATS platforms
  • Comfortable conducting candidate interviews over video
  • Ability to evaluate candidates against role requirements
  • Strong ability to assess candidate communication skills and overall fit
  • Excellent spoken and written English
  • Strong organization, time management, and follow-through
  • Comfortable working toward recruiting KPIs and deadlines
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing full-cycle recruitment
  • Experience recruiting for U.S.-based companies
  • Experience sourcing across multiple industries or job functions
  • Familiarity with multiple ATS and recruiting platforms
  • Experience with high-volume or fast-paced recruiting environments
  • Experience supporting remote or international hiring
  • Familiarity with recruiting analytics and pipeline reporting

Tools & Platforms

LinkedIn Recruiter | Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) | Job Boards | Candidate Databases | Video Interview Platforms | Google Workspace / Microsoft Office

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy proactively finding candidates rather than relying only on applications
  • Can quickly understand a role and identify relevant talent
  • Conduct structured and professional candidate interviews
  • Stay organized while managing multiple searches simultaneously
  • Follow up consistently with candidates and hiring managers
  • Can assess both qualifications and communication skills
  • Care about providing candidates with a professional experience
  • Are comfortable being measured against recruiting activity and hiring outcomes

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include sourcing candidates on LinkedIn, reviewing new applications, conducting screening interviews, updating ATS records, and coordinating interviews with hiring managers.

You’ll also follow up with candidates, gather salary and availability information, maintain active pipelines, support offers, and review recruiting metrics to determine where additional sourcing or follow-up is needed.

In short: you keep the hiring pipeline moving and help turn qualified candidates into successful hires.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Qualified candidates sourced
  • Candidate screening volume and quality
  • Interview conversion rates
  • Pipeline health across open positions
  • Speed of candidate follow-up
  • Time-to-fill / time-to-hire
  • Recruiting activity against established KPIs
  • Candidate experience and communication quality
  • Accuracy and organization of ATS records

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Recruiting / Talent Acquisition Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, candidate sourcing, and screening and enjoy building strong pipelines and connecting qualified candidates with the right opportunities, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help deliver an organized, efficient, and candidate-focused hiring process.

The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Reclaim, an AI-native denial management and revenue recovery venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

We are entering a $16B+ Total Addressable Market with a gaping $ 7.5B–$10B whitespace, targeting the highly underserved mid-market segment. Currently, 30–40% of denied medical claims go uncontested because practices lack the staff and capital to contest them. This systemic failure leaves between $50,000 and $300,000 in legally earned revenue permanently abandoned at each practice every year.

Reclaim AI resolves denied and aged claims end-to-end, embedding outcome-based contingency pricing—meaning practices pay zero upfront, and we only take a cut of the dollars we successfully recover, for our target ideal customer profile (practices with $80K+ in annual recoverable claims).

Market Context

We didn’t just read market reports; we spent weeks interviewing billing managers, practice owners, revenue cycle leaders at health systems, and even digital operations leaders at major insurance companies. The dysfunction we uncovered is staggering, creating a massive opportunity for a disruptor:

  • The pain is so severe, practices are building their own tech: The frustration of payer opacity is so deep that medical billers are hiring part-time software engineers to build in-house robotic process automation (RPA) scrapers just to check claim statuses.
  • Massive, emotional write-offs: Staff carry immense guilt over these administrative losses. One small-practice assistant admitted, "I feel like we probably had to write off probably close to a million dollars" simply because they couldn't keep up with the manual follow-ups.
  • The "Payer-Side Inversion" Opportunity: We discovered that insurance companies are drowning in the exact same claims dysfunction they generate. One major payer we interviewed reported a backlog of 31,000 contested claims that consumed 80% of their staff's operational capacity, forcing emergency hires just to manage the disputes.
  • The Competition is Distracted: Well-funded Tier-1 competitors are charging $15K+ upfront licensing fees and fighting over enterprise health systems. The competitive window to capture the mid-market with a contingency-priced autonomous agent is wide open.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets
  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning
  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with practice owners and revenue cycle leaders, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

You understand the nuanced differences in denial codes, know why administrative denials (like credentialing gaps) are uniquely painful, and intuitively understand the fragmented systems (e.g., Tebra, eClinicalWorks, Availity) that billers are forced to use

jobs.description:
We are a technology-enabled financial operations partner, dedicated to helping retail suppliers and vendors drive value through deep expertise, ensure transaction accuracy using cutting-edge technology, and strengthen their financial operations with a white-glove approach. Our vision is to empower the world’s leading brands to elevate profitability through operational precision, innovative financial solutions, and a workplace culture that inspires our people and partners to achieve excellence.

Our culture thrives on collaboration, inclusivity, and connection. We believe the best results happen when every team member feels empowered to lead, contribute, and bring their unique perspective to the table. As a remotely distributed company, we make it a priority to stay closely connected by celebrating milestones, birthdays, and big wins together no matter where we are.

At STAT, you’ll find a team that works hard, has fun, and supports one another every step of the way. We’re ambitious, driven, and passionate about the work we do, but just as importantly, we’re kind, approachable, and genuinely excited to grow together.

What You'll Do

STAT is expanding its Amazon practice and we are looking for a rare combination: someone who understands Amazon deeply, not just the industry around it, who can both execute the work and win new business independently. This role is the engine for growing STAT's network of Amazon agency partners.

This is not a role for someone who understands recovery or deductions generically. The Amazon marketplace is its own world, 1P Vendor Central dynamics, co-op structures, chargeback mechanics, and you need to navigate that world fluently on day one.

This role is structured as a doer + seller combined: you'll pitch the partnership, close it, and get into the work alongside the client. That model is the norm in this space and is not as rare or daunting as it might sound in other retail verticals.

Strategic Partnership Management

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive partnership strategy targeting Amazon-focused agencies, with an initial emphasis on agencies where STAT can establish deep, embedded relationships.
  • Identify key agency partners, understand their client mix and pain points, and align STAT's Amazon services to create mutually beneficial partnerships.
  • Continuously assess market trends, to identify gaps where STAT's expertise is most defensible and valuable.
  • Work to displace incumbent providers at larger enterprise agencies through demonstrating superior 1P depth and outcomes.

Relationship Building

  • Establish and maintain strong, lasting relationships with key stakeholders within Amazon agencies.
  • Serve as STAT's primary point of contact and ambassador in all Amazon agency partnership discussions.
  • Foster ongoing collaboration between agency teams and STAT's internal Amazon delivery team to ensure client outcomes exceed expectations and deepen the partnership.

Business Development

  • Source, pitch, and close new agency partnership agreements, owning the full sales cycle from first contact through signed partnership.
  • Develop joint business plans with agency partners that clearly articulate growth opportunities for both parties.
  • Monitor the performance of active partnerships and proactively suggest service improvements, expansions, or new use cases.
  • Leverage STAT's existing client pipeline to supplement outbound efforts and provide warm introductions into new agency relationships.

Amazon Delivery & Execution

  • Roll up your sleeves and contribute directly to Amazon account work, auditing, deduction recovery, Vendor Central issue resolution, so you can speak credibly about what STAT does and represent it accurately in every pitch.
  • Stay current on Amazon's evolving vendor and seller policies, co-op agreements, chargeback categories, and platform changes that affect STAT's clients and agency partners.

Who You Are

  • You have hands-on Amazon expertise, specifically Vendor Central (1P) and can hold a sophisticated conversation about co-op, chargebacks, shortages, and margin recovery without needing a subject matter expert beside you
  • You have worked at or extensively with Amazon agencies, giving you a working understanding of how agencies are structured, how they serve brand clients, and what problems they are trying to solve for those clients
  • You have an existing network within the Amazon agency ecosystem and can walk in with warm relationships rather than starting from zero
  • You are comfortable being a doer and a seller simultaneously, closing the deal and then doing some of the work is the norm in this world, and you thrive in that model
  • You are highly self-motivated, independent, and results-driven with a verifiable track record of building and closing new partnerships or accounts
  • You are comfortable operating remotely in a fast-moving environment and do not require a hub location (NWA, Minneapolis, or otherwise) to be effective, your network and your calendar are your office
  • If your background is from a large brand rather than an agency, you compensate with an exceptional sales pitch, a strong professional network, and the ability to tap into STAT's existing client pipeline to generate early momentum
  • You reflect STAT's values: Strategic, Nimble, Inquisitive, Proactive, Empathetic, and Straightforward

Ideal Background

  • 8+ years of experience working directly in or alongside Amazon agencies (account management, business development, or a senior-level delivery role)
  • Deep, working knowledge of Amazon Vendor Central: co-op agreements, deduction and chargeback categories, operational compliance, and 1P vs. 3P tradeoffs
  • Demonstrated success building and maintaining agency or channel partnerships—not just managing accounts, but growing them
  • Familiarity with the competitive landscape of Amazon service providers and a clear point of view on where STAT's differentiation is strongest

Benefits

  • Disability and life insurance coverage
  • Access to virtual healthcare resources
  • Flexible paid time off policy
  • Paid parental leave
