About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building alarge and complex product ecosystemthat serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a moderncheckout experience and customizable widgets(each a standalone SPA),donor, organization, and partner portals,admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset.

About the role

Fundraise Up is building high-trust donation and fundraising experiences that help nonprofits grow their impact. We are looking for a UX Researcher to strengthen how UX research informs product decisions across the company.

You will focus on two areas: leading complex, ambiguous, high-impact UX research that informs product strategy, and building a scalable UX Research practice within the Design team. Designers will run simpler studies independently, while you provide the process, coaching, quality guardrails, and support that make research a consistent habit.

You will be the dedicated UX Research expert within the Research Team, working alongside Product and Marketing Researchers who will support you across your projects. You will bring deep UX Research expertise while collaborating closely with the wider Product, Design, and Analytics teams.

What You'll Do

  • Act as an active UX Research evangelist and change agent: proactively identify opportunities, coach and challenge colleagues, launch new initiatives.
  • Own and grow the UX Research practice: build a pragmatic research process for Design team, enable designers to run appropriate research independently, and create clear quality guardrails without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Lead high-impact research from the quarterly plan and run it end-to-end: intake brief → write methodology → conduct research → analyze → synthesize → present → push actions.
  • Choose the right method: interviews, usability tests, concept tests, surveys, desk research, competitive scans or others — based on uncertainty level, business goals, and timeline.
  • Run your work independently: access to tools/data, participant scheduling and confirmations, session logistics, note-taking, and documentation — no hand-holding.
  • Work closely with Product Analytics to connect quantitative and qualitative evidence. We work together and show a product manager a full picture of user behavior.
  • Experiment with new approaches and tools, from moderated and unmoderated testing to emerging AI-enabled methods such as synthetic users, where they can add real value.
  • Be the user's best friend: ensure user needs and constraints are represented in product decisions – not just opinions.

Requirements

  • Proven experience running research end-to-end with high ownership.
  • Experience working across both B2C and B2B products and audiences.
  • Fluent English — all participants are English-speaking; you moderate and present in English.
  • Regularly collect input from Sales, CS, Support, Marketing, Analytics and turn it into testable research questions.
  • High research quality bar: correct research methods, structured methodology, predictable timelines, ethical practice.
  • Use recruiting platforms and handle logistics yourself: access, scheduling, confirmations, tool setup, etc.
  • Use AI tools to speed up ops and synthesis (guides, notes, tagging/themes, survey drafts, summaries) while keeping human judgment and methodological rigor where it matters.
  • Be the team’s source of new knowledge: run a “research radar” across internal learnings, market/competitor moves, and high-signal UX/product sources, then share regular updates so the team stays current and avoids blind spots.
  • At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. You should already be using AI meaningfully in your work. We will not teach you how to use AI, but we will give you everything you need, like unlimited Claude and support from AI-experienced colleagues.
  • Bring exceptional empathy and care for people: our users are nonprofits and donors—people doing good in the world—so you approach participants with respect, sensitivity, and high ethical standards.

Strong plus

  • NN/g certifications.
  • Academic/scientific research background (graduate/PhD track).
  • PostHog / Tableau (or similar analytics tools).
  • Productboard (or other insights repository tools).
  • Mentoring/teaching (workshops, onboarding, sharing research craft).

At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool — not an experimental one

We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. You should already be using AI meaningfully in your work and understand where it adds value and how it can improve the way you operate.

Why work with us

  • A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds
  • Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders
  • Flat structure: no politics, just great work with great people
  • Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next
  • Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is €4,100 - €5,200 gross.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

At Ironmark, we make marketing easier.

You’ll serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, coordinate print and digital marketing campaigns, manage projects from initiation through delivery, and work closely with customers, vendors, sales partners, and internal teams to keep work accurate, on schedule, and moving forward.

You’ll need to understand the details behind the work: specifications, estimates, files, proofs, timelines, production requirements, workflows, and systems. At the same time, you’ll be expected to understand your customers’ businesses well enough to spot opportunities, solve problems, and help grow the relationship.

  • Assist in escalating and resolving complex client concerns when necessary.

Business Development & Operations Lead

Remote | Full-time | 40-hours/week
Rate: $6 to $8/hour, with the final rate to be determined during the final interview.

About Pillar Health Solutions ()

Pillar Health Solutions is a growing healthcare company that partners with medical practices to provide insurance-supported dietary and exercise counseling programs for patients.

Our model connects physicians and their patients with dietitians, virtual trainers, and operational support designed to improve patient engagement and continuity of care.

We are entering an important growth stage and are looking for a Business Development & Operations Lead who can help expand our physician partnerships while strengthening the operational systems and client experience supporting that growth.

This is not a traditional back-office Operations Manager position.

We are looking for someone who can operate as a trusted extension of the leadership team: part business developer, part client success leader, part operator, and part strategic problem solver.

What You Will Own

Physician Acquisition & Business Growth

A major priority for this role is helping Pillar Health Solutions grow its network of physician and medical-practice partners.

You will:

  • Develop and execute practical strategies for attracting new physician and clinic partnerships

  • Identify opportunities to reach physicians, practice owners, office managers, and other healthcare decision-makers

  • Support organic marketing and local-market growth initiatives

  • Help develop physician-facing messaging, success stories, testimonials, and other materials that strengthen Pillar's value proposition

  • Research new channels, tools, partnerships, and approaches for increasing qualified opportunities

You do not need to be a career marketer, but you should understand how businesses grow and be able to contribute thoughtful, executable ideas.

Discovery Calls & Client Conversion

You will help convert interested medical practices into active Pillar partners.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting or facilitating discovery calls with prospective physician partners

  • Explaining Pillar's services and patient-support model confidently

  • Communicating fees, billing structure, workflow, and partnership expectations clearly

  • Understanding the prospective practice's needs and identifying how Pillar can support them

  • Following up on opportunities and moving qualified prospects toward partnership

  • Continuously improving the discovery and conversion process based on feedback and results

Success in this position requires someone who is comfortable speaking directly with physicians, business owners, and senior decision-makers.

Physician, Patient & Program Operations

Once partnerships are established, you will help ensure that the experience remains strong for physicians and patients.

You will:

  • Serve as a key operational contact for physician partners

  • Monitor feedback from physicians and patients and take appropriate action

  • Coordinate with dietitians, virtual trainers, administrative staff, and virtual assistants

  • Support thoughtful matching between patients, dietitians, and virtual trainers when appropriate

  • Monitor patient engagement and identify concerns before they become escalations

  • Address service issues, complaints, and operational breakdowns

  • Help establish appropriate check-ins across the patient, dietitian, trainer, and physician relationship

Because patient experience can directly affect program continuation and business performance, this role requires someone who notices problems early and acts on them.

Founder Partnership & Executive Communication

You will work closely with Pillar Health Solutions leadership and should be comfortable communicating directly with a founder.

Initially, this may include a short daily business update meeting.

You will be expected to:

  • Prepare and drive the agenda rather than waiting for leadership to determine what should be discussed

  • Provide concise updates on projects, priorities, wins, risks, and unresolved issues

  • Explain not only what happened, but why it happened

  • Present recommended next steps and anticipated outcomes

  • Bring thoughtful options instead of open-ended problems

  • Negotiate priorities, expectations, and timelines when necessary

  • Provide respectful pushback when an idea may not be practical or when another priority should come first

  • Maintain transparency even when progress is slower than expected

We are looking for someone who can disagree professionally, communicate difficult information tactfully, and remain levelheaded under pressure.

AI & Technology Integration

Pillar wants AI to become a practical part of how the business operates.

You will:

  • Identify opportunities where AI can improve existing workflows

  • Research tools independently when a business problem arises

  • Use AI for research, analysis, documentation, communication, marketing support, and process improvement

We are looking for practical AI literacy, not simply someone who has used ChatGPT occasionally.

Operational Excellence

Although growth is an immediate priority, you will also help strengthen Pillar's operational foundation.

This may include:

  • Monitoring business and client KPIs

  • Improving workflows as operational gaps become visible

  • Maintaining accurate client, physician, patient, billing, and reporting information

  • Supporting consistent naming conventions and documentation

  • Reviewing processes for accuracy and efficiency

  • Creating or improving SOPs when a documented process is genuinely needed

  • Supporting scheduling, invoicing, reporting, and administrative coordination

  • Helping the company prepare operationally as the number of physician partners and patients increases

As Pillar grows, the scope of the position may expand into greater leadership and team-management responsibilities.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of relevant experience across business operations, executive support, business development, customer success, healthcare operations, or a related field

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leaders, founders, executives, physicians, or business owners

  • Strong client-facing communication and relationship-management skills

  • Ability to manage several responsibilities simultaneously in a startup or rapidly changing environment

  • Experience solving problems independently without waiting for detailed instructions

  • Strong written and verbal communication

  • Confidence facilitating meetings and business conversations

  • Ability to organize information and communicate progress clearly

  • Strong judgment when dealing with sensitive or difficult conversations

  • Comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and processes independently

  • Practical experience using AI tools for business or productivity

  • High attention to detail, particularly where client information, billing, reporting, or financial accuracy is involved

Highly Preferred

  • Healthcare practice, healthcare startup, wellness, medical services, or physician-facing experience

  • Experience supporting a startup founder or small-business owner

  • Experience conducting discovery, sales, partnership, or client-conversion calls

  • Exposure to physician acquisition or healthcare business development

  • Experience with local or organic marketing

  • Customer Success Management experience

  • Chief of Staff or senior Executive Assistant experience

  • Experience introducing new technologies or AI-driven workflows into an organization

jobs.excerpt: At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions.
jobs.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.

As an Analytics Engineer (Finance & Modeling), you'll own the metrics, reporting and reconciliation our financial decisions rest on, turning subscription and transaction data across OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall and Custody Navigator into numbers the business can defend. As that foundation becomes automatic, the work shifts toward forecasting and modeling.

You won't start from scratch. Our dbt project is live on Databricks with a star-schema finance mart in production and documented in Unity Catalog. What's missing is the layer on top, and that layer is yours. We also run an internal AI agent that answers business questions in Slack off the semantic layer, so every metric you define and test becomes a question Finance can ask directly rather than queue.

What you'll accomplish:

  • Governed metrics. Add the definitions the finance mart doesn't have yet (ARR, renewal rate, churn, CAC), versioned in dbt and documented in Unity Catalog, with the tests that make each one defensible, and wired into the agent so Finance can ask them directly.
  • Reporting Finance can run without you. Move the recurring finance pack into marimo, retire the Tableau views behind it, and turn a monthly hand-build into something that runs on a schedule.
  • Numbers that reconcile. Reconcile transactions across the app stores, payment processors, subscription systems and the ledger, with automated checks that alert rather than surface at close. Route discrepancies upstream with the evidence attached and turn each one into a test. You build the checks and escalate. Accounting owns the treatment.
  • Forecasting for Finance. Cohort subscriber and revenue projection, and aggregate renewal and retention forecasting, feeding the CFO's forecast and board reporting. LTV by acquisition source, feeding paid spend allocation with Growth. Pricing and promo impact, modeled before we ship rather than measured after. Individual churn propensity and uplift follow once there's a retention motion ready to act on the scores.
  • Models ship as scored tables in dbt and Unity Catalog, with tests, lineage and a definition the agent can answer from. Not as notebooks.

Who you are:

  • Statistically rigorous. You know why a cohort curve is the wrong shape, what a model is leaking, and when a result is noise.
  • Fluent in finance, and unwilling to let a number you can't explain go out the door. When two systems disagree, you find out why and tell the people upstream.
  • An engineer who owns the number end to end, from a CFO's question through the model, the test, the report and the conversation that follows. A spreadsheet nobody can reproduce reads to you as a liability.
  • AI-proficient in practice, not in theory. Claude Code, coding agents and agent SDKs are part of our daily loop, and we expect you to already work this way. A lot of what used to be a week of modeling work is now an afternoon, and we're hiring for people who have internalized that.
  • Willing to wear several hats. This is a small team supporting four brands. Some weeks you're deep in a retention model, some weeks you're chasing an app store discrepancy or unblocking someone else's dashboard. The scope above is the center of the role, not a fence around it.
  • Motivated by work that matters. Families rely on these products during real moments in their lives.

What you bring:

  • 3+ years in analytics engineering, data science, BI engineering or advanced analytics.
  • Statistical modeling shipped into a business process: forecasting, survival or cohort analysis, or propensity.
  • Measuring the lift from a price change or a growth experiment. You don't need to have designed the test, but you need to be able to read the result honestly and say what it's worth.
  • Subscription metrics you've built and defended to a finance stakeholder: ARR/MRR, renewal, churn, LTV/CAC, or cohort revenue.
  • Strong SQL and real dimensional modeling. You've designed marts, not just queried them.
  • Python and Git as daily habits.
Nice to have, not a dealbreaker:
  • dbt, Databricks and Unity Catalog, or a comparable lakehouse.
  • Reconciling transactional data to a financial system of record.
  • Code-first notebook reporting (marimo, Hex, Streamlit, Quarto).

Why Join?
We’re redefining family technology.
In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods.
Scale meets startup energy.
With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day.
Purpose-driven. Performance-focused. People-first.
Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters.
How we support you:
  • Medical: In Tandem pays 100% of the premium for employees AND 99% for all additional family members

  • Supportive and flexible working environment – work from anywhere!
Come As You Are!

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

Responsibilities

﻿

﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

5. Experimentation & Optimization

  • Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
  • Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Home Office

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

  • You measurably move the needle - more modules migrated per sprint, faster PR turnarounds - without a spike in production bugs.

  • The team gets better because of you: PRs are clearer, test coverage grows, documentation stays current, and the same mistakes stop repeating.

Modernize a real .NET + SQL Server stack into something you'd be proud of

You'll:

  • Upgrade legacy services to current .NET (LTS where it makes sense), untangling architecture boundaries and fixing the performance issues that have been "known" for years.

  • Push toward a proper API-layer architecture - RESTful, versioned - built for correctness and maintainability, not just "it works."

  • Get your hands dirty with SQL Server: query performance, indexing, transactional correctness. If there are data pipeline needs (Kafka, etc.), you'll help build those too.

What success looks like:

  • Legacy surface area shrinks sprint over sprint. Critical paths live in modern code. Fewer "oh, that's still in the old system" conversations.

  • APIs get faster and more reliable. Database hot spots stop waking people up at night.

Own it like it's yours - especially because this is healthcare

You'll:

  • Build with security and privacy as defaults, not afterthoughts. Least privilege, safe data handling, the works. This is healthcare - getting it wrong isn't an option.

  • Put real quality guardrails in place: automated tests that actually catch things, CI that blocks bad changes, structured logging, observability that tells you what's happening before users do.

  • Review code thoughtfully, have honest architectural conversations, and raise the bar without being a jerk about it.

What success looks like:

  • Fewer severity-1 incidents. When something does go wrong, root cause takes hours, not days.

  • Automated test coverage grows meaningfully on modernized code. The team stops relying on "just test it manually."

Work with real humans to ship things that matter

You'll:

  • Partner with analysts, stakeholders, and other engineers to turn business problems into working software - not just technically correct software, but software that actually solves the problem.

  • Help build delivery plans that are honest about trade-offs. "Right" vs. "right now" is a real tension - you'll help the team navigate it with pragmatic milestones.

What success looks like:

  • Delivery is predictable. Customer onboarding milestones are met. Features ship with confidence, not crossed fingers.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years building and shipping production systems. Not side projects - real software with real users solving skills; able to work independently and collaboratively in fastmoving teams

  • Some C# and modern .NET experience (Core and beyond). Especially in large codebases and you've done meaningful refactoring and migration work, not just greenfield.

  • Strong SQL Server chops - schema design, query tuning, performance troubleshooting. You've worked on data-heavy applications where the database wasn't an afterthought.

  • Cloud experience with Azure and/or AWS. Azure is particularly relevant here.

  • API design experience - you've built and maintained service-oriented architectures with real versioning, auth, reliability, and testing practices.

  • You actually use AI coding tools as a daily driver. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar - and not just for autocomplete. You've used agents for multi-file refactors, migrations, test generation, and review workflows. You have opinions about what works and what doesn't.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • You've actually done a legacy ASP.NET / .NET Framework modernization before. You know where the bodies are buried and you have the scars to prove it. Bonus points for Azure modernization patterns.

  • You communicate clearly. Good PR descriptions, straightforward design docs, pragmatic collaboration, low ego. We don't need a rockstar - we need someone the team trusts.

  • Experience with distributed systems tooling - Kafka, event-driven architectures, or working with Postgres alongside SQL Server.

  • Front-end experience with Angular and/or React/Next.js.

  • You've helped establish agent-friendly engineering practices: writing repo instructions that AI tools can follow, breaking work into agent-sized tasks, setting up CI guardrails for AI-generated code, feature flags, canary deployments - any part of the progressive delivery toolkit.

  • Background in regulated domains (healthcare, fintech, payments) where "move fast and break things" will get you fired.

Working closely with the Financial Controller, you'll take ownership of established finance processes and controls, spotting issues early and resolving them before they become bigger problems.

Success comes from independently owning your area, applying good judgement and creating confidence that the everyday finance operation is under control.

WHAT THIS LOOKS LIKE IN PRACTICE

Keep Finance Operations Running Reliably

You'll create confidence in the everyday flow of financial activity through the business.

You'll:

  • coordinate core finance operations across invoicing, expenses, payments and financial administration
  • maintain accurate and complete financial records and supporting information
  • ensure established finance processes and controls are followed consistently
  • keep financial trackers and systems current so others can rely on the information within them
  • identify missing, incorrect or unusual information and resolve discrepancies proactively
  • maintain clear records and audit trails that support effective financial control.

Coordinate Expenses & Financial Compliance

You'll help make spending easy to understand, appropriately controlled and accurately reflected in our financial information.

You'll:

  • coordinate the financial administration and control of employee expenses and corporate card activity
  • ensure transactions have appropriate receipts, coding, VAT treatment and supporting information
  • reconcile expense and corporate card information against financial records
  • support accurate allocation of costs across the business
  • help colleagues understand and follow expense processes and policies

Where travel or expense systems support these processes (E.G. Expensify), you'll help colleagues use them effectively and maintain the finance information required from them. Ownership of the wider travel operating model or technology does not sit within the scope of this role.

Support Billing & Cash Flow

You'll help ensure Quadmark has clear visibility of money coming into and moving through the business.

You'll:

  • coordinate accurate and timely client invoicing
  • maintain the records and information that support cash-flow visibility
  • support reconciliation of WIP, FIA and other relevant cash-flow information
  • identify discrepancies or delays and work with the appropriate people to resolve them
  • provide reliable financial information that supports the Financial Controller's oversight of working capital and liquidity.

Create Confidence at Month End

You'll make sure the operational finance information needed for month end is accurate, complete and ready when required.

You'll:

  • complete and support reconciliations within agreed month-end rhythms
  • validate underlying financial information before it is used for reporting
  • ensure expense, freelancer, invoicing and other operational finance records are complete
  • investigate differences and resolve routine issues independently
  • support VAT and other periodic finance reviews by maintaining accurate underlying records and providing relevant context

Make Finance Easy to Work With

You'll be an approachable and dependable point of contact for everyday finance processes.

You'll:

  • help colleagues understand how to navigate finance processes correctly
  • make sure new starters understand the finance processes and systems relevant to them
  • maintain useful guidance and process documentation
  • recognise recurring questions or friction and suggest practical improvements.

Strengthen How We Work

Ownership means understanding why a process exists, not just completing it.

You'll:

  • spot recurring errors, unnecessary manual work or unclear ownership
  • recommend practical improvements to everyday finance processes
  • share knowledge so important processes aren't dependent on one person.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • 3+ years’ experience in finance operations, accounts payable/receivable or bookkeeping role
  • Working towards or holding a relevant qualification (AAT, ACCA or CIMA)
  • Hands on experience with Xero, Expensify and other similar accounting systems
  • Strong Excel skills and comfort reconciling data across multiple sources
  • A clear, confident communicator who can explain finance processes to non-finance colleagues.

jobs.description:
What We Do

At Terabase Energy, we believe that digitalization and automation will drive the next wave of innovation and cost reduction in large scale solar.  To fully unlock the potential of this opportunity, Terabase is developing an interconnected software and construction automation platform.  We work alongside project developers, owners, and engineering & construction firms to support the design, optimization, and construction of huge solar projects around the world. Our team is a blend of solar-industry veterans and newbies, thought-leaders, dreamers, software, electrical and mechanical engineers, coders, product managers, project managers, and sales and marketing professionals. We are based in Northern California, with several other offices in the United States and around the world.  If all of this piques your interest, we’d love to hear from you!

Position Overview

The Sr. Controls Engineer – OT SCADA Projects leads the design, configuration, commissioning, and support of plant control systems for utility-scale solar, storage, and hybrid renewable energy projects. This engineer works with minimal oversight, applies expert knowledge of grid functionality and Utility/ISO standards, mentors junior engineers, and contributes to product standards. Approximately 80% of this role is project execution, while up to 20% is continuous improvement and product development.

Responsibilities

Project Execution & Technical Delivery (~80%)

  • Lead end-to-end controls design for utility-scale solar, BESS, and hybrid projects, including review of the project scope to identify project-specific requirements and deviations from the standard Terabase controls product offering.
  • Program and commission SEL controllers using AcSELerator; develop control logic in Codesys using IEC 61131-3 structured text and continuous function charts
  • Follow the controls development process for any project-specific development work, including documentation of requirements, logic development, testing in a simulated/lab environment and documentation of test results.
  • Implement and validate closed-loop Active Power and Reactive Power, AVR and PFR Algorithms
  • Maintain version control for all code artifacts according to established version control procedure (Bitbucket)
  • Efficiently troubleshoot complex SCADA and controls issues using Wireshark, breakpoints, cross-reference, and watch list tools
  • Produce project deliverables: System Architecture Diagrams, Control Narratives, Logic Diagrams, commissioning documents, and operator manuals

Product & Process Improvement (~20%)

  • Contribute to new feature development and bug fixes in collaboration with the Product Engineering team
  • Review documentation prepared by junior controls engineers (technical and non-technical)
  • Lead the Continuous Improvement and Lessons Learned program, feed field insights back into product standards and templates
  • Coach junior engineers through FAT preparation and customer-facing presentation

Stakeholder Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as primary controls technical contact for EPCs, asset owners, and grid operators through project execution, FAT, and commissioning
  • Lead FATs as formal presentations; communicate to non-technical audiences with supporting materials prepared in advance
  • Flag technical risks and schedule pressures to project management team with context and proposed solutions
  • Maintain Jira tickets daily with thorough detail; enforce Jira best practices with junior engineers

Expectations & Success Indicators

  • Deliver high-quality work independently across multiple concurrent projects with ownership and urgency
  • Leverage standardized platforms and tools to work efficiently
  • Ensure 100% adherence to Terabase quality processes; enforce standards with junior engineers
  • Mentor junior controls engineers through technical guidance, code review, and FAT coaching
  • Project deliverables completed on time, within scope, and meeting Utility/ISO regulatory standards
  • Jira, version control, and documentation consistently maintained without follow-up from management
  • Recognized internally and externally as the go-to technical authority on Terabase SCADA and OT controls
  • Travel up to 10% for on-site commissioning, FAT, and customer engagements

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Science, or related field
  • 5+ years of IEC 61131-3/PLC programming experience, preferably in Codesys or AcSELerator environment
  • 3+ years of utility-scale renewable power plant controls experience (solar, BESS, or hybrid), including project-specific development work, Factory Acceptance Test (FAT), commissioning and Site Acceptance Test (SAT)

Technical Skills

  • Expert IEC 61131-3 programming; primary tooling is AcSELerator (SEL controllers) and Codesys, including Diagram Builder, traces, breakpoints, and watch lists
  • Extensive knowledge of industrial protocols: Modbus-TCP, DNP3, OPC-UA, C37.118, etc.
  • Expert knowledge of grid functionality: Primary Frequency Response (PFR), Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR), Active/Reactive power closed loop control, and capacitor bank functionality – including the underlying grid rationale, not just controller behavior
  • Proficiency with Utility/ISO testing and interconnection requirements (ERCOT, PJM, BPA, IEEE 2800, NERC, etc.)
  • Experience with Power Plant Controller (PPC) design, configuration, and commissioning
  • Familiarity with PSCAD, PSSE, and/or TSAT modeling processes for utility-scale sites
  • Experience with hardware in the loop (HIL) hardware, such as RTDS, OPAL-RT, Speedgoat, Typhoon, etc.

Benefits

Compensation And Benefits

This role offers a base salary of $150,000 – $190,000 (DOE).

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each posted range individual pay is determined (and may be greater or higher) dependent on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Ascensus is the leading independent technology and service platform powering savings plans across America, providing products and expertise that help nearly 16 million people save for a better today and tomorrow.

Section 1: Position Summary

This role is responsible for creating, analyzing, managing, and delivering comprehensive reports of bank and insurance company owned life insurance (BOLI & ICOLI) policies for an assigned group of clients. They work closely with stakeholders and the Carrier Data Coordinator to ensure accuracy and relevance. Key responsibilities include data analysis and report development. This role develops and maintains a full understanding of trends for each client’s BOLI/ICOLI portfolio and performs detailed analysis to ensure accuracy of reports. This role has a direct impact on the ongoing relationship with BOLI and ICOLI clients.

Section 2: Job Functions, Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Client Reporting

  • Develops and maintains an in-depth understanding of the reporting needs for each client.
  • Researches and resolves any issues specific to each client concerning products, policy values, crediting rates, and other information in reports delivered.
  • Prepares, reviews, and delivers all client reporting.
  • Performs quality control checks, reports to supervisor and Relationship Manager on client satisfaction, and any other items necessary to assure customer loyalty.
  • Handles large volume of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) with necessary sensitivity

BOLI/ICOLI Specific Knowledge & Interpretive Analysis

  • Understands the differences and similarities between general account, separate account, and hybrid account insurance policies.
  • Comprehensive understanding of separate account BOLI/ICOLI policies and related stable value features.
  • Comprehensive understanding of various product mortality treatment features.
  • Ability to read and interpret life insurance policy and related document provisions that may impact policy performance. Knowledge of accounting concepts and other results that may impact reporting and policy decisions.
  • Understanding of how tax, regulatory, and GAAP standards impact BOLI/ICOLI.

Analytical

  • Gathers and analyzes data from various sources to identify trends and draw meaningful conclusions while developing an in-depth understanding of each client’s BOLI/ICOLI products.
  • Develops a process and methodology for regular yield analysis and identification of changes relevant to each client’s portfolio.
  • Performs various financial functions and cell manipulation in Microsoft Excel including Internal Rate of Return (IRR), VLOOKUP, etc.
  • Creation of ad hoc schedules and reports based on client requests/needs.
  • Strong understanding of time value of money concepts.
  • Solves complex problems and improves processes.

Procedural

  • Maintains knowledge of proprietary BOLI/ICOLI administration system and its functions.
  • Assists in the implementation and ongoing maintenance and application of regulatory requirements for BOLI/ICOLI clients.
  • Contributes to development of executive-level reports, materials, and administrative standards for clients, and assists with the implementation of changes.
  • Develops and maintains full understanding of day-to-day workflow processes required for assigned client plans.
  • Self-starter working in a fast-paced, demanding environment under tight deadlines.
  • Works independently to manage assigned workload while working under pressure and can readily adapt to changing priorities.

Collaborative

  • Assists in facilitation of communication between the different business lines represented in Ascensus’ Newport team for all assigned clients.
  • Collaborates with others, seeks/conveys information, initiates action, adapts to change and openly shares knowledge with colleagues.
  • Participates in setting department standards, processes, and procedures.

Travel: Up to 5%

Become a part of our caring community

Join Humana as a Case Manager within the Inclusa/Humana team, where you will serve members in the Wisconsin Family Care (FC) program. Reporting to the Manager of Care Coaching, you will provide comprehensive case management services to frail elders and adults with intellectual, developmental, or physical disabilities. Let's make a difference together! You will support members in Eau Claire and surrounding areas.

Job Description

Main responsibilities:

  • Assess members health and safety needs to identify their strengths, interests, and preferences to develop a comprehensive Member Care Plan (MCP).
  • Coordinate with a Field Care Nurse to provide services that address members' health and safety needs, ensuring the team provides support in the least restrictive environment following the MCP.
  • Conduct face-to-face social assessments with members upon enrollment and at minimum, every six months, typically at the member's residence.
  • Conduct quarterly in-person visits and maintain monthly contact with members by phone.
  • Arrange support services for members, including those related to social integration, community resources, employment, housing, and other non-medical needs.
  • Ensure cost-effective service delivery.
  • Evaluate risk factors and provide education to members.
  • Maintain accurate documentation including case notes, service authorizations, and updates to the MCP.


Use your skills to make an impact

40

Lead operations and scale a fast-growing UK content agency as Senior Ops Manager.

£3,000–£4,000 | Full-time | UK timezone


We're Jamal and Ali, the founders of Your Social Currency - a fast-growing social media agency working with some of the biggest founders, entrepreneurs, and CEOs in the UK.

Our team helps high-level personal brands create content that actually performs - from raw footage all the way through to publishing and growth. We're building something serious, and we're proud of the calibre of clients we work with and the results we deliver.

We care about clean execution just as much as creative quality, and we're building a team of switched-on people who feel the same way. If that sounds like your kind of environment, you'll fit right in!

We’re looking for a Senior Operations Manager.

This is a high-level strategic leadership position, not an execution-heavy or admin role. As Jamal and Ali step back from day-to-day operations, you will essentially run the operational engine of the business, leading systems, strategy, and accountability across the agency.

You will architect and optimise agency workflows, standard operating procedures (SOPs), AI-driven automations, and financial oversight. You won't be doing the task-level delivery work yourself—instead, you'll manage and empower our Account Managers and production team leads to deliver exceptional results reliably.

You will serve as the final point of escalation for operational or client delivery issues before they ever reach the founders. Your goal is to build an autonomous, scalable business structure that runs smoothly without founder friction.

You will:

  • own overall operational architecture, agency efficiency, and operational profitability
  • build, refine, and enforce SOPs, quality benchmarks, and automated workflows across the agency
  • manage, mentor, and hold Account Managers accountable for team output and client satisfaction
  • leverage AI tools, integrations, and modern software to streamline production cycles
  • maintain financial oversight, monitoring margins, capacity planning, and resource allocation
  • act as the final firewall and escalation point for major client or delivery risks before founder involvement
  • drive strategic growth and scaling initiatives in tandem with executive vision

You are not:

  • doing day-to-day editing, clipping, or content task execution
  • managing individual task cards or acting as a project coordinator
  • a frontline account manager dealing with daily client queries
  • an executive assistant or admin support worker

You are the operational leader ensuring the business operates with complete stability, profitability, and accountability.

If you naturally think:
“How do we automate this?” / “Is this process scalable?” / “Are our margins healthy?” / “How do I empower my team to solve this without me?” …then you’ll thrive in this role.

In this role, you will:

📋 Design and oversee scalable operational systems and agency-wide SOPs

🤖 Implement AI tools and custom workflow automations to eliminate manual overhead

👥 Lead, manage, and hold Account Managers accountable for client health and team delivery

💰 Oversee operational finances, resource allocation, software costs, and delivery margins

🛡️ Serve as the final escalation buffer for high-level risks before they reach founders

🔄 Optimize end-to-end workflows from client onboarding through to ongoing retention

📅 Lead strategic operational reviews and high-level leadership alignment meetings

📈 Forecast capacity needs and plan recruitment strategy alongside company growth

🧹 Drive operational excellence, governance, and accountability culture cross-functionally

⚡ Enable the founders to focus on strategic vision while you run day-to-day operations

This is a full-time role aligned with UK hours (9am–5pm, Monday to Friday).

What Success Looks Like

  • The team starts Monday with complete clarity
  • Work moves daily instead of in bursts of panic
  • Deliverables don’t sit unassigned or forgotten
  • Editors and support staff know exactly what they own
  • Clients aren’t chasing for updates
  • Meetings become shorter because the operational reality is already known
  • Deadlines are hit consistently
  • Problems are surfaced before they become emergencies
  • The business feels calm, controlled, and operationally sharp

Requirements

To excel in this role, you need:

✅ 3–7+ years of operations leadership experience in small to mid-sized agency environments

✅ Proven track record of designing SOPs, scaling systems, and driving organizational accountability

✅ High fluency with AI tools, workflow automation platforms (e.g. Make, Zapier), and modern tech stacks

✅ Experience managing leaders and Account Managers rather than direct execution staff

✅ Strong financial oversight skills (margins, budgeting, capacity planning, cost management)

✅ Exceptional executive communication, conflict resolution, and problem-solving abilities

✅ Decisive leadership style with the confidence to run the company operations autonomously

Brownie points for:

⭐ Direct experience in fast-moving social media, video content, or creative production agencies

⭐ Experience aiding founder transition from operational management to strategic guidance

This role is a great fit for someone who dislikes vague ownership, messy processes, and unfinished loops.

The kind of person who naturally asks: who owns this, when is it due, and what’s blocking progress?

Someone who stays calm under pressure while still creating urgency when needed, and who brings structure to fast-moving environments without creating confusion or drama.

You won’t wait for problems to become obvious before stepping in. You spot risks early, keep things moving, and take pride in clean execution, clear communication, and smooth operations.

If managing lots of moving parts at once sounds energising rather than overwhelming, this role will likely feel very natural to you!

You’ll Probably Struggle In This Role If…

  • You dislike chasing people or enforcing accountability
  • You prefer brainstorming over operational execution
  • You wait for founders to create structure for you
  • You struggle to manage lots of moving pieces simultaneously
  • You avoid difficult follow-ups when deadlines slip
  • You rely on reminders instead of proactively driving workflow forward
  • You confuse being busy with actually being in control

Benefits

What’s in it for you?

jobs.description:
Senior Manager, SEO & GEO

Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels

Push the boundaries of discovery. In your sweatpants.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of SEO & GEO to lead the next evolution of organic discovery at Parallels.

This role will own our strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. SEO remains a critical growth engine for Parallels - driving visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and category authority. At the same time, discovery is rapidly expanding into generative AI experiences, where customers increasingly ask tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot what to buy, how to solve problems, and which products to trust.

The Senior Manager of SEO & GEO will ensure Parallels continues to win in search today while building a leadership position in the AI-driven discovery channels of tomorrow.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone who has deep SEO expertise and is excited to define the emerging GEO playbook. You will strengthen our technical SEO foundation, scale our content and authority strategy, and lead the company approach to improving how Parallels is surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended by AI-powered platforms.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Communications, and Channel teams to make Parallels more discoverable across the full customer journey - from traditional search queries to AI-generated recommendations.

Your team is global and works across multiple time zones, so comfort with remote work and asynchronous collaboration is critical. Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Parallels is committed to building an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and work environment. We offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations required during the recruitment process. jobs.excerpt: At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all.
jobs.description:
At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.

We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day:“What would I do if this patient were my mom?”That question drives everything we do.

But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose.

Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.

Position Summary
The Vice President - Strategic Accounts plays a critical role in advancing Caris Life Sciences’ enterprise precision medicine strategy by building, expanding, and sustaining system-level partnerships across surgery, pathology, and oncology. This position owns executive (C-suite and senior administrative) relationships within Caris’ most complex health systems, academic centers, and large group practices, and drives enterprise-wide adoption of Caris’ molecular diagnostics and precision oncology solutions.
This role functions as a strategic operator, project leader, and trusted advisor, integrating commercial strategy with disciplined project management, data-driven execution, and cross-functional coordination to ensure successful implementation, scale, and sustainability of precision medicine programs. While not a direct people manager, this role serves as an indirect leader and force multiplier, aligning stakeholders and enabling Regional Business Directors and field teams to achieve regional and enterprise growth objectives.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own and manage executive-level relationships within strategic accounts, including CEOs, CMOs, COOs, CFOs, Cancer Center Directors, laboratory leadership, and health system administrators.
  • Develop, execute, and maintain enterprise-level account strategies spanning surgical workflows, pathology operations, and oncology care delivery.
  • Identify opportunities to integrate Caris molecular profiling and precision oncology solutions into clinical pathways, institutional standards of care, and system-wide protocols.
  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) focused on performance, utilization trends, outcomes, and future growth initiatives.
  • Analyze account- and regional-level data to identify growth opportunities, adoption barriers, and productivity gaps.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to Regional Business Directors by aligning enterprise priorities with regional planning, prioritization, and tactical execution.
  • Provide indirect leadership, mentorship, and subject matter expertise to Oncology Account Executives, Oncology Case Managers, and supporting field roles.
  • Serve as the primary project owner for strategic initiatives, including complex account onboarding, precision medicine program launches, pathology-driven initiatives, workflow optimization, EMR integrations, and service improvements.
  • Coordinate cross-functional execution across Operations, Client Services, Laboratory, Medical Affairs, IT, and Marketing to ensure successful delivery of enterprise initiatives.
  • Define project scope, timelines, deliverables, and success metrics; track progress using CRM and project management tools.
  • Support new business development and account expansion by assisting with complex deal strategy, value positioning, and navigation of institutional decision-making processes.
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for strategic accounts and ensure alignment between customer expectations and Caris operational performance.
  • Represent Caris Life Sciences at the highest levels of customer leadership as a long-term precision medicine partner.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, business, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in strategic account management, oncology diagnostics, precision medicine, or complex healthcare sales.
  • Strong understanding of molecular diagnostics, next-generation sequencing (NGS), oncology workflows, and pathology/laboratory operations.
  • Demonstrated success driving growth within complex, matrixed healthcare environments.
  • Proven ability to influence without direct authority and lead cross-functional and field teams.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), reporting tools, and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to successfully complete pre-employment processes, including background check, drug screening, and reference check.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or other advanced degree.
  • Formal project management training or PMP certification.
  • Experience supporting enterprise or health-system-level partnerships.
  • Established relationships within academic medical centers or large integrated delivery networks.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and executive communication skills.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working remotely or on-site with customers.
  • Ability to travel by air and automobile for customer meetings and regional responsibilities.
  • Ability to lift and carry materials up to 25 pounds occasionally (e.g., presentation materials, equipment).

Training

  • All job-specific, compliance, and safety training will be assigned based on the responsibilities associated with this role.
  • Ongoing training related to Caris products, systems, regulatory requirements, and commercial processes will be required.

Other

  • This position requires significant regional travel (approximately >50%).
  • Evening, weekend, or holiday work may be required based on customer needs and business priorities.
  • This role may require after-hours responsiveness for critical customer or enterprise issues.

Conditions of Employment: Individual must successfully complete pre-employment process, which includes criminal background check, drug screening, credit check( applicable for certain positions) and reference verification.

jobs.description:
About Dynatron

Dynatron is championing a new standard of Fixed Ops excellence for automotive dealerships. We cut through the Fixed Ops data fog and deliver unique insights and actions that help you drive revenue growth, expand margins, and uplift retention—all through a unique AI-powered Fixed Ops Data Intelligence Platform, proven methodology, and expert coaching.
As a remote-first software company, we combine deep automotive expertise with technology, data, and structured client partnership to help dealerships achieve measurable, sustainable results.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced Automotive SaaS Client Success professional to join Dynatron as a Client Performance Coach.
This role sits at the intersection of Client Success, automotive expertise, software adoption, and performance consulting. You'll manage a portfolio of dealership clients, helping them translate Dynatron's technology and data into measurable business outcomes while building the trusted relationships that drive adoption, retention, and long-term growth.
This is not a traditional dealership Fixed Operations role. While understanding the dealership environment is important, we're looking for someone who knows how to succeed as a Client Success professional within a SaaS organization - managing customer relationships, driving technology adoption, demonstrating ROI, identifying risk, coordinating across internal teams, and creating value throughout the customer lifecycle.
Success means your clients don't simply use Dynatron. They understand its value, incorporate it into how they operate, achieve measurable results, and view Dynatron as a strategic partner.

Role Reality

This is a highly structured, fully virtual Client Success role. Most of your day will be spent managing customer relationships through scheduled meetings, account preparation, performance analysis, documentation, follow-up, and internal collaboration.
You should expect:
  • Approximately 45-50 hours per week
  • No weekends
  • Approximately six hours per day of scheduled, camera-on virtual meetings
  • A portfolio of dealership customers requiring proactive relationship and performance management
  • Significant use of CRM, software dashboards, performance data, and structured documentation
  • Clear expectations around client engagement, adoption, retention, and performance
  • Software-company compensation rather than traditional dealership compensation
The strongest performers combine the urgency and customer awareness required in automotive with the structure, discipline, and scalability required in SaaS.

What You'll Do

Own the Client Relationship

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner for a portfolio of dealership clients, building trusted relationships with General Managers, Fixed Operations Directors, Service Managers, and other key stakeholders.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client's business objectives, operational challenges, and measures of success.
  • Establish regular engagement cadences and maintain clear success plans for assigned accounts.
  • Navigate challenging conversations and escalations while maintaining credibility and strengthening the client relationship.
  • Build relationships across multiple stakeholders to create durable partnerships that extend beyond a single customer champion.

Drive Software Adoption & Client Value

  • Guide clients through adoption of Dynatron's platform, workflows, and performance methodology.
  • Help dealership teams incorporate Dynatron into their day-to-day operating processes rather than treating the platform as a standalone tool.
  • Monitor product utilization and engagement to identify adoption gaps, risks, and opportunities.
  • Reinforce effective platform usage through ongoing training, coaching, and consultation.
  • Translate software capabilities into practical business value for dealership leaders.

Demonstrate Performance & ROI

  • Analyze dashboards, utilization metrics, historical performance, and dealership data to evaluate account performance.
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for dealership stakeholders.
  • Demonstrate the business impact and ROI of Dynatron's solutions through regular performance conversations and executive-level presentations.
  • Coach clients on pricing and performance strategies, including ELR, Hours/RO, parts matrixing, Variable Labor Pricing strategies, and Warranty Filings.
  • Identify trends and opportunities that help clients improve profitability and operational performance.

Manage Client Health, Retention & Growth

  • Proactively assess account health using engagement, utilization, performance, relationship, and other relevant indicators.
  • Identify potential churn risks early and develop clear action plans in partnership with internal stakeholders.
  • Support renewal strategy by continuously demonstrating measurable value throughout the client lifecycle.
  • Identify opportunities where additional Dynatron solutions could create value for the customer and partner with Sales on appropriate expansion conversations.
  • Maintain accurate visibility into account status, risks, opportunities, and next steps.

Partner Cross-Functionally

  • Work closely with Sales, Product, Support, Implementation, and other Client Success teams to deliver a coordinated customer experience.
  • Communicate client feedback, product needs, and emerging trends to internal stakeholders.
  • Coordinate resolution of complex client issues and ensure appropriate follow-through.
  • Support successful customer transitions from implementation into ongoing Client Success.
  • Share insights and best practices that improve the broader customer experience.

Maintain Client Success Discipline

  • Maintain accurate account records, meeting notes, health indicators, action plans, and follow-up activities within SugarCRM.
  • Prepare thoroughly for client meetings using product, performance, and historical account data.
  • Manage a calendar-driven customer portfolio with consistent follow-through and clear prioritization.
  • Participate in ongoing training, coaching calibration, and professional development.
  • Operate with accountability for both customer outcomes and the quality of the client experience.

What You Bring

Automotive SaaS Client Success Experience

  • 3-5+ years of experience in B2B Client/Customer Success, SaaS account management, or a comparable customer-facing role within the automotive technology ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated experience managing ongoing customer relationships beyond implementation or initial product sale.
  • Experience driving software adoption, customer engagement, retention, and measurable value within a recurring-revenue business.
  • Experience partnering with automotive dealerships and credibility with dealership leaders and operators.
  • Understanding of dealership operations and the ability to connect software capabilities to dealership business outcomes.
Direct dealership employment is not required. We are particularly interested in candidates who have successfully partnered with dealerships as customers while working within an automotive SaaS or technology organization.

Client Success & Commercial Acumen

  • Strong understanding of the SaaS customer lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, value realization, retention, renewal, and expansion.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify customer risk and take proactive action before issues escalate.
  • Experience using business outcomes and ROI to reinforce customer value.
  • Ability to recognize expansion opportunities while maintaining a consultative, client-first approach.
  • Comfortable being accountable for customer health, retention, and long-term relationship quality.

Data & Analytical Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate software dashboards, analyze utilization and performance metrics, and translate data into actionable client recommendations.
  • Comfortable using quantitative information to tell a clear business story.
  • Ability to identify patterns, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities across a portfolio of customers.
  • Strong preparation and analytical habits before client conversations.

Technology & Systems

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience using SugarCRM, Salesforce, or another enterprise CRM to manage customer relationships, document engagement, track account health, and maintain customer records.
  • High proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 for documentation, analysis, and executive presentations.
  • Comfortable conducting client relationships through virtual collaboration platforms such as Zoom or similar technologies.
  • Experience with Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, or similar tools is a plus.
  • Comfortable learning and becoming proficient in complex SaaS products and internal technology platforms.

Communication & Executive Presence

  • Strong virtual presentation, facilitation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with everyone from daily platform users to General Managers and senior dealership leadership.
  • Confidence presenting performance results and ROI to executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to simplify complex information without losing the underlying business meaning.
  • Comfortable navigating difficult customer conversations with professionalism and composure.

Ownership & Execution

  • Highly organized and effective in a remote, calendar-driven environment.
  • Strong follow-through and attention to detail across a portfolio of accounts.
  • Proactive rather than reactive approach to customer management.
  • Coachable, adaptable, and comfortable operating against defined processes and measurable expectations.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while partnering effectively across teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • Build trusted, strategic relationships with dealership customers.
  • Drive consistent adoption and effective utilization of Dynatron's software.
  • Connect platform usage to measurable dealership business outcomes.
  • Demonstrate value and ROI throughout the customer lifecycle - not just at renewal.
  • Identify customer risk early and act proactively to protect the relationship.
  • Create strong customer advocates while contributing to retention and expansion.
  • Maintain accurate, actionable customer information within the CRM.
  • Partner effectively across Dynatron to solve problems and improve the client experience.
  • Manage their portfolio with the discipline, consistency, and accountability expected of a high-performing SaaS Client Success organization.

Why Dynatron
