jobs.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on Staff Data Scientist to architect and execute Machine Learning solutions, develop Large Language Models (LLMs), and build the AI stack to automate complex Data Analytics workflows. This role is at the heart of JumpCloud's applied-AI journey, combining deep foundations in classical machine learning with practical experience in building AI agents and systems that transform business decision-making and analytics delivery.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Professional Experience: 8+ years across analytics, LLMs, data science, and applied machine learning, with a proven track record of owning business-facing solutions.

  • Product-Focused ML: Experience developing real-time anomaly detection models and large-scale data processing systems to identify product usage signals and adoption patterns.

  • Business ML Applications: Ability to solve business problems using predictive and prescriptive modeling, including price sensitivity, churn, revenue forecasting, and marketing mix optimization.

  • Domain Expertise: Knowledge of identity threat signals (e.g., unusual logins, MFA behavior, authentication velocity) and analyzing deviations from historical user behavior.

  • AI Execution & Advisory: Expertise in managing AI service costs and relevance, building AI agents for automated analysis, and generating explainable insights within business workflows.

  • Analytics Foundations: Strong background in segmentation, root cause analysis, funnel optimization, and acquisition quality scoring to drive growth and efficiency.

  • Thought Leadership: Capability to reason through unfamiliar domains to identify potential signals, features, and modeling approaches independently.

  • Ecosystem Background: Experience in fast-paced, data-first environments or startups where ML is a core driver of business outcomes.

What You Will Own:

  • AI Stack Roadmap: Leading the path from opportunity sizing and prototyping through to evaluation, deployment, and impact measurement.

  • Technical Execution: Ensuring robust performance, validation, and inference of real-time models using the latest industry improvements.

  • Standards & Governance: Establishing pragmatic standards for model development, LLM evaluation, observability, security, and cost management.

  • Capability Mentorship: Coaching analysts and creating reusable tools to raise the collective quality of predictive problem-solving.

  • Strategic Communication: Translating complex technical work into clear recommendations and trade-offs for senior stakeholders.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Aligning stakeholders with competing priorities and creating clarity in ambiguous settings to influence outcomes.

Technical Breadth:

  • Expertise in Python, SQL, statistical analysis, and common ML frameworks.

  • Deep knowledge of MLOps, including feature engineering, deployment, inference, and monitoring.

  • Proficiency with LLM APIs, RAG, Semantic Layers, Embeddings, and agent orchestration frameworks.

  • Experience building robust ML pipelines for both real-time and asynchronous predictions.

Behavioral Strengths

  • Exceptional business acumen and clarity of thought.
  • Curiosity driven by purpose with the ability to "zoom in" on details and "zoom out" for strategy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of recurring-revenue B2B SaaS business models.
  • Experience with Data Engineering: Data governance, transformation, and orchestration patterns on modern platforms.

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.

Language:

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at with the subject line "Scam Notice"

About this Position

Net at Work is seeking a hands-on, business-oriented Vice President of Information Technology to lead the company's internal technology organization. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the VP of IT will be responsible for the reliability, security, scalability, and performance of the company's business applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, and technology operations.

The VP of IT will provide strategic and operational leadership for internal technology while partnering closely with executive leadership to ensure technology investments support business objectives, operational excellence, employee productivity, and company growth. This leader will oversee technology operations, enterprise applications, cybersecurity, vendor relationships, and technology governance while driving continuous improvement across the organization.

  • Own and oversee Net at Work’s internal business application ecosystem, ensuring systems are reliable, secure, scalable, well-supported, and aligned with business operations.
  • Lead rollouts of new internal applications and major system enhancements across departments, including planning, requirements, testing, training, adoption, and post-launch support.
  • Apply sound SDLC practices, development best practices, and delivery frameworks to application rollouts, integrations, vendor-led implementations, and internal technology projects.
  • Oversee core technology operations, including infrastructure, cloud platforms, network operations, collaboration tools, end-user support, monitoring, escalation, and incident management.
  • Head the company’s internal security function, including security policies, controls, access management, risk management, vulnerability management, security awareness, and incident readiness.
  • Establish practical technology roadmaps, governance processes, operating standards, and prioritization models that support day-to-day business needs and company growth.
  • Manage technology vendors, implementation partners, licensing, renewals, support contracts, budgets, forecasts, and related technology spend.
  • Support technology due diligence and integration planning for acquisitions, with a focus on applications, infrastructure, security, vendors, licensing, and operational continuity.

  • Partner closely with the COO and leaders across Finance, Legal, Compliance, People & Learning, Sales, Service, Operations, and customer experience to support business priorities.

  • Strong understanding of SDLC, application delivery best practices, implementation frameworks, integrations, testing, release management, and production support.

  • Experience managing technology budgets, vendors, licensing, renewals, implementation partners, and support contracts.
  • Experience in professional services, managed services, consulting, SaaS, technology services, or B2B services environments strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; master’s degree preferred.

Leadership Attributes

The successful candidate will be:

  • Operationally disciplined and execution-oriented
  • A strategic business partner who aligns technology with organizational goals
  • Service-oriented and focused on delivering exceptional internal customer experiences
  • Security-minded and risk-aware
  • An effective leader capable of developing high-performing teams
  • Skilled at balancing strategic planning with hands-on operational leadership
  • Comfortable working with executive leadership and translating business needs into technology solutions

Customer Requirements

This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.

Core Competencies

  • Client Champion – Relentlessly exceed client expectations. Consistently anticipate needs to deliver valuable solutions and extraordinary outcomes.
  • Problem Solver – Smart, analytical, inquisitive, knowledge-seeker that thrives on a challenge.
  • Promise Keeper – Place high value on keeping our word and doing the right thing. Demonstrate honesty, integrity, and commitment.
  • Collaborative Integrator –Team player, unifier, relationship-oriented, win-win seeker, exemplify the concept of relationships through trust and unity.
  • Driven Intrapreneur – Exceed goals using independent creative thinking, optimism, self-confidence, and a can-do attitude.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. The role

We are looking for a structured, proactive, and technically strong Technical Program Manager to coordinate technical execution within our Post-Sales organization in the United States.

Nebius Post-Sales teams work with customers running production workloads on our cloud infrastructure. Your mission is to make this work predictable and scalable by maintaining clear execution plans, technical dependencies, ownership, customer health, and operational processes.

A key part of the role is the transition from Pre-Sales into Post-Sales. You will ensure that customer architecture, technical requirements, service dependencies, known risks, and operational context are carried into production with clear ownership. As customers move through production, you will maintain visibility into their health and core technical issues and coordinate dependencies across Post-Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering.

You will work closely with architects and engineers and develop a strong understanding of customer environments and Nebius cloud infrastructure. You should be able to translate technical requirements into execution plans, identify missing dependencies and readiness gaps, challenge incomplete plans, and coordinate technical work across several teams.

This role is remote within the United States and requires candidates to be based on the East Coast.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Coordinate technical execution across US Post-Sales customers, maintaining clear plans, dependencies, risks, ownership, and status.

  • Own and improve the Pre-Sales to Post-Sales transition, including customer architecture, technical requirements, dependencies, documentation, and ownership handover.

  • Partner with architects and engineers to translate production requirements into execution plans and identify technical gaps or dependencies.

  • Proactively identify weaknesses in Post-Sales processes and design, implement, and measure practical improvements.

Overview

Field Marketing Manager, Germany

We are seeking an experienced, commercially minded Field Marketing Manager to drive pipeline growth, brand awareness, customer engagement and revenue contribution across the DACH region.

This role serves as the primary marketing partner to regional sales and leadership and is responsible for developing and executing an integrated marketing strategy that supports business growth, strategic account engagement and revenue generation. The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking with strong commercial and analytical skills, using data and insight to guide investment decisions and maximise business impact.

You will bring a deep understanding of the DACH market, strong knowledge of the local marketing ecosystem, and the ability to build strong relationships with regional vendors, partners and industry organisations.

While events are a key focus, this is not an events-focused role. We are looking for a modern B2B marketer who understands how to leverage the full marketing mix to drive awareness, engagement, demand generation, pipeline creation and revenue growth.

The ideal candidate embraces AI as a force multiplier, using AI-powered tools to uncover insights faster, accelerate execution, improve decision-making and scale marketing impact while maintaining high standards of quality, accuracy and brand integrity.

You will be reporting to the Marketing Director. This is a remote role from Germany.

Develop and Execute Regional Marketing Strategy

Senior Federal Acquisition Support Specialist / Team Lead – Remote

Cetechs is seeking a highly experienced Federal acquisition professional to serve as a Senior Federal Acquisition Support Specialist / Team Lead supporting the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration, Regional Procurement Office – Central.

This position will provide senior-level cradle-to-grave acquisition support while also providing technical leadership and guidance to a team of acquisition support specialists.

The position is primarily remote, with occasional travel to the employee's nearest VA facility for onboarding, fingerprinting, PIV processing, Government equipment issuance, meetings, or other Government-directed requirements.

Position Details

Position: Senior Federal Acquisition Support Specialist / Team Lead
Employment Type: Full-Time
Schedule: 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday
Work Arrangement: Primarily Remote
Location: United States, Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico
Anticipated Start: Fall 2026
Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship Required

Responsibilities

The Senior Acquisition Support Specialist / Team Lead will provide advanced Federal acquisition support and technical leadership to acquisition support personnel.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Lead and provide technical guidance to acquisition support specialists.
  • Provide cradle-to-grave support for complex Federal acquisitions.
  • Support Contracting Officers and Contract Specialists during pre-award and post-award activities.
  • Develop acquisition strategies and acquisition plans.
  • Conduct and oversee market research.
  • Assist with development and review of Statements of Work and Performance Work Statements.
  • Prepare solicitations, amendments, awards, modifications, and related procurement documentation.
  • Develop and review Independent Government Cost Estimates (IGCEs).
  • Conduct complex cost and price analysis.
  • Prepare price reasonableness recommendations.
  • Support source-selection planning and documentation.
  • Review procurement packages for FAR, VAAR, and agency compliance.
  • Support contract administration, modifications, options, changes, and claims.
  • Assist with contractor performance monitoring and QASP activities.
  • Support contract termination and closeout activities.
  • Analyze difficult contracting issues and recommend alternative courses of action.
  • Coordinate with Government leadership, Contracting Officers, Contract Specialists, CORs, program offices, requiring activities, and other stakeholders.
  • Review acquisition documentation for accuracy, adequacy, completeness, and compliance.
  • Support multiple acquisition programs, sites, and service lines.
  • Provide leadership and technical direction to the contract support team.

Minimum Experience

Candidates must have:

  • At least 5 years of recent Federal acquisition experience within the last 7 years.
  • Demonstrated experience performing comprehensive and complex Federal acquisition support.
  • Extensive working knowledge of:
    • FAR
    • VAAR
    • Federal acquisition regulations, policies, and procedures
  • Demonstrated experience performing both pre-award and post-award acquisition activities.
  • Experience supporting acquisitions above the Simplified Acquisition Threshold.
  • Experience handling complex Federal contract actions.

Education

Candidates must possess:

  • Bachelor's degree in any field.

AND

  • At least 24 semester hours in any combination of:
    • Accounting
    • Business
    • Finance
    • Law
    • Contracts
    • Purchasing
    • Economics
    • Industrial Management
    • Marketing
    • Quantitative Methods
    • Organization and Management

Acquisition Certification / Training

Candidates must possess qualifying Federal acquisition certification or equivalent acquisition training, such as:

  • FAC-C
  • FAC-C Professional
  • DAWIA Contracting certification
  • Courses leading to Federal contracting certification
  • Equivalent commercial acquisition/contracting coursework

Preferred Specialized Experience

Experience in one or more of the following Federal acquisition areas is highly desirable:

  • Complex professional or healthcare services
  • Construction contracting
  • Architect-Engineer contracting
  • Real property leasing
  • Contract modifications
  • Source selections
  • FAR Part 13 acquisitions
  • FAR Part 15 acquisitions
  • FAR Part 36 acquisitions
  • FAR Part 43 contract modifications
  • VA acquisition and contracting

Systems

Working knowledge of:

  • Microsoft Teams
  • Word
  • Excel
  • Outlook
  • PowerPoint
  • SharePoint
  • Adobe Acrobat
  • Government contract writing systems such as eCMS
  • SAM.gov
  • CPARS
  • FPDS-NG
  • GSA eBuy
  • GSA Advantage

Prior Department of Veterans Affairs acquisition experience and VA eCMS experience are strongly preferred.

Leadership Skills

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • Ability to lead and provide technical guidance to acquisition personnel.
  • Strong written communication skills.
  • Strong time and workload management.
  • Ability to collaborate with multiple stakeholders.
  • Ability to analyze complex contracting issues.
  • Ability to review and improve acquisition and source-selection documentation.
  • Ability to provide sound Federal acquisition recommendations while recognizing that final contractual decisions remain with Government Contracting Officers.

Additional Requirements

  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must successfully complete VA fingerprinting and background investigation requirements.
  • Must complete required VA security, privacy, and Rules of Behavior training.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain required VA system access and PIV credentials.
  • Must be able to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Must be available 40 hours per week.
  • Occasional travel to a VA facility may be required for onboarding and other Government-directed activities.

Cetechs is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business providing professional and technical support services to Federal Government customers.

Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Director, Platform Engineering & DevOps to lead the development and maturation of our enterprise Platform Engineering organization.

This leader will be responsible for building a modern, automation-first platform primarily focused on Microsoft Azure, while supporting remaining legacy workloads in AWS and on-premises data centers during the company's migration to Azure.

The Director will lead the Platform Engineering team and partner closely with Network Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Security, and application Engineering to deliver secure, reliable, scalable, and highly automated infrastructure platforms.

A key objective of this role is to move the organization toward a self-service Platform Engineering model, enabling application teams to deploy and manage infrastructure using standardized patterns, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and cloud governance.

Role and Responsibilities

Build, lead, and develop the Platform Engineering organization, including engineering strategy, roadmap, standards, and operating model.

  • Lead the design and evolution of the company's enterprise Microsoft Azure platform, including landing zones, governance, identity, networking, security, observability, and resiliency.

  • Support the migration of applications and infrastructure from AWS and on-premises environments to Azure.

  • Establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation as the standard approach for provisioning and managing infrastructure.

  • Develop reusable Terraform modules, CI/CD pipelines, reference architectures, and standardized deployment patterns.

  • Build self-service platform capabilities and "golden paths" that improve developer productivity and reduce manual infrastructure provisioning.

  • Partner with Network Engineering on hybrid cloud connectivity, cloud networking, Private Link, DNS, routing, firewalls, and application delivery.

  • Partner with SRE to establish platform availability objectives, observability standards, resiliency practices, incident improvements, and operational readiness, leveraging Datadog Application

  • Partner with SRE and Application Engineering to establish consistent standards for application and platform telemetry, including metrics, logs, distributed traces, dashboards, alerting, and service-level monitoring.

  • Ensure cloud and platform services are appropriately instrumented and integrated with the enterprise observability platform.

  • Partner with Security to implement secure-by-default platform patterns, cloud governance, policy enforcement, and compliance controls.

  • Establish cloud cost-management and FinOps practices across Azure and remaining AWS environments.

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop engineering leaders and senior technical talent.

  • Provide executive-level communication regarding platform strategy, technology risks, investments, reliability, and cloud transformation progress.

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, Platform Engineering, systems engineering, or related disciplines, including significant engineering leadership experience.

  • Deep technical knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including enterprise cloud architecture, networking, security, governance, resiliency, and platform services.

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation, particularly Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based engineering workflows.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex cloud transformation initiatives, including hybrid environments, enterprise cloud migrations, or modernization of mission-critical infrastructure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or leading an enterprise Platform Engineering organization or Internal Developer Platform.

  • Working knowledge of AWS and experience supporting or migrating AWS workloads.

  • Experience with Azure Landing Zones, Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Well-Architected Framework, and Azure Verified Modules.

  • Experience with Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

  • Experience with GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, GitHub Actions or comparable DevOps platforms.

  • Experience with enterprise observability and APM platforms, preferably Datadog, and technologies such as OpenTelemetry.

  • Experience implementing SRE practices including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, resiliency engineering, and incident management.

  • Experience implementing cloud FinOps and cost optimization practices.

  • Experience operating technology platforms in healthcare, SaaS, financial services, or another regulated environment.

Success Metrics for the Role

Success will be measured by the Director's ability to build a scalable Platform Engineering organization and improve the speed, reliability, security, and efficiency of infrastructure delivery.

  • Increased adoption of standardized Azure landing zones, reusable platform services, and self-service capabilities.

  • Reduced infrastructure provisioning and application deployment lead times.

  • Progress migrating targeted AWS and on-premises workloads to Azure.

  • Improved platform availability and achievement of defined SLOs.

  • Increased adoption and effectiveness of standardized observability and APM practices across platform and application services, including improved service visibility and reduced mean time to detect and restore.

  • Reduction in infrastructure-related incidents, configuration drift, and manual production changes.

  • Improved developer satisfaction and adoption of Platform Engineering services.

  • Improved cloud governance, security compliance, and cost efficiency.

  • Successful recruitment, development, and retention of a high-performing Platform Engineering team.

Fractional CFO (6–8 Hours per Week) – FinTech / Remote

PLEASE READ THE FULL JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING

Location: Remote
Working Pattern: Fractional – approximately 6–8 hours per week
Environment: Early-Stage FinTech

About the Opportunity

Our client is an early-stage FinTech business developing technology designed to improve access to financial services for businesses operating internationally.

The company is entering an important stage of its development, with increasing focus on commercial readiness, fundraising, governance and building out its senior leadership capability.

As part of this next phase, the business is looking for an experienced Fractional Chief Financial Officer to join its developing executive leadership team.

This is not a traditional full-time CFO appointment.

The role is designed for an experienced finance leader who can provide approximately 6–8 hours of senior-level support per week and is comfortable participating in an early-stage venture alongside other compatible professional commitments.

You will work closely with the Founder/CEO and wider leadership team, providing strategic financial leadership while helping establish the financial foundations required for future growth and investment.

This engagement is likely to suit someone motivated by building longer-term enterprise value rather than someone seeking a conventional full-time executive package at this stage.

Further details regarding the engagement and participation structure will be discussed directly with candidates progressing through the process.

Application – Mandatory Qualifying Questions

Please submit your CV together with a cover letter. Within your cover letter, you must answer each of the mandatory qualifying questions below.

  1. What experience do you have operating as a CFO, Finance Director, Fractional CFO or equivalent senior finance leader within FinTech, financial services or a high-growth technology business?
  2. What experience do you have supporting fundraising, investor readiness and investor due diligence? Please provide a specific example and explain your personal involvement.
  3. Please provide an example of a financial model, fundraising model or scenario-planning exercise you have personally led or materially developed.
  4. What experience do you have working with early-stage or pre-revenue businesses where finance infrastructure, processes and controls were still being developed?
  5. Do you have experience within trade finance, payments, lending, structured finance, banking or another relevant financial-services environment? Please explain.
  6. This opportunity requires approximately 6–8 hours per week. Can you consistently commit to this level of involvement alongside your other professional commitments?

These questions are mandatory and form part of our initial assessment process. Applications that do not provide a clear answer to every mandatory qualifying question will be automatically disqualified and will not be considered further.

What You'll Be Doing

You will provide strategic financial leadership as the business prepares for fundraising and its next stage of development, including:

  • Developing and maintaining financial models, forecasts and scenario planning
  • Supporting fundraising strategy and investor readiness
  • Supporting investor discussions and due diligence
  • Advising on financial strategy, capital requirements and cash/runway planning
  • Establishing appropriate financial reporting, governance and controls
  • Providing financial input into commercial models and strategic partnerships
  • Supporting Board and investor reporting
  • Working with external accountants and specialist advisers
  • Helping establish a scalable finance function

The emphasis is on high-value financial leadership rather than routine transactional finance or bookkeeping.

What We're Looking For

You should bring:

  • CFO, Fractional CFO, Finance Director or equivalent senior experience
  • Strong financial modelling and forecasting capability
  • Demonstrable fundraising and investor-facing experience
  • Early-stage/startup experience
  • Strong financial governance knowledge
  • Commercial judgement
  • Confidence working directly with founders and senior stakeholders
  • The ability to create infrastructure rather than rely upon an established finance function
  • The ability to make meaningful executive-level impact within 6–8 hours per week

Experience within FinTech, trade finance, payments, banking, lending, structured finance or other regulated financial services would be particularly valuable.

Engagement Structure

This is a flexible, fractional engagement of approximately 6–8 hours per week within an early-stage FinTech venture.

It is designed for someone comfortable with a structure centred on longer-term participation in company growth rather than a conventional executive package at this stage.

Full details of the participation structure will be discussed with candidates progressing through the process.

  • Align: work closely with the Product Leadership, Senior Product Operations Manager, Product Managers, and cross-functional business partners to help ensure product work is clearly understood, decisions are communicated effectively, and teams stay aligned on priorities, dependencies, and readiness.
  • Enable: Help provide product teams with the means to complete routine and strategic tasks as efficiently as possible, by supporting key processes, maintaining tools and workflows, and bringing structure to how work is prepared, reviewed, and tracked.
  • Improve: Support continuous, iterative improvement of how teams work by helping identify bottlenecks, reducing time spent on non-core product activities, and reinforcing the systems, governance, and operating rhythms that support high-quality product work.

Duties & Responsibilities

    Product Operations is a multifaceted function that focuses on improving how the Product organization operates day to day, driving cross-functional collaboration, and enabling product teams to focus on what they do best: build great products. This role is a mixture of hands-on execution and support for continuous improvement, working under the direction of the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership team. In this role you will be responsible
    for:
  • Product Operating Model and Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) Support: Support the flow of work from intake through discovery, assessment, planning, and delivery by helping ensure requests are complete, handoffs are clear, and the right information is available at the right time.
  • Intake and Initiative Readiness: Support the intake process by serving as a first line of review for incoming requests. Work with stakeholders to gather required inputs and help ensure work is ready for Product review and decision-making.
  • Operating Rhythm and Meeting Support: Help prepare, coordinate, and, where appropriate, facilitate recurring forums such as Weekly Business Reviews, roadmap reviews, stakeholder meetings, and leadership sessions. Ensure materials are organized, decisions are captured, and follow-up actions are tracked to completion.
  • Tools and Workflow Optimization: Maintain the product management tech stack, including workflow hygiene, documentation practices, and reporting accuracy, and flag opportunities to improve transparency and usability across Product and cross-functional teams.
  • Governance and Process Support: Support key operating processes including compliance reviews, cross-functional readiness, and other recurring governance needs that help the business interact effectively with Product.
  • Cross-functional Project and Program Support: Support the execution of select cross-functional initiatives directed by the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Managers, helping track alignment on scope, timelines, dependencies, and risks across teams.
  • Data-informed Execution: Help gather and organize data, reporting, and operational insights to support the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership in identifying trends and informing process improvements.
  • Iterative Improvement: Help ensure product operating processes, frameworks, and methodologies remain practical and fit for purpose. Support the rollout of improvements as directed, with a bias toward progress over perfection.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Support open communication and help facilitate alignment between Product, Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Marketing, and other stakeholders, ensuring teams are working effectively toward common goals.
  • Team Support: Support onboarding, training, and documentation efforts led by the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership, helping build repeatable ways of working across the Product Organization.

Requirements

  • Experience: 2-5 years in product operations, program management, project management, product management, or a similar role, ideally within a technology or product-focused organization.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also welcomed.

Skill Set

    Product Operations is a strategic support function for the business that is as much about coordinating people as it is technology and processes. The strongest candidates will be comfortable owning tactical, day-to-day operational work while building the skills to help identify ways to improve how the organization works over time.
    Predominantly, candidates from product operations, program or project management, business operations, product management, business analysis, or similar roles may bring the right mix of execution, organization, and process improvement experience to the position.
  • An understanding of the full product development lifecycle (PDLC), including intake, discovery, assessment, planning, release, and cross-functional readiness processes.
  • Works iteratively and pragmatically - eager to help improve the way teams work over time without over-engineering or trying to change everything at once.

  • An empathetic attitude to truly understand the problems you are trying to support and solve with your colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, resilience to change, and the ability to adapt while working across multiple priorities and teams.
  • Experience managing task management and workflow tools - e.g. Jira, Linear, Asana, Productboard, or similar platforms.

  • Experience supporting the administration, adoption, and improvement of software tools and workflows in general.
  • Comfort supporting meetings and presentations with multiple stakeholders, with growing confidence in facilitating and presenting over time.
  • Comfort working with all levels of the business - from senior leaders to individual contributors - and a willingness to make suggestions and support positive change under the direction of the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership.

Compensation: $150,000-$200,000 per year
Location: United States – Remote or Omaha, NE - Hybrid

The job:
As a Senior Product Manager at Buildertrend on our Search team, you'll shape how builders find exactly what they need across a large and growing corpus of project data. Search is the most explicit statement of intent a builder makes in Buildertrend: a change order from last month, the photo from a daily log three weeks ago, the selection a client approved. Today it’s harder than it needs to be to find those things and you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in builder’s lives by helping to rebuild our search capability. You'll lead the shift from traditional keyword search toward LLM-powered search that understands intent, including owning the product direction for algorithms that rank, personalize and surface results, and building the feedback loops that drive continuous improvement based on real customer behavior. Success in this role means measurably better search quality: higher click-through rates, better match quality and results that feel like they understand the builder's intent, not just their keywords.

What you will do:

  • Define product direction for Search, owning the roadmap for ranking, retrieval and personalization.

  • Lead the evolution from keyword-based search to model-based, LLM-powered search that reasons over both structured and unstructured data.

  • Build and refine algorithmic feedback loops: a customer searches, evaluates the results and that signal feeds back into ranking improvements.

  • Design and run evals that measure whether search and ranking models are actually getting customers to what they're trying to find.

  • Partner closely with engineering and data science on data aggregation and structure, model development and serving in production, retrieval strategies (including RAG) and ranking approaches.

  • Establish and track success metrics like click-through rate and match quality, and use them to prioritize model and product investments.

  • Validate opportunities through experimentation, comparing new ranking or retrieval approaches against current performance.

  • Build tight feedback loops with customers to understand search intent and where results fall short.

  • Communicate technical trade-offs and model performance clearly to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Use provided AI tools (full Claude Code access, etc.) to develop and challenge your own thinking while maintaining full ownership of any AI assisted outputs.

Who you are and what you need:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required. A background in computer science, engineering or a related technical field is helpful.

  • 5+ years of product management experience required, including meaningful ownership of search, recommendations, personalization, relevance/ranking, or ad-tech systems.

  • B2B SaaS experience preferred; candidates from B2C search, recommendations, or personalization backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

  • Experience designing evaluations that measure whether a model is producing the outcome customers are trying to reach.

  • Proven record of improving search and relevance metrics (like click-through, match quality) and connecting them to adoption, retention, and revenue.

  • Experience running algorithmic feedback loops: search, result, evaluation and improvement.

  • Familiarity with modern retrieval and ranking approaches, including RAG and model-based search, is a strong plus.

  • Systems thinker who understands end to end workflows and dependencies.

  • Comfortable partnering directly with engineering and data science on model performance and trade-offs.

  • Strong algorithmic thinking and the ability to translate technical approaches into measurable outcomes.

  • Ability to make clear decisions in complex or ambiguous technical situations.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially translating technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

  • Comfortable using provided tools (full Claude Code access etc.) to explore the code base, pressure test technical tradeoffs, and challenge your own thinking while maintaining full ownership of AI assisted outputs.

We are giving you:

  • Exceptional health packages, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life insurance and short- and long-term disability benefits

  • A 401(k) plan with Buildertrend matching contributions to help you plan for the future

  • Generous paid time off, 11 paid holidays, plus personal days to make sure you have time to recharge

  • Parental leave and paid sabbaticals to support you during life’s big moments

  • Volunteer time off – because giving back matters

  • Wellness program and onsite fitness center to keep you feeling your best

  • Opportunities for hybrid or remote work to give you the flexibility you need

  • Free daily lunches when you're at our HQ office, plus monthly events to connect with your team

Who we are:

Buildertrend is cutting-edge, cloud-based project management software. With nearly 1 million users across the globe, we know what builders need: To work simpler, see more growth and calm the chaos in their business. That’s why we believe in providing an all-in-one solution to solve real problems, deliver real results, and change the way the world builds. If you want to learn more about us, check out:

  5. Since customers are creating plans which are dependent on accurate data you will be required to provide data analysis, processing and validation using excel and SQL. (A mandatory course for this will be a part of your onboarding).
  6. Since many of our customers are in different time zones and we seek to provide them with exceptional support you will be subject to a rotational on-call schedule. Making yourself available for “On-call” time is remunerated over and above your monthly total cost to company salary.

You will be required to work remotely, with a monthly Cost to Company between R18 000 and R20 000 (depending on your qualifications and experience), we’re looking for someone to provide proactive customer support.

Who is DotActiv?

DotActiv provides category management software and services which enable retailers and suppliers to analyse their retail data and create data-driven assortments, planograms and floor plans. We’re a passionate group of young people that want to be successful in everything we do. Our entire company is made up of +-70% of females while the average age is about 26 to 28 years old.

What does that mean for you?

Working in technical support at DotActiv, you would have the opportunity of engaging with top retail brands from all corners of the world every single day. The multiplicity of culture exposure is dramatic and can be both very challenging and rewarding. Our business is growing quickly which makes for a high-pressure environment.

Your colleagues will push you to be better because as a group we want to win out there in the market but they will also support you in a very sincere way.

Requirements

What we will expect from you

A great attitude is what is most important. The next most important thing we will expect is an “always learning” mindset. Besides these critical ingredients, you will need to possess or in some instances be willing to acquire (with our help) the following skills and abilities:

Education and Language:

  • Any relevant IT certificates or qualifications would be advantageous.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills in English.
  • An additional language will be advantageous, specifically Spanish, Portuguese, French or another widely spoken language.

Knowledge and Computer Skills

  • Knowledge of the principles of customer service in relation to software products.
  • DotActiv Enterprise software knowledge.
  • Computer packages & systems currently in use by the company.
  • Project management.
  • Customer coaching & support.
  • Competent use of job-specific in-house systems used by the company.
  • Intermediate MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) & deploy ability within Google Suite.
  • Basic to Intermediate MS SQL or similar solution.
  • Problem-solving (Trouble-shooting).
  • Intermediate MS Operating Systems (Windows 10, 11, Server).
  • Ability to test software for bugs and feature readiness.
  • IIS/SSL Certificates.

Soft Skills

To thrive in this position, you will need to have the following soft skills:

  • Ability to patiently support, educate and assist customers.
  • Good oral & written communication skills.
  • Excellent client relationship skills (Quality client engagement).
  • High capacity to represent the brand.
  • Ability to multitask & remain attentive in an often-busy environment.
  • Be naturally calm and focused.
  • Be versatile if participation in other types of activity is required.

Character Traits

  • Empathetic
  • Able to deal with regular stress peaks
  • Curious
  • Positive and Upbeat
  • Technician/ Problem solver at heart

Benefits

What you can expect from DotActiv

Here’s what you can expect from DotActiv as technical support:

We will offer you a developmental path specific to your circumstances, allowing you to grow your career with us.

jobs.title: Principal Architect - Databricks
jobs.excerpt: About UsSince 1989, SHI International Corp.  has helped organizations change the world through technology.
jobs.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

We are expanding our Databricks capability within the Data and AI practice and are looking for a Principal Solutions Architect to lead the technical side of it.

You will work directly with customers from the outset, qualifying opportunities, conducting technical discovery with customer architects and data leaders, designing target-state platforms, and owning the technical win. Much of the work ahead involves platform build-out, migration, and consolidation, helping enterprises move to the Databricks Lakehouse from Hadoop and Spark estates, legacy analytics platforms, established data warehouse and appliance environments, and other cloud platforms. The role also supports AI and machine learning initiatives that Databricks is designed to enable.

This is a senior individual contributor position with significant influence over the solutions we build and bring to market. It is ideal for someone who wants to shape a capability rather than operate within one that is already defined.

Role Description

Own the Technical Side of Databricks Pursuits

  • Lead qualification, technical discovery, target architecture design, effort estimation, and risk assessment.

  • Develop technical content for proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs).

  • Build and maintain technical relationships with customer architects and stakeholders.

  • Provide customers with realistic and accurate assessments of migration complexity, implementation effort, AI workload readiness, and associated risks.

Provide Architectural Oversight Through Delivery

  • Review architecture decisions throughout project delivery.

  • Confirm that the delivered solution aligns with what was originally scoped and proposed.

  • Surface technical risks and issues early in the engagement.

  • Remain closely involved throughout delivery to ensure accountability for architecture and outcomes.

Shape Databricks Service Offerings

  • Define the technical content of market-facing Databricks offerings.

  • Establish what is included in scope, how success is measured, and what evidence validates successful completion.

  • Create repeatable delivery standards and frameworks that teams can execute consistently.

Partner with Databricks

  • Engage directly with Databricks field teams and specialist architects on joint customer accounts.

  • Build productive relationships with Databricks technical teams.

  • Effectively collaborate and navigate technical challenges, feedback, and differing viewpoints from vendor architects and specialists.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Willingness to Learn: Can apply new learning to daily work, encourage and facilitate learning in others, and actively make changes to work based on feedback.

  • Self-Development: Can demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and adaptability to new ideas and methods.

  • Leadership: Can take ownership of complex team initiatives, collaborate with others in decision-making processes, and drive team performance.

  • Strategic Thinking: Can analyze complex situations, anticipate future trends, and align and integrate strategies across departments or functions.

  • Problem-Solving: Can proactively identify and take ownership of complex problem-solving initiatives, initiate preventative measures, collaborate with others to find solutions, and drive successful outcomes.

  • Analytical Thinking: Can use advanced analytical techniques to solve complex problems, draw insights, and communicate the solutions effectively.

  • Prioritization: Can take ownership of complex task management, collaborate with others to align priorities, and drive team efficiency.

  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Can take ownership of customer-centric initiatives, ensuring products and services align with customer needs. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate customer feedback into product development.

  • Organization: Can oversee complex projects with multiple moving parts, ensure team alignment with organizational systems, and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences, facilitate effective communication between others, and mentor others in effective communication.

  • Interpersonal Skills: Can communicate effectively, build relationships, resolve conflicts, influence others, and support others in developing their interpersonal skills in major situations.

Skill Level Requirements

Lakehouse Platform and Architecture

  • Account and workspace design

  • Unity Catalog and metastore architecture

  • Compute strategy across interactive, jobs, and serverless workloads

  • Open table format decisions

  • Cost architecture and design choices that affect long-term scalability and affordability

The ability to design platforms that remain technically and financially sustainable at enterprise scale is critical.

Migration and Consolidation

  • Migrating organizations from Hadoop and Spark environments

  • Modernizing legacy analytics and statistical platforms

  • Consolidating established warehouses and appliance-based solutions

  • Migrating workloads from other cloud platforms

Key areas of expertise include:

  • Platform assessments

  • Wave planning and migration strategy

  • Workload and code conversion

  • Reconciliation and parity validation

  • Cutover planning and execution

This is expected to represent a significant portion of the work within the practice and requires genuine expertise rather than general familiarity.

Data Engineering and Pipelines

  • Batch data ingestion

  • Streaming data ingestion

  • Declarative pipeline development

  • Workflow orchestration

  • Testing and validation frameworks

  • Data quality instrumentation

  • Building and operating reliable, production-ready data engineering solutions

Machine Learning and AI Engineering

  • Feature engineering

  • Experiment tracking

  • Model registry and serving

  • Evaluation and validation frameworks

  • Retrieval and grounding architectures

  • Agent development

This represents one of Databricks’ key differentiators and is an area where many customers require assistance moving from proof-of-concept solutions to production-grade, supportable implementations.

Governance at the Perimeter

  • Catalog-based access controls

  • Data classification

  • Data masking

  • Data lineage and governance frameworks

Candidates should understand how Databricks governance integrates with enterprise governance strategies and be able to address challenges that exist across organizational and platform boundaries.

Consumption Economics

  • Compute sizing strategies

  • Workload placement optimization

  • Serverless versus classic compute trade-offs

  • Consumption attribution and chargeback models

  • Cost management and optimization practices

Candidates must be comfortable discussing platform costs with customers and providing practical guidance on controlling and forecasting consumption.

Technical Depth Expectations

Candidates do not need to be equally strong across all six areas; however, they must possess:

  • Deep expertise in lakehouse architecture and platform design

  • Deep expertise in migration and consolidation

  • Deep expertise in data engineering

  • Sufficient proficiency in the remaining areas to recognize when specialist support should be engaged

Other Requirements

Databricks Expertise

  • Substantial hands-on Databricks experience gained through:

    • A Databricks partner organization

    • Databricks directly

    • Managing a significant Databricks Lakehouse environment internally

  • This role requires Databricks-specific expertise rather than general data platform leadership experience.

Enterprise Migration and Consolidation Experience

  • Proven success delivering enterprise-scale migration and consolidation initiatives.

  • Ability to discuss at least one major migration project in detail, including lessons learned and outcomes.

Production Machine Learning and AI Experience

  • Experience operating and supporting production machine learning or AI solutions.

  • Expertise beyond proof-of-concept implementations.

  • Demonstrated understanding of the operational, governance, and maintenance considerations required for production AI workloads.

Principal-Level Technical Leadership

  • Proven success operating at Principal Architect level or equivalent.

  • Recognized as the senior technical authority in customer engagements.

  • Trusted to commit organizations to scopes, architectures, and technical approaches.

Presales Experience

  • Experience in presales environments, or

  • Delivery leadership experience demonstrating the ability to:

    • Lead customer discussions

    • Define scope and solution approaches

    • Develop proposals and Statements of Work

    • Stand behind technical commitments made during the sales process

Vendor Collaboration

  • Comfortable working with and being challenged by vendor architects and technical specialists.

Certifications

  • Databricks certification preferred.

  • Ability to obtain certification quickly if not currently certified.

  • Certification support and funding are provided.

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $195,000 - $250,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

jobs.excerpt: Help Us Change the Way People Use TechnologyAt DGR Systems, we’re about connecting companies to the right solutions and enabling them to gain the most value from their investments.
jobs.description:
Help Us Change the Way People Use Technology

At DGR Systems, we’re about connecting companies to the right solutions and enabling them to gain the most value from their investments. We go to great lengths to hire great people because, at our core, our clients deserve to have each person working on their project bring qualified expertise, a can-do attitude, and experience-based strategic insights to the table. They need to trust their IT consulting firm as a partner who is there to help accelerate their success and not pass them off to a junior team after the contract has been signed. Want to join us?

THE ROLE

DGR Systems designs and delivers technology solutions that our clients rely on to run their organizations. Behind every project sits a technical team doing complex, specialized work athigh standards, and a clientwho is counting on us to deliver what we committed to.

This role is about more than coordinating tasks.You will own the client relationship, the project record, and the path forward on every engagement you touch, from kickoff through close.

You will report to the Sr. Manager,PMOand work closely with DGR's Technical Leads in a two-in-the-box delivery model.

The Project Manager and Technical Lead bring different responsibilities to theengagement butshare accountability for delivering a successful outcome.

WHY THIS ISN’T A STANDARD BOOKKEEPING JOB

This role will feel different from a PM position where every project follows the same playbook. DGR hasestablisheddelivery methodologies, standards, and support structures, but our engagements vary significantly in size, complexity, technology, and client environment.

A network refresh spanning more than a thousand sites requires a different approach than an identity modernization for a healthcare system or a securityframeworkdeployment for a government organization. We expect our PMs to understand the difference and adjust the level of planning, communication, and governance accordingly.You will work with a Technical Lead who understands the technical work,establisheddelivery methodologies to guide the engagement, and the flexibility to adapt the approach together based on what the project requires.

The PM's role is not to direct the technical team. It is to create the conditions for the technical team to do their best work while keeping the client informed, expectations aligned, and the engagement moving forward.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

This role covers two things that have to work together for any engagement to succeed.

The Project

  • Lead technology projects end to end, applying DGR's delivery methodologies to fit the engagement rather than the other way around
  • Partner with the assigned Technical Lead in a two-in-the-box model, sharing ownership of the outcome andmaking sure priorities, decisions, dependencies, and next stepsremainclear.
  • Own all project documentation, artifacts, and reporting. The client, leadership, and team should always havean accurateread on where things stand.
  • Anticipate and clear roadblocks ahead of the team rather than reacting after they have slowed delivery
  • Surface risks and dependencies early, along with a recommendation for how to address them.
  • Match the level of process and coordination to what each engagement actually needs.Apply the right level of structure for the size, complexity, and risk ofthe engagement.

The Client Relationship

  • Be the client's primary contact. Own the relationship through proactive communication, honest status, and expectations that match reality.
  • Managescopeclearly and professionally. Help clients understand what is included,identifywhen a requestrepresentsa change, and work through those conversations without losing trust.
  • Coordinate across internal teams, partners, and client stakeholders to keep everyone aligned and moving forward.

You will also keep project records and documentation current throughout each engagement, not as a milestone activity but as an ongoing standard. We treat that as part of the job, not as something to get to later.

HOW WE WORK

  • We match the level of process to the engagement.Complex or sensitive projects require more structure, while smaller, focused engagements may need less. Strong PMs here know how to recognize the difference.
  • The Technical Lead is your delivery partner.You are not expected to manage their technical work. You are expected to work alongside them to keep the engagement organized, remove obstacles, manage theclientexperience, and make sure the team is moving toward the same outcome.
  • Proactive communication matters, especially when the news is difficult.We expect clients to hear about risks, delays, or changes from us early, along with a clear explanation of what happens next.
  • The project recordstayscurrent.Every engagement should be in good enough shape that another PM could pick it up tomorrow without asking you for context. That is the standard that protects the client and protects DGR.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You'llNeed

  • 3 or more years of project management experience in technology consulting or professional services
  • A track recordof managing IT deployments, integrations, and migrations across infrastructure, networking, security, or modern workplace environments
  • Experience navigating difficult client conversations, includingscopechanges, competing expectations, project risk, or delivery challenges.
  • A proactive communication style, especially when a project is at risk orexpectationsneedto be reset.
  • Strong project documentation habits, with the ability tomaintaina clear andaccurateproject record throughout the engagement.

It Will Help If You Have

  • Worked across multiple technology service areas
  • Experience with a delivery model where a PM and technical lead share ownership of the outcome
  • Exposure to Microsoft technology areas such as Modern Workplace, Identity, Infrastructure, or Security
  • Managed multiple concurrent engagements across varied client types in a consulting environment

We'llTeach You

  • DGR's delivery methodologiesand how we apply them
  • DGR's service portfolio and partner ecosystem
  • Our tooling, systems, documentation standards, and expectations for managing an engagement at DGR

WHO THIS ISN’T FOR

We want candidates to have a clear picture of the environment before deciding whether DGR is the right fit.

  • This role may not be the right fit if you prefer to follow the same project playbook regardless of the engagement. We haveestablishedmethodologies, but we expect PMs to apply judgment in how they use them.
  • You will need to be comfortable having clear conversations about scope. Serving the client well sometimes means explaining that a request changes what was originally agreed and helpingdeterminethe right path forward.
  • This is an execution-focused PM role within an established operating model.There will be opportunities to improve how we work, but the primary responsibility isdeliveringsuccessful client engagements.
  • You will also need to be comfortable operating when every answer is notimmediatelyavailable. We expect PMs to bring structure to ambiguity,identifywhat needs to be resolved, and keep the client and team moving forward

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary range$80,000 - $100,000

Work arrangement- Remote

DGR Systems also offers competitive healthcare coverage, 401(k) match, paid time off, paid holidays, Employer assisted HSA (Health Savings Account) match, and other company-sponsored programs.

HOW TO APPLY FOR THIS ROLE

Send us your resume and a few sentences about a client situation that challenged you. Tell us what made the situation difficult, how you approached it, and how the relationship was affected. It does not need to be a perfect success story. We are interested in how you think and communicate when a situation gets complicated.

Apply to:

DGR Systems is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, weare not able tosponsor visas.

jobs.title: Pre-Sales Solutions Architect
jobs.excerpt: About PraxentPraxent builds software for financial services companies, the kind where the stakes are real, the regulators are watching, and the legacy systems are not going away on their own.
jobs.description:
About Praxent

Praxent builds software for financial services companies, the kind where the stakes are real, the regulators are watching, and the legacy systems are not going away on their own. We have spent our history on application development for banks, insurers, lenders, payments companies, and wealth platforms, and we are now building out data platforms and AI services alongside it.

We are one of a very small number of smaller partners in Anthropic's managed partner program, which is otherwise made up almost entirely of global systems integrators. Our founder is still here. Our people stay. Delivery is AI-first, and collaboration is not a poster on the wall.

We are now investing seriously in the Microsoft ecosystem, and this role is central to that.

The role

You will be the technical face of Praxent in the Microsoft channel for financial services. That means working with Microsoft account teams to find where we fit, sitting with FSI executives to find what is worth funding, and owning the solution and the economics that connect the two.

Our sellers and the Microsoft field open the door. You are the person who walks through it and makes what is on the other side winnable and deliverable: you sit with FSI executives and their architects, work out what is actually worth funding, and own the solution and the economics that connect the two.

You will own proposals end to end, including pricing, scoping, requirements gathering, and SOW writing, and you will co-lead RFPs with our sales team. You will build the total cost of ownership and ROI case, not just quote a number. You will size the Azure consumption a program produces, because in this channel that number is what earns Microsoft's field investment. And when a pursuit needs proof, you will build the POC yourself, in days rather than weeks, then hand the deep technical work to a delivery team that is very good at it.

This is a pre-sales role with a practice-building mandate. You are not inheriting a demand engine. You are helping build one, with real investment behind it and design and leadership runway as the practice grows.

What this role is not

You are not a hunter. You will not carry an origination quota, a personal pipeline number, or a territory. Praxent sellers and the Microsoft field bring the opportunity; your job is to make us win it, price it honestly, and hand delivery something they can build. If what you want is to own a number and a book of accounts, this is the wrong seat and we would rather you knew that now.

What you will do

  • Own the technical story for Praxent's Microsoft offer in financial services, across all three phases: Azure modernization, the Fabric and Purview data foundation, and agents on Foundry governed by Agent 365.
  • Work alongside our sellers and the Microsoft field — account executives, cloud solution architects, and partner development managers — to qualify what they bring us and make Praxent the obvious technical choice on the accounts they already own.
  • Own proposals: pricing, scoping, requirements gathering, and SOW writing, co-leading RFPs with the salesperson, who owns the relationship and the close.
  • Architect the economics as well as the solution: total cost of ownership and ROI, not just a price, plus a sized Azure consumption ramp.
  • Find the Microsoft partner funding a pursuit qualifies for, and work with our partner team to secure it.
  • Hold your own in the room with CIOs and CEOs, and say what matters briefly.
  • Spin up POCs and working artifacts in hours or days when a pursuit needs proof.
  • Architect on the Microsoft stack, leaning on our delivery team for the deepest technical areas, and hand off clean scope they can build.
  • Defend our AI-native delivery model to technical buyers who are sceptical of it — the coding harness, the governance around it, and why AI velocity without one produces debt they will pay for later.
  • Package what works into reusable FSI IP and repeatable offerings the whole team can sell

What you bring

  • A financial services background. This one is non-negotiable. You understand lending, core banking, and payments — origination and underwriting, servicing and collections, KYC, AML and fraud, transaction monitoring, reconciliation, and disputes well enough to be useful in the room, not just in the architecture.
  • 10+ years in financial services technology, including 7+ in or alongside the Microsoft field, with real relationships and working knowledge of how the co-sell motion functions — Partner Center, co-sell ready offers, MACC, and partner funding included.
  • Commercial ownership experience: proposals you priced, scopes you defined, SOWs you wrote that got signed, and effort models you built and defended.
  • Executive presence. You are credible with a CIO or CEO, and you are succinct.
  • Comfort at $2-3M+ multi-year, multi-tower deal sizes.
  • A builder's instinct: you prototype fast because it moves deals, not because it is fun.
  • Working knowledge of the FSI regulatory landscape, enough to scope around it if not to advise on it.
  • Azure architecture credibility. AZ-305 preferred; if you do not have it, you are willing to get it within six months.
  • Enough agentic depth to scope one: Foundry, Agent 365, evals, human-in-the-loop gates, audit logging, and what it costs to run agents at volume.

Nice to have

  • Microsoft Fabric and Purview experience; Azure Databricks also counts.
  • Time at a Microsoft Partner of the Year firm, or at Microsoft itself.
  • Experience building FSI specific IP or accelerators.
  • Experience standing up a practice or offering from close to zero.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering workflows — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar — beyond having an opinion about them.

What You’ll Love About Us:

  • Rest and relaxation. Employees enjoy 15 days of PTO, 9 US holidays, 5 wellness days, and a closed office the last week of the year. Employees earn more PTO each year.
  • Stay healthy. We offer medical, dental, and vision coverage as well as wellness days. We also provide disability insurance and we even have a wellness program.
  • Plan for the future. We don’t want you to work here forever. Save for retirement with an IRA and we’ll match up to 3% every year.
  • Stability. We've been in business for over 25 years.
  • Work stays at work. We promote a healthy work/life balance to help ensure you have the time that you need. We encourage no more than a 40 hour work week.
  • Great company culture. We’ve been recognized by Texas Monthly, Clutch, Comparably, and more for the quality of our workplace. Feel free to check out our rating on Glassdoor.
  • We’re here to empower you. It’s your work and your career. Our management team is here to help you become who you want to be. Not to micromanage you.
  • We value your ideas. At Praxent, our doors are always open. Need help? Come on in. Have a vision for the future of the company? We’d love to hear it.
  • You’re more than an employee, you’re a person. Every co-worker you’ll meet is committed to treating you with respect and kindness. You won’t hear stuff like, “It’s just business.”
  • Family values. Praxent provides paid parental leave.

The US OTE earnings for this full-time position are targeted to be $225,000 - $255,000 + benefits. Our ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
